Abroscopus albogularis.extract: The rufous-faced warbler is a species of the bush warbler family, Cettiidae. It was formerly included in the "Old World warbler" assemblage.
Abroscopus albogularis.title: Rufous-faced warbler

zh-CN.title: 红脸树莺
zh-CN.extract: 红脸树莺是树莺科（Cettiidae）的一个物种。它以前被归入“旧世界莺”类群。

Acanthis flammea.extract: The redpoll is a species of small passerine bird in the finch family Fringillidae. It is the only species placed in the genus Acanthis. It breeds in the Arctic and north temperate Holarctic tundra and taiga. The redpoll was formerly widely treated as three species: the common or mealy redpoll, the arctic or hoary redpoll, and the lesser redpoll.
Acanthis flammea.title: Redpoll

zh-CN.title: 朱顶雀
zh-CN.extract: 朱顶雀是一种小型雀形目鸟类，属于燕雀科。它是Acanthis属中唯一的物种。繁殖于北极和北温带的全北区冻原和针叶林地带。朱顶雀曾广泛被视为三个独立物种：普通朱顶雀（或称粉红朱顶雀）、北极朱顶雀（或称白腰朱顶雀）和小朱顶雀。

Accipiter cooperii.extract: Cooper's hawk is a medium-sized hawk native to the North American continent and found from southern Canada to Mexico. This species was formerly placed in the genus Accipiter.
Accipiter cooperii.title: Cooper's hawk

zh-CN.title: 库氏鹰
zh-CN.extract: 库氏鹰是一种中型鹰，原产于北美大陆，分布范围从加拿大南部到墨西哥。该物种曾归入Accipiter属。

Accipiter gentilis.extract: The Eurasian goshawk is a species of medium-large bird of prey in the family Accipitridae, a family which also includes other extant diurnal raptors, such as eagles, buzzards and harriers. It was formerly placed in the genus Accipiter. It is a widespread species that inhabits many of the temperate parts of Eurasia. Except in a small portion of southern Asia, it is the only species of "goshawk" in its range and it is thus often referred to, both officially and unofficially, as simply goshawk. It is mainly resident, but birds from colder regions migrate south for the winter. As of 2023, goshawks found in North America are no longer considered to be conspecific, but are now designated as the American goshawk.
Accipiter gentilis.title: Eurasian goshawk

zh-CN.title: 苍鹰
zh-CN.extract: 苍鹰是一种中大型猛禽，属于鹰科，该科还包括其他现存的昼行性猛禽，如雕、鵟和鹞。它曾归入Accipiter属。它是一种分布广泛的物种，栖息于欧亚大陆许多温带地区。除南亚一小部分外，它是其分布区内唯一的“苍鹰”物种，因此通常（无论是正式还是非正式地）简称为苍鹰。主要为留鸟，但来自寒冷地区的个体会南迁越冬。截至2023年，北美发现的苍鹰不再被视为同种，而是被指定为美洲苍鹰。

Accipiter nisus.extract: The Eurasian sparrowhawk, also known as the northern sparrowhawk or simply the sparrowhawk, is a small bird of prey in the family Accipitridae. Adult male Eurasian sparrowhawks have bluish grey upperparts and orange-barred underparts; females and juveniles are brown above with brown barring below. The female is up to 25% larger than the male – one of the greatest size differences between the sexes in any bird species. Though it is a predator which specialises in catching woodland birds, the Eurasian sparrowhawk can be found in any habitat and often hunts garden birds in towns and cities. Males tend to take smaller birds, including tits, finches and sparrows; females catch primarily thrushes and starlings but are capable of killing birds weighing 500 g (18 oz) or more.
Accipiter nisus.title: Eurasian sparrowhawk

zh-CN.title: 雀鹰
zh-CN.extract: 雀鹰，也称北方雀鹰或简称雀鹰，是鹰科的一种小型猛禽。成年雄性雀鹰上体蓝灰色，下体带橙色横纹；雌鸟和幼鸟上体褐色，下体具褐色横纹。雌鸟比雄鸟大25%——这是任何鸟类中两性体型差异最大的之一。尽管它是一种专门捕食林地鸟类的捕食者，雀鹰可以在任何栖息地找到，并经常在城镇和城市中捕食花园鸟类。雄鸟倾向于捕捉较小的鸟类，包括山雀、雀类和麻雀；雌鸟主要捕食鸫和椋鸟，但也能杀死重达500克（18盎司）或更重的鸟。

Accipiter striatus.extract: The sharp-shinned hawk or northern sharp-shinned hawk, colloquially often nicknamed sharpie, is a small hawk, with males being the smallest hawks in the United States and Canada, but with the species averaging larger than some Neotropical species, such as the tiny hawk. The taxonomy is far from resolved, with some authorities considering the southern taxa to represent three separate species, white-breasted hawk, plain-breasted hawk, and rufous-thighed hawk. The American Ornithological Society and some other checklists keep all four species conspecific. A recent genetic study additionally recommended splitting the three Caribbean island populations as three additional separate species, though this has not yet been adopted by any of the ornithological authorities.
Accipiter striatus.title: Sharp-shinned hawk

zh-CN.title: 条纹鹰
zh-CN.extract: 条纹鹰，也称北方条纹鹰，口语中常昵称为“尖子”，是一种小型鹰，雄鸟是美国和加拿大最小的鹰，但该物种平均体型比某些新热带物种（如小鹰）大。其分类远未明确，一些权威机构将南方类群视为三个独立物种：白胸鹰、纯胸鹰和红腿鹰。美国鸟类学学会和其他一些名录将所有四个物种视为同种。最近的一项遗传研究还建议将三个加勒比岛屿种群分裂为另外三个独立物种，但尚未被任何鸟类学权威机构采纳。

Acridotheres cristatellus.extract: The crested myna, also known as the Chinese starling, is a species of starling in the genus Acridotheres native to southeastern China and Indochina. It is named after the tuft of feathers on its forehead that resembles a crest.
Acridotheres cristatellus.title: Crested myna

zh-CN.title: 冠八哥
zh-CN.extract: 冠八哥，也称中国椋鸟，是八哥属的一种椋鸟，原产于中国东南部和印度支那。它的名字来源于前额上类似冠羽的羽毛簇。

Acridotheres grandis.extract: The great myna, also known as the white-vented myna, is a species of starling in the family Sturnidae. Its range extends from Sikkim across Northeast India and Indochina.
Acridotheres grandis.title: Great myna

zh-CN.title: 大八哥
zh-CN.extract: 大八哥，也称白臀八哥，是椋鸟科八哥属的一种鸟类。其分布范围从锡金穿过印度东北部和印度支那。

Acridotheres tristis.extract: The common myna or Indian myna, sometimes spelled mynah, is a bird in the family Sturnidae, native to Asia. An omnivorous open woodland bird with a strong territorial instinct, the common myna has adapted extremely well to urban environments.
Acridotheres tristis.title: Common myna

zh-CN.title: 家八哥
zh-CN.extract: 家八哥，也称印度八哥，有时拼写为mynah，是椋鸟科的一种鸟类，原产于亚洲。作为一种杂食性、领地意识强的开阔林地鸟类，家八哥在城市环境中适应得非常好。

Acrocephalus bistrigiceps.extract: The black-browed reed warbler is a marsh-warbler in the family Acrocephalidae. It was formerly included in the "Old World warbler" assemblage. The species was first described by Robert Swinhoe in 1860.
Acrocephalus bistrigiceps.title: Black-browed reed warbler

zh-CN.title: 黑眉苇莺
zh-CN.extract: 黑眉苇莺是一种苇莺科（Acrocephalidae）的沼泽莺。它曾被归入“旧大陆莺”类群。该物种由罗伯特·斯温霍于1860年首次描述。

Acrocephalus concinens.extract: The blunt-winged warbler is a marsh-warbler. The species was first described by Robert Swinhoe in 1870. It was formerly included in the "Old World warbler" assemblage.
Acrocephalus concinens.title: Blunt-winged warbler

zh-CN.title: 钝翅苇莺
zh-CN.extract: 钝翅苇莺是一种沼泽莺。该物种由罗伯特·斯温霍于1870年首次描述。它曾被归入“旧大陆莺”类群。

Acrocephalus orientalis.extract: The Oriental reed warbler is a passerine bird of eastern Asia belonging to the reed warbler genus Acrocephalus. It was formerly classified as a subspecies of the great reed warbler of the western Palearctic.
Acrocephalus orientalis.title: Oriental reed warbler

zh-CN.title: 东方大苇莺
zh-CN.extract: 东方大苇莺是东亚的一种雀形目鸟类，属于苇莺属（Acrocephalus）。它曾被视为西方古北界的大苇莺的一个亚种。

Acrocephalus tangorum.extract: The Manchurian reed warbler, also known as the Manchurian reed-warbler, is a species of marsh-warbler. It was formerly included in the "Old World warbler" assemblage, and was usually treated as a subspecies of the paddyfield warbler. It is found in Cambodia, China, Hong Kong, South Korea, Laos, Russia, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia and possibly Myanmar. Its natural habitat is swamps. It is threatened by habitat loss.
Acrocephalus tangorum.title: Manchurian reed warbler

zh-CN.title: 远东苇莺
zh-CN.extract: 远东苇莺，也称满洲苇莺，是一种沼泽莺。它曾被归入“旧大陆莺”类群，并通常被视为稻田苇莺的一个亚种。分布于柬埔寨、中国、香港、韩国、老挝、俄罗斯、泰国、越南、马来西亚以及可能包括缅甸。其自然栖息地为沼泽。由于栖息地丧失而受到威胁。

Actinodura cyanouroptera.extract: The blue-winged minla, also known as the blue-winged siva, is a species of bird in the family Leiothrichidae.
Actinodura cyanouroptera.title: Blue-winged minla

zh-CN.title: 蓝翅希鹛
zh-CN.extract: 蓝翅希鹛，也称蓝翅笑鸫，是噪鹛科（Leiothrichidae）的一种鸟类。

Actitis hypoleucos.extract: The common sandpiper is a small Palearctic wader. This bird and its American sister species, the spotted sandpiper, make up the genus Actitis. They are parapatric and replace each other geographically; stray birds of either species may settle down with breeders of the other and hybridize. Hybridization has also been reported between the common sandpiper and the green sandpiper, a member of the closely related genus Tringa.
Actitis hypoleucos.title: Common sandpiper

zh-CN.title: 矶鹬
zh-CN.extract: 矶鹬是一种小型古北界涉禽。该鸟及其美洲姊妹种斑腹矶鹬共同组成矶鹬属（Actitis）。它们为邻域分布，在地理上相互替代；迷鸟可能随另一物种的繁殖鸟定居并杂交。还报道过矶鹬与林鹬（近缘的鹬属Tringa成员）的杂交。

Actitis macularius.extract: The spotted sandpiper is a small shorebird. Together with its sister species the common sandpiper, it makes up the genus Actitis. They replace each other geographically; stray birds may settle down with breeders of the other species and hybridize.
Actitis macularius.title: Spotted sandpiper

zh-CN.title: 斑腹矶鹬
zh-CN.extract: 斑腹矶鹬是一种小型滨鸟。它与姊妹种矶鹬共同组成矶鹬属（Actitis）。它们在分布上相互替代；迷鸟可能随另一物种的繁殖鸟定居并杂交。

Aechmophorus occidentalis.extract: The western grebe is a species in the grebe family of water birds. Folk names include "dabchick", "swan grebe" and "swan-necked grebe".
Aechmophorus occidentalis.title: Western grebe

zh-CN.title: 西䴙䴘
zh-CN.extract: 西䴙䴘是水鸟䴙䴘科的一种。俗称包括“小䴙䴘”、“天鹅䴙䴘”和“天鹅颈䴙䴘”。

Aegithalos concinnus.extract: The black-throated bushtit, also known as the black-throated tit, is a very small passerine bird in the family Aegithalidae.
Aegithalos concinnus.title: Black-throated bushtit

zh-CN.title: 红头长尾山雀
zh-CN.extract: 红头长尾山雀，也称为黑喉山雀，是一种非常小的雀形目鸟，属于长尾山雀科（Aegithalidae）。

Aegolius acadicus.extract: The northern saw-whet owl is a species of small owl in the family Strigidae. The species is native to North America. Saw-whet owls of the genus Aegolius are some of the smallest owl species in North America. They can be found in dense thickets, often at eye level, although they can also be found some 20 ft (6.1 m) up. Saw-whets are often in danger of being preyed upon by larger birds of prey. The northern saw-whet owl is a migratory bird without any strict pattern.
Aegolius acadicus.title: Northern saw-whet owl

zh-CN.title: 北鸺鹠
zh-CN.extract: 北鸺鹠是一种小型鸮科（Strigidae）鸟类。该物种原产于北美洲。鸺鹠属（Aegolius）的鸺鹠是北美洲最小的鸮类之一。它们可以在茂密的灌木丛中找到，通常与视线齐平，尽管也可能在约20英尺（6.1米）高处发现。北鸺鹠经常面临被较大猛禽捕食的危险。它是一种没有严格模式的候鸟。

Aerodramus fuciphagus.extract: The edible-nest swiftlet, also known as the white-nest swiftlet, is a small bird of the swift family which is found in Southeast Asia. Its opaque and whitish nest is made exclusively of solidified saliva and is the main ingredient of bird's nest soup, a delicacy of Chinese cuisine. Germain's swiftlet is now treated as conspecific with this species.
Aerodramus fuciphagus.title: Edible-nest swiftlet

zh-CN.title: 金丝燕
zh-CN.extract: 金丝燕，也称为白巢金丝燕，是一种小型雨燕科鸟类，分布于东南亚。其不透明且发白的巢完全由凝固的唾液构成，是中式美食燕窝汤的主要成分。杰氏金丝燕（Germain's swiftlet）现在被视为与该物种同种。

Aeronautes saxatalis.extract: The white-throated swift is a swift of the family Apodidae native to western North America, south to cordilleran western Honduras. Its coastal range extends as far north as Northern California, while inland it has migratory populations found throughout the Great Basin and Rocky Mountain regions, ranging as far north as southern British Columbia. White-throated swifts are found in open areas near cliffs, rock faces, or man-made structures, where they roost. Swifts are social birds, and groups are often seen roosting and foraging for flying insects together.
Aeronautes saxatalis.title: White-throated swift

zh-CN.title: 白喉雨燕
zh-CN.extract: 白喉雨燕是一种雨燕科（Apodidae）鸟类，原产于北美西部，南至洪都拉斯西部科迪勒拉山脉。其沿海范围北至加利福尼亚北部，而内陆则有迁徙种群分布于大盆地和落基山脉地区，最北可达不列颠哥伦比亚省南部。白喉雨燕出现在悬崖、岩壁或人造结构附近的开放区域，在那里栖息。雨燕是群居鸟类，经常可以看到群体一起栖息和觅食飞行昆虫。

Aethopyga christinae.extract: The fork-tailed sunbird is a bird in the family Nectariniidae. The species was first described by Robert Swinhoe in 1869.
Aethopyga christinae.title: Fork-tailed sunbird

zh-CN.title: 叉尾太阳鸟
zh-CN.extract: 叉尾太阳鸟是太阳鸟科（Nectariniidae）的一种鸟。该物种由罗伯特·斯温霍（Robert Swinhoe）于1869年首次描述。

Aethopyga gouldiae.extract: Mrs. Gould's sunbird is a sunbird species native to forests and shrublands from the southern foothills of the Himalayas to Southeast Asia.
Aethopyga gouldiae.title: Mrs. Gould's sunbird

zh-CN.title: 蓝喉太阳鸟
zh-CN.extract: 蓝喉太阳鸟是一种太阳鸟，原产于从喜马拉雅山南麓到东南亚的森林和灌木丛中。

Aethopyga siparaja.extract: The crimson sunbird is a species of bird in the sunbird family which feed largely on nectar. They may also take insects, especially when feeding their young. Flight is fast and direct on their short wings. Most species can take nectar by hovering like a hummingbird, but usually perch to feed. It is the unofficial national bird of Singapore, as declared by the Nature Society Singapore.
Aethopyga siparaja.title: Crimson sunbird

zh-CN.title: 黄腰太阳鸟
zh-CN.extract: 黄腰太阳鸟是太阳鸟科的一种鸟类，主要以花蜜为食。它们也可能捕食昆虫，特别是在喂养雏鸟时。飞行速度快而直接，翅膀短。大多数物种可以像蜂鸟一样悬停采蜜，但通常栖息觅食。它是新加坡的非官方国鸟，由新加坡自然学会宣布。

Agapornis fischeri.extract: Fischer's lovebird is a small parrot species of the genus Agapornis. They were originally discovered in the late 19th century. They are named after the 19th century German explorer of East Africa Gustav Fischer.
Agapornis fischeri.title: Fischer's lovebird

zh-CN.title: 费氏牡丹鹦鹉
zh-CN.extract: 费氏牡丹鹦鹉是牡丹鹦鹉属的一种小型鹦鹉。它们最初于19世纪末被发现。以19世纪东非德国探险家古斯塔夫·费舍尔（Gustav Fischer）命名。

Agelaius phoeniceus.extract: The red-winged blackbird is a passerine bird of the family Icteridae found in most of North America and much of Central America. It breeds from Alaska and Newfoundland south to Florida, the Gulf of Mexico, Mexico, and Guatemala, with isolated populations in western El Salvador, northwestern Honduras, and northwestern Costa Rica. It may winter as far north as Pennsylvania and British Columbia, but northern populations are generally migratory, moving south to Mexico and the Southern United States.
Agelaius phoeniceus.title: Red-winged blackbird

zh-CN.title: 红翅黑鹂
zh-CN.extract: 红翅黑鹂是一种雀形目鸟类，属于拟鹂科，分布于北美大部分地区和中美洲大部分地区。其繁殖范围从阿拉斯加和纽芬兰向南至佛罗里达、墨西哥湾、墨西哥和危地马拉，在萨尔瓦多西部、洪都拉斯西北部和哥斯达黎加西北部有孤立种群。冬季最北可到宾夕法尼亚和不列颠哥伦比亚省，但北部种群通常为候鸟，向南迁徙至墨西哥和美国南部。

Agropsar philippensis.extract: The chestnut-cheeked starling is a species of starling in the family Sturnidae. It breeds in Japan and the Russian islands of Sakhalin and Kuriles; it winters in Taiwan, the Philippines and northern Borneo.
Agropsar philippensis.title: Chestnut-cheeked starling

zh-CN.title: 栗颊椋鸟
zh-CN.extract: 栗颊椋鸟是椋鸟科的一种椋鸟。繁殖于日本和俄罗斯的萨哈林岛及千岛群岛；冬季在台湾、菲律宾和北婆罗洲越冬。

Agropsar sturninus.extract: The Daurian starling, or purple-backed starling, is a species of bird in the starling family found in the eastern Palearctic from eastern Mongolia and southeastern Russia to North Korea and central China.
Agropsar sturninus.title: Daurian starling

zh-CN.title: 紫背椋鸟
zh-CN.extract: 紫背椋鸟，又称达乌里椋鸟，是椋鸟科的一种鸟类，分布于东古北界，从蒙古东部和俄罗斯东南部至朝鲜北部和中国中部。

Aix galericulata.extract: The mandarin duck is a perching duck species native to East and Northeast Asia. It is sexually dimorphic; the males are elaborately coloured, while the females have more subdued colours. It is a medium-sized duck, at 41–49 cm (16–19 in) long with a 65–75 cm (26–30 in) wingspan. It is closely related to the North American wood duck, the only other member of the genus Aix. 'Aix' is an Ancient Greek word which was used by Aristotle to refer to an unknown diving bird, and 'galericulata' is the Latin for a wig, derived from galerum, a cap or bonnet. Outside of its native range, the mandarin duck has a large introduced population in the British Isles and Western Europe, with additional smaller introductions in North America.
Aix galericulata.title: Mandarin duck

zh-CN.title: 鸳鸯
zh-CN.extract: 鸳鸯是一种原产于东亚和东北亚的栖鸭。该鸟种两性异形：雄性色彩艳丽，雌性则颜色较为暗淡。属于中型鸭，体长41–49厘米，翼展65–75厘米。它与北美林鸳鸯亲缘关系密切，后者是Aix属中唯一的其他物种。“Aix”是亚里士多德使用的一个古希腊词语，指一种未知的潜水鸟；“galericulata”是拉丁语中假发的意思，源自galerum（帽子或软帽）。在其原生分布区之外，鸳鸯在英伦三岛和西欧有大量引入种群，在北美也有较小的引入种群。

Aix sponsa.extract: The wood duck or Carolina duck is a partially migratory species of perching duck found in North America. The male is one of the most colorful North American waterfowls.
Aix sponsa.title: Wood duck

zh-CN.title: 林鸳鸯
zh-CN.extract: 林鸳鸯或卡罗来纳鸭是一种部分迁徙的栖鸭，分布于北美。雄性是最为多彩的北美水禽之一。

Alauda arvensis.extract: The Eurasian skylark, commonly referred to in Europe as the lark, is a passerine bird in the lark family, Alaudidae. It is a widespread species found across Europe and the Palearctic with introduced populations in Australia, New Zealand, Canada, and on the Hawaiian Islands. It is a bird of open farmland and heath, known for the song of the male, which is delivered in hovering flight from heights of 50 to 100 metres. The sexes are alike. It is streaked greyish-brown above and on the breast and has a buff-white belly.
Alauda arvensis.title: Eurasian skylark

zh-CN.title: 欧亚云雀
zh-CN.extract: 欧亚云雀，在欧洲常简称为云雀，是百灵科（Alaudidae）的一种雀形目鸟类。它广泛分布于欧洲和古北界，并在澳大利亚、新西兰、加拿大和夏威夷群岛有引入种群。这是一种生活在开阔农田和石楠地的鸟类，以雄性在50至100米高度盘旋飞行时鸣唱而闻名。两性相似。上体和胸部为带有灰色条纹的灰褐色，腹部为浅黄白色。

Alauda gulgula.extract: The Oriental skylark is a species of skylark found in the Sino-Indian region and parts of central Asia. Like other skylarks, it is found in open grassland where it feeds on seeds and insects.
Alauda gulgula.title: Oriental skylark

zh-CN.title: 小云雀
zh-CN.extract: 小云雀是一种云雀，分布于中印地区和中亚部分地区。与其他云雀一样，生活在开阔草地，以种子和昆虫为食。

Alcedo atthis.extract: The common kingfisher, also known as the Eurasian kingfisher and river kingfisher, is a small kingfisher with seven subspecies recognized within its wide distribution across Eurasia and North Africa. It is resident in much of its range, but migrates from areas where rivers freeze in winter.
Alcedo atthis.title: Common kingfisher

zh-CN.title: 普通翠鸟
zh-CN.extract: 普通翠鸟，也称为欧亚翠鸟和河翠鸟，是一种小型翠鸟，在其广泛分布于欧亚大陆和北非的范围内有7个亚种。它在大部分分布区为留鸟，但会从河流冬季结冰的地区迁徙。

Alcippe hueti.extract: Huet's fulvetta is a species of bird in the family Leiothrichidae. It is endemic to southeast China. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist montane forest. Its diet includes Vaccinium carlesii.
Alcippe hueti.title: Huet's fulvetta

zh-CN.title: 休氏雀鹛
zh-CN.extract: 休氏雀鹛是噪鹛科的一种鸟类。它特有于中国东南部。其自然栖息地为亚热带或热带湿润山地森林。其食物包括 Vaccinium carlesii。

Amandava amandava.extract: The red avadavat, red munia or strawberry finch, is a sparrow-sized bird of the family Estrildidae. It is found in the open fields and grasslands of tropical Asia and is popular as a cage bird due to the colourful plumage of the males in their breeding season. It breeds in the Indian subcontinent in the monsoon season. The species name of amandava and the common name of avadavat are derived from the city of Ahmedabad in Gujarat, India, from where these birds were exported into the pet trade in former times.
Amandava amandava.title: Red avadavat

zh-CN.title: 红梅花雀
zh-CN.extract: 红梅花雀，或称红火雀、草莓雀，是一种麻雀大小的梅花雀科鸟类。分布于热带亚洲的开阔田野和草地，因其雄鸟在繁殖季节色彩鲜艳的羽毛而常被作为笼鸟。它在印度次大陆的季风季节繁殖。种加词 amandava 和常用名 avadavat 源自印度古吉拉特邦的艾哈迈达巴德市，这些鸟早年曾被出口到宠物贸易。

Amaurornis phoenicurus.extract: The white-breasted waterhen is a waterbird of the rail and crake family, Rallidae, that is widely distributed across South and Southeast Asia. They are dark slaty birds with a clean white face, breast and belly. They are somewhat bolder than most other rails and are often seen stepping slowly with their tail cocked upright in open marshes or even drains near busy roads. They are largely crepuscular in activity and during the breeding season, just after the first rains, make loud and repetitive croaking calls.
Amaurornis phoenicurus.title: White-breasted waterhen

zh-CN.title: 白胸苦恶鸟
zh-CN.extract: 白胸苦恶鸟是秧鸡科（Rallidae）的一种水鸟，广泛分布于南亚和东南亚。它们身体呈暗石板色，面部、胸部和腹部为洁净的白色。它们比多数其他秧鸡更加大胆，常可看到它们在开阔沼泽甚至繁忙道路旁的排水沟中尾巴翘起缓步行走。它们主要在晨昏活动，繁殖季节（刚过第一场雨）会发出响亮而重复的呱呱叫声。

Ammodramus savannarum.extract: The grasshopper sparrow is a small New World sparrow. It belongs to the genus Ammodramus, which contains three species that inhabit grasslands and prairies. Grasshopper sparrows are sometimes found in crop fields and they will readily colonize reclaimed grassland. In the core of their range, grasshopper sparrows are dependent upon large areas of grassland where they avoid trees and shrubs. They seek out heterogenous patches of prairie that contain clumps of dead grass or other vegetation where they conceal their nest, and also contain barer ground where they forage for insects, spiders, and seeds. Grasshopper sparrows are unusual among New World sparrows in that they sing two distinct song types, the prevalence of which varies with the nesting cycle. The primary male song, a high trill preceded by a stereotyped series of short chips, is reminiscent of the sounds of grasshoppers and is the origin of this species' name. Like some other birds of the central North American grasslands, this species also moves around a lot, not only via annual migrations, but individuals frequently disperse between breeding attempts or breeding seasons. Grasshopper sparrows are in steep decline across their range, even in the core of the breeding distribution in the tallgrass prairies of the central Great Plains. The Florida grasshopper sparrow is highly endangered.
Ammodramus savannarum.title: Grasshopper sparrow

zh-CN.title: 蚱蜢鹀
zh-CN.extract: 蚱蜢鹀是一种小型新世界麻雀。它属于 Ammodramus 属，该属包含三种栖息于草地和草原的物种。蚱蜢鹀有时出现在农田中，并乐于在复垦的草地上定居。在其分布核心区，蚱蜢鹀依赖大面积草地，并避开树木和灌木。它们寻找包含枯草或其他植物丛的异质草原斑块来隐藏鸟巢，同时也需要较裸露的地面来觅食昆虫、蜘蛛和种子。蚱蜢鹀在新世界麻雀中不寻常，因为它们会唱两种截然不同的歌声，其出现频率随巢周期变化。雄鸟的主要歌声是一段高音颤音，前面有一系列刻板的短促音节，让人联想到蚱蜢的声音，这也是该物种名称的由来。像北美中部草原的一些其他鸟类一样，这个物种也频繁移动，不仅每年迁徙，个体也常在繁殖尝试或繁殖季节之间扩散。蚱蜢鹀在其整个分布区数量急剧下降，即使是在中央大平原高草草原的繁殖核心区也是如此。佛罗里达蚱蜢鹀已高度濒危。

Amphispiza bilineata.extract: The black-throated sparrow is a species of bird in the family Passerellidae, the New World sparrows. It is found in Mexico and the United States.
Amphispiza bilineata.title: Black-throated sparrow

zh-CN.title: 黑喉雀鹀
zh-CN.extract: 黑喉雀鹀是雀鹀科（Passerellidae）的一种鸟类，属于新世界麻雀。分布于墨西哥和美国。

Anas acuta.extract: The pintail or northern pintail is a duck species with wide geographic distribution that breeds in the northern areas of Europe and across the Palearctic and North America. It is migratory and winters south of its breeding range as far as the equator. Unusually for a bird with such a large range, it has no geographical subspecies, although the possibly conspecific duck Eaton's pintail is considered to be a separate species.
Anas acuta.title: Northern pintail

zh-CN.title: 针尾鸭
zh-CN.extract: 针尾鸭是一种分布广泛的鸭类，繁殖于欧洲北部、古北界和北美。它是候鸟，冬季迁徙到繁殖地以南直至赤道。对于分布范围如此之大的鸟类来说，没有地理亚种是不寻常的，不过可能同种的伊顿针尾鸭（Eaton's pintail）被认为是一个独立物种。

Anas crecca.extract: The Eurasian teal, common teal, or Eurasian green-winged teal is a common and widespread duck that breeds in temperate Eurosiberia and migrates south in winter. The Eurasian teal is often called simply the teal due to being the only one of these small dabbling ducks in much of its range. The bird gives its name to the blue-green colour teal.
Anas crecca.title: Eurasian teal

zh-CN.title: 绿翅鸭
zh-CN.extract: 绿翅鸭是一种常见且分布广泛的鸭类，繁殖于温带欧亚大陆，冬季南迁。绿翅鸭常被简称为 teal，因为在它的大部分分布区内它是唯一的小型浮水鸭。这种鸟赋予了蓝绿色（teal）这一颜色名称。

Anas platyrhynchos.extract: The mallard or wild duck is a dabbling duck that breeds throughout the temperate and subtropical Americas, Eurasia, and North Africa. It has been introduced to New Zealand, Australia, Peru, Brazil, Uruguay, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, the Falkland Islands, and South Africa. Belonging to the subfamily Anatinae of the waterfowl family Anatidae, mallards live in wetlands, eat water plants and small animals, and are social animals preferring to congregate in groups or flocks of varying sizes.
Anas platyrhynchos.title: Mallard

zh-CN.title: 绿头鸭
zh-CN.extract: 绿头鸭是一种浮水鸭，繁殖于温带和亚热带的美洲、欧亚大陆和北非。它已被引入新西兰、澳大利亚、秘鲁、巴西、乌拉圭、阿根廷、智利、哥伦比亚、福克兰群岛和南非。属于鸭科（Anatidae）的鸭亚科（Anatinae），绿头鸭生活在湿地，吃水草和小动物，是社会性动物，喜欢聚集在大小不一的群体或鸭群中。

Anas zonorhyncha.extract: The eastern spot-billed duck or Chinese spot-billed duck is a species of dabbling duck that breeds in East and Southeast Asia. This species was formerly considered a subspecies of the Indian spot-billed duck and both were referred to as the spot-billed duck. The name is derived from the yellow spot on the bill.
Anas zonorhyncha.title: Eastern spot-billed duck

zh-CN.title: 东方斑嘴鸭
zh-CN.extract: 东方斑嘴鸭，又称中华斑嘴鸭，是一种涉水鸭，繁殖于东亚和东南亚。该物种曾被视为印度斑嘴鸭的亚种，二者统称为斑嘴鸭。其名称源自喙上的黄色斑点。

Anhinga melanogaster.extract: The Oriental darter is a water bird of tropical South Asia and Southeast Asia. It has a long and slender neck with a straight, pointed bill and, like the cormorant, it hunts for fish while its body is submerged in water. It spears a fish underwater, bringing it above the surface, tossing and juggling it before swallowing the fish head first. The body remains submerged as it swims, and the slender neck alone is visible above the water, which accounts for the colloquial name of snakebird. Like the cormorants, it has wettable feathers and it is often found perched on a rock or branch with its wings held open to dry.
Anhinga melanogaster.title: Oriental darter

zh-CN.title: 东方蛇鹈
zh-CN.extract: 东方蛇鹈是热带南亚和东南亚的一种水鸟。它颈部细长，喙直而尖锐，与鸬鹚类似，身体潜入水中捕鱼。它会在水下刺中鱼，然后带到水面，抛掷并摆弄，最后从头开始吞下。游泳时身体没入水中，仅细长的颈部露出水面，因此俗称“蛇鸟”。与鸬鹚一样，它的羽毛可湿润，常栖息在岩石或树枝上，张开翅膀晾干。

Anous minutus.extract: The black noddy, also known as white-capped noddy, is a species of tern in the family Laridae. It is a medium-sized seabird with black plumage and a white cap that closely resembles the lesser noddy with which it was at one time considered conspecific. The black noddy has slightly darker plumage and dark rather than pale lores.
Anous minutus.title: Black noddy

zh-CN.title: 黑玄燕鸥
zh-CN.extract: 黑玄燕鸥，也称白顶玄燕鸥，是鸥科燕鸥属的一种。它是一种中型海鸟，羽毛黑色，头顶白色，与小玄燕鸥极为相似，曾被认为同种。黑玄燕鸥的羽毛略深，眼先呈深色而非浅色。

Anous stolidus.extract: The brown noddy, common noddy or noddy tern is a seabird in the family Laridae. The largest of the noddies, it can be told from the closely related black noddy by its larger size and plumage, which is dark brown rather than black. The brown noddy is a tropical seabird with a worldwide distribution, ranging from Hawaii to the Tuamotu Archipelago and Australia in the Pacific Ocean, from the Red Sea to the Seychelles and Australia in the Indian Ocean and in the Caribbean to Tristan da Cunha in the Atlantic Ocean. The brown noddy is colonial, usually nesting on elevated situations on cliffs or in short trees or shrubs. It only occasionally nests on the ground. A single egg is laid by the female of a pair each breeding season. In India, the brown noddy is protected in the PM Sayeed Marine Birds Conservation Reserve.
Anous stolidus.title: Brown noddy

zh-CN.title: 褐玄燕鸥
zh-CN.extract: 褐玄燕鸥，又称普通玄燕鸥，是鸥科的一种海鸟。它是玄燕鸥中体型最大的，与近缘的黑玄燕鸥相比，体型更大，羽毛为深褐色而非黑色。褐玄燕鸥是一种热带海鸟，分布广泛，从夏威夷到土阿莫土群岛和澳大利亚（太平洋），从红海到塞舌尔和澳大利亚（印度洋），以及从加勒比海到特里斯坦达库尼亚（大西洋）。褐玄燕鸥营群居生活，通常在悬崖、矮树或灌木的高处筑巢，偶尔在地面筑巢。每个繁殖季节，雌鸟仅产一枚卵。在印度，褐玄燕鸥受到PM Sayeed海洋鸟类保护区的保护。

Anser albifrons.extract: The greater white-fronted goose is a species of goose, closely related to the smaller lesser white-fronted goose. The greater white-fronted goose is migratory, breeding in northern Canada, Alaska, Greenland, and Russia, and winters farther south in North America, Europe, and Asia. It is named for the patch of white feathers bordering the base of its bill; its specific name albifrons comes from the Latin albus "white" and frons "forehead". In the United Kingdom and Ireland, it has been known as the white-fronted goose; in North America, it is known as the greater white-fronted goose, and this name is also increasingly adopted internationally. Even more distinctive are the salt-and-pepper markings on the breast of adult birds, which is why the goose is colloquially called the "specklebelly" in North America.
Anser albifrons.title: Greater white-fronted goose

zh-CN.title: 白额雁
zh-CN.extract: 白额雁是一种雁，与较小的小白额雁亲缘关系密切。白额雁是候鸟，繁殖于加拿大北部、阿拉斯加、格陵兰和俄罗斯，冬季迁徙至北美、欧洲和亚洲南部。其名称源自喙基部的一圈白色羽毛；种加词albifrons来自拉丁语albus“白色”和frons“前额”。在英国和爱尔兰，它被称为白额雁；在北美，它被称为大白额雁，这一名称在国际上也被越来越多地采用。更独特的是成鸟胸部的盐胡椒色斑纹，因此在北美被俗称为“斑胸雁”。

Anser anser.extract: The greylag goose is a species of large goose in the waterfowl family Anatidae and the type species of the genus Anser. It has mottled and barred grey and white plumage and an orange beak and pink legs. A large bird, it measures between 74 and 91 centimetres in length, with an average weight of 3.3 kilograms. Its distribution is widespread, with birds from the north of its range in Europe and Asia often migrating southwards to spend the winter in warmer places, although many populations are resident, even in the north. It is the ancestor of most breeds of domestic goose, having been domesticated at least as early as 1360 BCE. The genus name and specific epithet are from anser, the Latin for "goose". In the USA, its name has been spelled "graylag".
Anser anser.title: Greylag goose

zh-CN.title: 灰雁
zh-CN.extract: 灰雁是雁形目鸭科的一种大型雁，也是雁属的模式种。其羽毛呈灰色和白色相间的斑驳状，喙橙色，腿粉色。它是一种大型鸟类，体长74至91厘米，平均体重3.3公斤。分布广泛，欧洲和亚洲北部地区的种群常向南迁徙到更温暖的地方越冬，但许多种群即使在高纬度地区也是留鸟。灰雁是大多数家鹅品种的祖先，最早至少在公元前1360年被驯化。属名和种加词均来自拉丁语anser，意为“鹅”。在美国，其名称拼写为“graylag”。

Anser cygnoides.extract: The swan goose is a large goose with a natural breeding range in inland Mongolia, Northeast China, and the Russian Far East. It is migratory and winters mainly in central and eastern China. Vagrant birds are encountered in Japan and Korea, and more rarely in Kazakhstan, Laos, coastal Siberia, Taiwan, Thailand and Uzbekistan.
Anser cygnoides.title: Swan goose

zh-CN.title: 鸿雁
zh-CN.extract: 鸿雁是一种大型雁，自然繁殖范围包括蒙古内陆、中国东北和俄罗斯远东地区。它是候鸟，主要在中国中东部越冬。偶见个体在日本和韩国出现，更罕见地在哈萨克斯坦、老挝、西伯利亚沿海、台湾、泰国和乌兹别克斯坦出现。

Anser erythropus.extract: The lesser white-fronted goose is a goose closely related to the larger greater white-fronted goose. It breeds in the northernmost Palearctic, but it is a scarce breeder in Europe, with a reintroduction attempt in Fennoscandia.
Anser erythropus.title: Lesser white-fronted goose

zh-CN.title: 小白额雁
zh-CN.extract: 小白额雁是一种与较大的白额雁亲缘关系密切的雁。它在最北端的古北界繁殖，但在欧洲是稀有的繁殖鸟，在芬诺斯坎底亚有再引入尝试。

Anser fabalis.extract: The taiga bean goose is a species of goose that breeds in northern Europe and Asia. It is migratory and winters further south in Europe and Asia. This and the tundra bean goose were recognised as separate species by the International Ornithologists' Union and the American Ornithological Society from 2007, but are still considered a single species by some other authorities, notably BirdLife International and the IUCN. The taiga and tundra bean goose diverged about 2.5 million years ago and established secondary contact c. 60,000 years ago, resulting in extensive gene flow.
Anser fabalis.title: Taiga bean goose

zh-CN.title: 豆雁
zh-CN.extract: 豆雁是一种雁类，繁殖于北欧和亚洲。它是候鸟，冬季在更南的欧洲和亚洲越冬。自2007年起，国际鸟类学家联合会和美国鸟类学会将其与冻原豆雁视为独立物种，但其他一些权威机构（特别是国际鸟盟和世界自然保护联盟）仍将其视为单一物种。豆雁和冻原豆雁约在250万年前分化，并在约6万年前发生二次接触，导致广泛的基因流动。

Anser serrirostris.extract: The tundra bean goose is a goose that breeds in northern Siberia. This and the taiga bean goose are recognised as separate species by the American Ornithological Society and International Ornithologists' Union, but are considered a single species by other authorities. It is migratory and winters further south in Asia. The taiga and tundra bean goose diverged about 2.5 million years ago and established secondary contact ca. 60,000 years ago, resulting in extensive gene flow.
Anser serrirostris.title: Tundra bean goose

zh-CN.title: 冻原豆雁
zh-CN.extract: 冻原豆雁是一种繁殖于西伯利亚北部的雁类。自2007年起，美国鸟类学会和国际鸟类学家联合会将其与豆雁视为独立物种，但其他权威机构仍将其视为单一物种。它是候鸟，冬季在更南的亚洲越冬。豆雁和冻原豆雁约在250万年前分化，并在约6万年前发生二次接触，导致广泛的基因流动。

Anthus cervinus.extract: The red-throated pipit is a small passerine bird, which breeds in the far north of Europe and the Palearctic, with a foothold in northern Alaska. It is a long-distance migrant, wintering to Africa and South-East Asia and western Alaska in North America. It is vagrant to Western Europe.
Anthus cervinus.title: Red-throated pipit

zh-CN.title: 红喉鹨
zh-CN.extract: 红喉鹨是一种小型雀形目鸟类，繁殖于欧洲北部和古北界极北部，并延伸至阿拉斯加北部。它是长距离迁徙鸟，冬季迁徙至非洲、东南亚以及北美洲的阿拉斯加西部。偶有迷鸟出现在西欧。

Anthus gustavi.extract: The Pechora pipit is a small passerine bird which breeds in the East Palearctic tundra and densely vegetated areas near river banks ranges from the Pechora River to the Chukchi Peninsula. It also breeds in Kamchatka and the Commander Islands, and with a disjunct population much further south in northeastern China and southeastern Siberia. It is a long-distance migrant, moving in winter to Indonesia. Rarely in September and October, the Pechora pipit may be observed in western Europe. The species was first described by Robert Swinhoe in 1863.
Anthus gustavi.title: Pechora pipit

zh-CN.title: 北鹨
zh-CN.extract: 北鹨是一种小型雀形目鸟类，繁殖于东古北界的冻原和河岸附近茂密植被区，分布范围从伯朝拉河到楚科奇半岛。还在堪察加半岛和指挥官群岛繁殖，并在中国东北部和西伯利亚东南部有一个不连续的孤立种群。它是长距离迁徙鸟，冬季迁徙至印度尼西亚。北鹨偶尔在9月和10月出现在西欧。该物种由罗伯特·斯温霍于1863年首次描述。

Anthus hodgsoni.extract: The olive-backed pipit is a small passerine bird of the pipit (Anthus) genus, which breeds across southern, north central and eastern Asia, as well as in the north-eastern European Russia. It is a long-distance migrant moving in winter to southern Asia and Indonesia. Sometimes it is also called Indian pipit or Hodgson's pipit, as well as tree pipit owing to its resemblance with the tree pipit. However, its back is more olive-toned and less streaked than that species, and its head pattern is different with a better-marked supercilium.
Anthus hodgsoni.title: Olive-backed pipit

zh-CN.title: 树鹨
zh-CN.extract: 树鹨是鹨属的一种小型雀形目鸟类，繁殖于亚洲南部、中北部和东部，以及俄罗斯欧洲部分的东北部。它是长距离迁徙鸟，冬季迁徙至南亚和印度尼西亚。有时也被称为印度鹨或霍奇森鹨，以及树鹨（因与林鹨相似）。但它的背部更偏橄榄色，条纹较浅，头部图案不同，眉纹更明显。

Anthus richardi.extract: Richard's pipit is a medium-sized passerine bird which breeds in open grasslands in the East Palearctic. It is a long-distance migrant moving to open lowlands in the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia. It is a rare but regular vagrant to western Europe.
Anthus richardi.title: Richard's pipit

zh-CN.title: 田鹨
zh-CN.extract: 田鹨是一种中型雀形目鸟类，繁殖于东古北界的开阔草地。它是长距离迁徙鸟，冬季迁徙至印度次大陆和东南亚的开阔低地。偶有但规律的迷鸟出现在西欧。

Anthus roseatus.extract:
The Rosy pipit is a species of bird in the family Motacillidae.
It is found in Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, China, India, South Korea, Myanmar, Nepal, Pakistan, Thailand and Vietnam.
Anthus roseatus.title: Rosy pipit

zh-CN.title: 粉红胸鹨
zh-CN.extract: 粉红胸鹨是鹡鸰科鹨属的一种鸟类。分布于阿富汗、孟加拉国、不丹、中国、印度、韩国、缅甸、尼泊尔、巴基斯坦、泰国和越南。

Anthus rubescens.extract: The American pipit, formerly known as the buff-bellied pipit, is a small songbird native to North America. It was first described by Marmaduke Tunstall in his 1771 Ornithologia Britannica. It was formerly classified as a form of the water pipit. The former subspecies, Siberian pipit, is now considered a distinct species.
Anthus rubescens.title: American pipit

zh-CN.title: 黄腹鹨
zh-CN.extract: 黄腹鹨，旧称水鹨，是一种原产于北美洲的小型雀形目鸟类。由马马杜克·滕斯托尔在其1771年的《不列颠鸟类学》中首次描述。它曾被认为是水鹨的一个亚种。原亚种西伯利亚鹨现被视为独立物种。

Anthus rufulus.extract: The paddyfield pipit or Oriental pipit is a small passerine bird in the pipit and wagtail family. It is a resident (non-migratory) breeder in open scrub, grassland and cultivation in southern Asia east to the Philippines. Although among the few breeding pipits in the Asian region, identification becomes difficult in winter when several other species migrate into the region. The taxonomy of the species is complex and has undergone considerable changes.
Anthus rufulus.title: Paddyfield pipit

zh-CN.title: 稻田鹨
zh-CN.extract: 稻田鹨或东方鹨是鹡鸰科鹨属的一种小型雀形目鸟类。它是南亚至菲律宾东部开阔灌丛、草地和耕地的留鸟（非迁徙繁殖鸟）。尽管是亚洲地区少数繁殖的鹨之一，但在冬季其他几种物种迁徙到该地区时，识别变得困难。该物种的分类复杂且经历了相当大的变化。

Anthus spinoletta.extract: The water pipit is a small passerine bird which breeds in the mountains of Southern Europe and the Palearctic eastwards to China. It is a short-distance migrant; many birds move to lower altitudes or wet open lowlands in winter.
Anthus spinoletta.title: Water pipit

zh-CN.title: 水鹨
zh-CN.extract: 水鹨是一种小型雀形目鸟类，繁殖于南欧和古北界东部直至中国的山区。它是短距离迁徙鸟；许多鸟类在冬季迁徙到较低海拔或潮湿的开阔低地。

Anthus sylvanus.extract:
The upland pipit is a species of bird in the family Motacillidae.
It is found in Afghanistan, China, Hong Kong, India, Nepal, and Pakistan. As its name suggests, it inhabits mountains, typically open areas with grassland at elevations above 500m.
Anthus sylvanus.title: Upland pipit

zh-CN.title: 山鹨
zh-CN.extract: 山鹨是鹡鸰科的一种鸟类。分布于阿富汗、中国、香港、印度、尼泊尔和巴基斯坦。顾名思义，它栖息于山区，通常为海拔500米以上的开阔草地。

Anthus trivialis.extract: The tree pipit is a small passerine bird that breeds throughout most of Europe and the Palearctic as far east as the East Siberian Mountains. It is a long-distance migrant, migrating in winter to Africa and southern Asia. The scientific name is from Latin: anthus is the name of a small bird of grasslands, and the specific  trivialis means "common".
Anthus trivialis.title: Tree pipit

zh-CN.title: 林鹨
zh-CN.extract: 林鹨是一种小型雀形目鸟类，繁殖于欧洲大部分地区以及古北界东至东西伯利亚山脉。它是长距离迁徙鸟，冬季迁徙到非洲和南亚。学名源自拉丁语：anthus是草地小鸟的名称，种加词trivialis意为“常见”。

Aphelocoma californica.extract: The California scrub jay is a species of scrub jay native to western North America. It ranges from southern British Columbia throughout California and western Nevada near Reno to west of the Sierra Nevada. The California scrub jay was once lumped with Woodhouse's scrub jay and collectively called the western scrub jay. IUCN and the Handbook of the Birds of the World maintain this lumped taxon. The group was also lumped with the island scrub jay and the Florida scrub jay; the taxon was then called simply scrub jay. The California scrub jay is nonmigratory and can be found in urban areas, where it can become tame and will come to bird feeders. While many refer to scrub jays as "blue jays", the blue jay is a different species of bird entirely.
Aphelocoma californica.title: California scrub jay

zh-CN.title: 加州灌丛鸦
zh-CN.extract: 加州灌丛鸦是一种原产于北美西部的灌丛鸦。分布范围从不列颠哥伦比亚省南部，贯穿加利福尼亚州和西内华达州里诺附近，至内华达山脉以西。加州灌丛鸦曾与伍德豪斯灌丛鸦合并统称为西部灌丛鸦。IUCN和《世界鸟类手册》仍维持这一合并分类。该群体也曾与岛灌丛鸦和佛罗里达灌丛鸦合并；当时该分类单元简称为灌丛鸦。加州灌丛鸦是非迁徙鸟类，常见于城市地区，在那里可以变得温顺并到喂鸟器觅食。虽然许多人称灌丛鸦为“蓝鸦”，但蓝鸦是完全不同的鸟类物种。

Aphelocoma woodhouseii.extract: Woodhouse's scrub jay is a species of scrub jay native to western North America, ranging from southeastern Oregon and southern Idaho to central Mexico. Woodhouse's scrub jay was until recently considered the same species as the California scrub jay, and collectively called the western scrub jay. Prior to that both of them were also considered the same species as the island scrub jay and the Florida scrub jay; the taxon was then called simply the scrub jay. Woodhouse's scrub jay is nonmigratory and can be found in urban areas, where it can become tame and will come to bird feeders. While many refer to scrub jays as "blue jays", the blue jay is a different species of bird entirely. Woodhouse's scrub jay is named for the American naturalist and explorer Samuel Washington Woodhouse.
Aphelocoma woodhouseii.title: Woodhouse's scrub jay

zh-CN.title: 伍德豪斯灌丛鸦
zh-CN.extract: 伍德豪斯灌丛鸦是一种原产于北美西部的灌丛鸦，分布范围从俄勒冈州东南部和爱达荷州南部到墨西哥中部。伍德豪斯灌丛鸦直到最近才被认为与加州灌丛鸦是同一物种，统称为西部灌丛鸦。在此之前，两者也曾与岛灌丛鸦和佛罗里达灌丛鸦被视为同一物种；该分类单元当时简称为灌丛鸦。伍德豪斯灌丛鸦是非迁徙鸟类，常见于城市地区，在那里可以变得温顺并到喂鸟器觅食。虽然许多人称灌丛鸦为“蓝鸦”，但蓝鸦是完全不同的鸟类物种。伍德豪斯灌丛鸦以美国博物学家和探险家塞缪尔·华盛顿·伍德豪斯的名字命名。

Aplonis panayensis.extract: The Asian glossy starling is a species of starling in the family Sturnidae. It is found in Bangladesh, Brunei, India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Singapore, Taiwan (introduced), Cambodia and Thailand. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forest and subtropical or tropical mangrove forest. There is also a huge number of this species inhabiting towns and cities, where they take refuge in abandoned buildings and trees. They often move in large groups and are considered one of the noisiest species of birds. In the Philippines, it is known as kulansiyang, galansiyang, or kuling-dagat.
Aplonis panayensis.title: Asian glossy starling

zh-CN.title: 亚洲辉椋鸟
zh-CN.extract: 亚洲辉椋鸟是椋鸟科的一种鸟类。分布于孟加拉国、文莱、印度、印度尼西亚、马来西亚、缅甸、菲律宾、新加坡、台湾（引入）、柬埔寨和泰国。其自然栖息地为亚热带或热带湿润低地森林和亚热带或热带红树林。也有大量该物种栖息于城镇和城市，它们会在废弃建筑和树木中安身。它们经常大群移动，被认为是噪音最大的鸟类之一。在菲律宾，它被称为kulansiyang、galansiyang或kuling-dagat。

Apus nipalensis.extract: The house swift is a species of swift in the family Apodidae. It is found in Japan, Nepal, and Southeast Asia. It is capable of flying long distances by alternately shutting off hemispheres of its brain in-flight.
Apus nipalensis.title: House swift

zh-CN.title: 家雨燕
zh-CN.extract: 家雨燕是雨燕科的一种雨燕。分布于日本、尼泊尔和东南亚。它能够通过交替关闭大脑半球在飞行中长距离飞翔。

Apus pacificus.extract: The Pacific swift is a species of bird that is part of the Swift family. It breeds in eastern Asia. It is strongly migratory, spending the northern hemisphere's winter in Southeast Asia and Australia. The general shape and blackish plumage recall its relative, the common swift, from which it is distinguished by a white rump band and heavily marked underparts. The sexes are identical in appearance, although young birds can be identified by pale fringes to the wing feathers that are absent in adults. This swift's main call is a screech typical of its family. It is one of a group of closely related Asian swifts formerly regarded as one species.
Apus pacificus.title: Pacific swift

zh-CN.title: 太平洋雨燕
zh-CN.extract: 太平洋雨燕是雨燕科的一种鸟类。它在东亚繁殖，具有强烈的迁徙性，在北半球的冬季前往东南亚和澳大利亚。其整体外形和黑色羽毛让人联想到它的近亲普通雨燕，但可以通过白色的腰部带和带有明显斑点的下体与普通雨燕区分。雌雄外观相同，但幼鸟的翅羽边缘有浅色条纹，而成鸟则没有。这种雨燕的主要叫声是其家族典型的尖叫声。它是曾经被认为是单一物种的一组密切相关的亚洲雨燕之一。

Aquila chrysaetos.extract: The golden eagle is a bird of prey living in the Northern Hemisphere. It is the most widely distributed species of eagle. Like all eagles, it belongs to the family Accipitridae. They are one of the best-known birds of prey in the Northern Hemisphere. These birds are dark brown, with lighter golden-brown plumage on their napes. Immature eagles of this species typically have white on the tail and often have white markings on the wings. Golden eagles use their agility and speed combined with powerful feet and large, sharp talons to hunt a variety of prey, mainly hares, rabbits, and marmots and other ground squirrels.
Aquila chrysaetos.title: Golden eagle

zh-CN.title: 金雕
zh-CN.extract: 金雕是一种生活在北半球的猛禽，是分布最广泛的雕类。与所有雕类一样，它属于鹰科（Accipitridae）。它们是北半球最著名的猛禽之一。这些鸟羽毛深棕色，后颈有较浅的金棕色羽毛。该物种的幼雕通常在尾部有白色，翅膀上也常有白色斑纹。金雕利用敏捷性和速度，结合有力的脚和大型锋利的爪子捕食多种猎物，主要是野兔、兔子、旱獭及其他地松鼠。

Aquila heliaca.extract: The eastern imperial eagle is a large bird of prey that breeds in southeastern Europe and extensively through West and Central Asia. Most populations are migratory and winter in northeastern Africa, the Middle East and South and East Asia. Like all eagles, the eastern imperial eagle is a member of the family Accipitridae. Furthermore, its feathered legs mark it as a member of the subfamily Aquilinae. It is a large, dark-colored eagle, with a resemblance to other members of the genus Aquila, but it is usually the darkest species in its range. It is an opportunistic predator that mostly selects smallish mammals as prey but also a fairly large proportion of birds, reptile and other prey types, including carrion. Compared to other Aquila eagles, it has a strong preference for the interface of tall woods with plains and other open, relatively flat habitats, including the wooded mosaics of the steppe. Normally, nests are located in large, mature trees and the parents raise around one or two fledglings. The global population is small and declining due to persecution, loss of habitat and prey. It has therefore been IUCN Red Listed as Vulnerable since 1994.
Aquila heliaca.title: Eastern imperial eagle

zh-CN.title: 白肩雕
zh-CN.extract: 白肩雕是一种大型猛禽，繁殖于欧洲东南部以及西亚和中亚的广大地区。大多数种群为迁徙性，在东北非洲、中东、南亚和东亚越冬。与所有雕类一样，白肩雕是鹰科（Accipitridae）的成员。此外，其腿部覆盖羽毛表明它属于雕亚科（Aquilinae）。它是一种大型深色雕，与其他雕属（Aquila）成员相似，但通常是其分布区内颜色最深的物种。它是一种机会主义捕食者，主要选择小型哺乳动物作为猎物，但也捕食较大比例的鸟类、爬行动物和其他猎物类型，包括腐肉。与其他雕属雕类相比，它更偏好高大树林与平原及其他开阔、相对平坦的栖息地交界处，包括草原的林地镶嵌景观。通常巢筑于大型成熟树木上，亲鸟养育约一至两羽雏鸟。全球种群数量较小且因迫害、栖息地和猎物丧失而减少，因此自1994年起被世界自然保护联盟（IUCN）红色名录列为易危（Vulnerable）。

Archilochus alexandri.extract: The black-chinned hummingbird is a hummingbird occupying a broad range of habitats. Its summer range is in the western United States and southwestern Canada. It is migratory, wintering as far south as Mexico. In sunlight, the iridescent purple gorget of the males is noticeable.
Archilochus alexandri.title: Black-chinned hummingbird

zh-CN.title: 黑颏蜂鸟
zh-CN.extract: 黑颏蜂鸟是一种栖息于广泛生境的蜂鸟。其夏季分布范围在美国西部和加拿大西南部。它是迁徙性鸟类，最南可至墨西哥越冬。在阳光下，雄鸟虹彩紫色的喉部明显可见。

Ardea alba.extract: The great egret, also known as the common egret, large egret, great white egret, or great white heron, is a large, widely distributed egret. The four subspecies are found in Asia, Africa, the Americas, and southern Europe. Recently, it has also been spreading to more northern areas of Europe. Distributed across most of the tropical and warmer temperate regions of the world, it builds tree nests in colonies close to water.
Ardea alba.title: Great egret

zh-CN.title: 大白鹭
zh-CN.extract: 大白鹭，也称普通鹭、大鹭、大白鹭或大白鹭，是一种大型且分布广泛的白鹭。四个亚种分布于亚洲、非洲、美洲和南欧。最近，它也开始扩散到欧洲更北部的地区。它遍布世界大部分热带和温暖温带区域，在靠近水边的树上群居筑巢。

Ardea cinerea.extract: The grey heron is a long-legged wading bird of the heron family, Ardeidae, native throughout temperate Europe and Asia, and also parts of Africa. It is resident in much of its range, but some populations from the more northern parts migrate southwards in autumn. A bird of wetland areas, it can be seen around lakes, rivers, ponds, marshes and on the sea coast. It feeds mostly on aquatic creatures which it catches after standing stationary beside or in the water, or stalking its prey through the shallows.
Ardea cinerea.title: Grey heron

zh-CN.title: 苍鹭
zh-CN.extract: 苍鹭是鹭科（Ardeidae）的一种长腿涉禽，原产于温带欧洲和亚洲的大部分地区，以及非洲的部分地区。在其大部分分布区内为留鸟，但一些来自较北部地区的种群会在秋季向南迁徙。它是湿地鸟类，可见于湖泊、河流、池塘、沼泽和海岸附近。它以水生生物为食，常在水中或水边静止站立，或在水浅处潜行捕食。

Ardea herodias.extract: The great blue heron is a large wading bird in the heron family (Ardeidae), common near shores of open water and wetlands over most of North and Central America, as well as Northwestern South America, the Caribbean, and the Galápagos Islands. It is occasionally found in the Azores and is a rare vagrant to Europe. An all-white population found in South Florida and the Florida Keys is known as the great white heron. Debate exists about whether these white birds are a color morph of the great blue heron, a subspecies of it, or an entirely separate species.
Ardea herodias.title: Great blue heron

zh-CN.title: 大蓝鹭
zh-CN.extract: 大蓝鹭是鹭科（Ardeidae）的一种大型涉禽，常见于北美和中美洲大部分地区、南美洲西北部、加勒比海和加拉帕戈斯群岛的开阔水域和湿地沿岸。偶尔在亚速尔群岛发现，也是欧洲的稀有迷鸟。在南佛罗里达和佛罗里达群岛发现的一种全白色种群被称为大白鹭。关于这些白色鸟类是大蓝鹭的色型、亚种还是完全独立的物种存在争议。

Ardea intermedia.extract: The medium egret, median egret, smaller egret or intermediate egret, is a medium-sized heron. Some taxonomists put the species in the genus Egretta or Mesophoyx. It is a resident breeder in southern and eastern Asia.
Ardea intermedia.title: Medium egret

zh-CN.title: 中白鹭
zh-CN.extract: 中白鹭，也被称为中型鹭、小鹭或中间鹭，是一种中型鹭。一些分类学家将其归入白鹭属（Egretta）或中鹭属（Mesophoyx）。它是南亚和东亚的留鸟繁殖鸟。

Ardea purpurea.extract:
The purple heron is a wide-ranging heron species. It breeds in Africa, central and southern Europe, and southern and eastern Palearctic. The Western Palearctic populations migrate between breeding and wintering habitats whereas the African and tropical-Asian populations are primarily sedentary, except for occasional dispersive movements.
It is similar in appearance to the more common grey heron but is slightly smaller, more slender and has darker plumage. It is also a more evasive bird, favouring densely vegetated habitats near water, particularly reed beds. It hunts for a range of prey including fish, rodents, frogs and insects, either stalking them or standing waiting in ambush.
Ardea purpurea.title: Purple heron

zh-CN.title: 紫鹭
zh-CN.extract:
紫鹭是一种分布广泛的鹭科鸟类。它在非洲、中欧和南欧以及古北界南部和东部繁殖。西古北界的种群在繁殖地和越冬地之间迁徙，而非洲和热带亚洲的种群主要是留鸟，除了偶尔的扩散性移动。
它的外观与更常见的苍鹭相似，但体型稍小，更纤细，羽毛颜色更深。它也是一种更隐秘的鸟类，喜欢靠近水域的植被茂密栖息地，尤其是芦苇床。它捕食多种猎物，包括鱼、啮齿动物、青蛙和昆虫，要么追踪猎物，要么站立等待伏击。

Ardenna tenuirostris.extract: The short-tailed shearwater or slender-billed shearwater, also called yolla or moonbird, and commonly known as the muttonbird both in early Australia and in New Zealand, is the most abundant seabird species in Australian waters, and is one of the few Australian native birds in which the chicks are commercially harvested. It is a migratory species that breeds mainly on small islands in Bass Strait and Tasmania and migrates to the Northern Hemisphere for the boreal summer.
Ardenna tenuirostris.title: Short-tailed shearwater

zh-CN.title: 短尾鹱
zh-CN.extract: 短尾鹱，又称细嘴鹱、yolla或moonbird，在早期澳大利亚和新西兰通常被称为羊肉鸟，是澳大利亚水域中最丰富的海鸟物种，也是少数商业化收获雏鸟的澳大利亚本土鸟类之一。它是一种迁徙物种，主要在巴斯海峡和塔斯马尼亚的小岛上繁殖，并迁徙到北半球度过北半球的夏季。

Ardeola bacchus.extract:
The Chinese pond heron is an East Asian freshwater bird of the heron family, (Ardeidae).
It is one of six species of birds known as "pond herons". It is parapatric with the Indian pond heron to the west and the Javan pond heron to the south, and these three are presumed to form a superspecies. As a group they are variously affiliated with the squacco heron or the Malagasy pond heron. As of mid-2011 there are no published molecular analyses of pond heron interrelationships and osteological data is likewise not analyzed for all relevant comparison taxa.
Ardeola bacchus.title: Chinese pond heron

zh-CN.title: 中国池鹭
zh-CN.extract:
中国池鹭是鹭科（Ardeidae）的一种东亚淡水鸟类。
它是六种被称为“池鹭”的鸟类之一。它与西部的印度池鹭和南部的爪哇池鹭呈邻域分布，这三种被认为形成一个超种。作为一个群体，它们与白翅黄池鹭或马岛池鹭有不同的亲缘关系。截至2011年中，尚无已发表的关于池鹭相互关系的分子分析，骨学数据也未针对所有相关比较分类群进行分析。

Arenaria interpres.extract: The ruddy turnstone is a small cosmopolitan wading bird, one of two species of turnstone in the genus Arenaria.
Arenaria interpres.title: Ruddy turnstone

zh-CN.title: 翻石鹬
zh-CN.extract: 翻石鹬是一种小型的世界性涉禽，是翻石鹬属（Arenaria）的两种鸟类之一。

Artamus fuscus.extract: The ashy woodswallow, sometimes also called the ashy swallow-shrike, is a woodswallow which is found in south Asia. Like other woodswallows, it has a short curved bill, a short square tail and long wings. It is usually seen perched in groups, high on powerlines, tall bare trees and most often in areas with a predominance of tall palm trees.
Artamus fuscus.title: Ashy woodswallow

zh-CN.title: 灰燕鵙
zh-CN.extract: 灰燕鵙，有时也称为灰燕伯劳，是一种分布于南亚的燕鵙科鸟类。与其他燕鵙一样，它有一个短而弯曲的喙，短而方的尾羽和长翅膀。通常能看到它们成群栖息在高处的电线上、高大的裸树上，最常见于高大的棕榈树占主导的地区。

Artemisiospiza belli.extract: Bell's sparrow is a species of bird in the family Passerellidae, the New World sparrows. It is found in Mexico and the United States.
Artemisiospiza belli.title: Bell's sparrow

zh-CN.title: 贝尔氏雀
zh-CN.extract: 贝尔氏雀是雀科（Passerellidae，新世界雀鸟）的一种鸟类。它分布于墨西哥和美国。

Arundinax aedon.extract: The thick-billed warbler breeds in the temperate east Palearctic, from south Siberia to west Mongolia. It is migratory, wintering in tropical South Asia and South-east Asia. It is a very rare vagrant to western Europe.
Arundinax aedon.title: Thick-billed warbler

zh-CN.title: 厚嘴苇莺
zh-CN.extract: 厚嘴苇莺在温带东古北界繁殖，从西伯利亚南部到蒙古西部。它是候鸟，在热带南亚和东南亚越冬。它在西欧是非常罕见的迷鸟。

Asio flammeus.extract: The short-eared owl is a widespread grassland species in the family Strigidae. Owls belonging to genus Asio are known as the eared owls, as they have tufts of feathers resembling mammalian ears. These "ear" tufts may or may not be visible. The short-eared owl will display its tufts when in a defensive pose, although its very short tufts are usually not visible. The short-eared owl is found in open country and grasslands.
Asio flammeus.title: Short-eared owl

zh-CN.title: 短耳鸮
zh-CN.extract: 短耳鸮是鸱鸮科（Strigidae）中一种广泛分布的草地物种。属于耳鸮属（Asio）的鸮类被称为耳鸮，因为它们有类似哺乳动物耳朵的羽毛簇。这些“耳”簇可能可见也可能不可见。短耳鸮在防御姿态时会展示其耳簇，尽管其非常短的耳簇通常不可见。短耳鸮常见于开阔地带和草原。

Asio otus.extract: The long-eared owl, also known as the northern long-eared owl or, more informally, as the lesser horned owl or cat owl, is a medium-sized species of owl with an extensive breeding range. The genus name, Asio, is Latin for "horned owl", and the specific epithet, otus, is derived from Greek and refers to a small eared owl. The species breeds in many areas through Europe and the Palearctic, as well as in North America. This species is a part of the larger grouping of owls known as typical owls, of the family Strigidae, which contains most extant species of owl.
Asio otus.title: Long-eared owl

zh-CN.title: 长耳鸮
zh-CN.extract: 长耳鸮，又称北方长耳鸮或非正式地称为小角鸮或猫鸮，是一种中等体型的猫头鹰，繁殖范围广泛。属名Asio在拉丁语中意为“角鸮”，种加词otus源自古希腊语，指一种小耳鸮。该物种在欧洲、古北区以及北美许多地区繁殖。它是更大的鸱鸮科典型猫头鹰群体的一部分，该科包含大多数现存猫头鹰物种。

Athene cunicularia.extract: The burrowing owl is a small, long-legged, primarily terrestrial—though not flightless—species of owl native to the open landscapes of North and South America. They are typically found in grasslands, rangelands, agricultural areas, deserts, or any other open, dry area with low vegetation. They nest and roost in burrows, and, despite their common name, do not often construct these dwellings themselves, rather repurposing disused burrows or tunnels previously excavated and inhabited by other species, such as American badgers, foxes, ground squirrels or prairie dogs, among others.
Athene cunicularia.title: Burrowing owl

zh-CN.title: 穴鸮
zh-CN.extract: 穴鸮是一种小型、长腿、主要陆生（但并非不会飞）的猫头鹰，原产于北美和南美的开阔景观。它们通常出现在草原、牧场、农业区、沙漠或任何其他低植被的开阔干燥区域。它们在洞穴中筑巢和栖息，尽管有俗称，它们通常不自己建造这些住所，而是重新利用其他物种（如美洲獾、狐狸、地松鼠或草原犬鼠等）先前挖掘和居住的废弃洞穴或隧道。

Aviceda jerdoni.extract: Jerdon's baza is a moderate sized brown hawk with a thin white-tipped black crest usually held erect. It is found in South-east Asia. It inhabits foothills in the terai and is rarer in evergreen forests and tea estates.
Aviceda jerdoni.title: Jerdon's baza

zh-CN.title: 褐冠鹃隼
zh-CN.extract: 褐冠鹃隼是一种中等体型的褐色鹰，具有细长、尖端白色的黑色冠羽，通常保持直立。分布于东南亚。栖息于特莱地区的山麓，在常绿森林和茶园中较罕见。

Aviceda leuphotes.extract: The black baza is a small bird of prey found in the forests of Northeast India, the eastern Himalayas, China and Southeast Asia. Many populations are migratory, including those in the Indian region, which winter in the south of the Peninsula and Sri Lanka. Black bazas have short, stout legs and feet with strong talons, and a prominent crest. They are found in dense forest, often in small groups, and can often be found perched on bare branches of tall trees rising above the forest canopy.
Aviceda leuphotes.title: Black baza

zh-CN.title: 黑冠鹃隼
zh-CN.extract: 黑冠鹃隼是一种小型猛禽，分布于印度东北部、东喜马拉雅、中国和东南亚的森林中。许多种群具有迁徙性，包括印度地区的种群，它们在半岛南部和斯里兰卡越冬。黑冠鹃隼有短而粗壮的腿和脚，强壮的爪子，以及显著的冠羽。它们生活在密林中，常以小群活动，经常栖息在森林冠层上方高大树木的裸露枝干上。

Aythya affinis.extract: The lesser scaup is a small North American diving duck that migrates south as far as Central America in winter. It is colloquially known as the little bluebill or broadbill because of its distinctive blue bill. The origin of the name scaup may stem from the bird's preference for feeding on scalp—the Scottish word for clams, oysters, and mussels; however, some credit it to the female's discordant scaup call as the name's source. It is apparently a very close relative of the Holarctic greater scaup or "bluebill", with which it forms a superspecies. The scientific name is derived from Ancient Greek and Latin, with aithuia being an Ancient Greek term for an unidentified seabird, used by Hesychius and Aristotle, among other authors, and affinis, Latin for "related to", from the lesser scaup's resemblance to the greater scaup.
Aythya affinis.title: Lesser scaup

zh-CN.title: 小潜鸭
zh-CN.extract: 小潜鸭是一种小型北美潜水鸭，冬季向南迁徙至中美洲。它俗称小蓝嘴鸭或宽嘴鸭，因其独特的蓝色喙。名称scaup可能源于该鸟偏好以scalp为食——苏格兰语中蛤蜊、牡蛎和贻贝的称呼；然而，有些人认为其来源是雌鸟不和谐的scaup叫声。它显然是全北区的斑背潜鸭或“蓝嘴鸭”的近亲，与其形成超种。学名源自古希腊语和拉丁语，aithuia是古希腊语中一种未识别的海鸟（赫西基奥斯和亚里士多德等人使用过），affinis在拉丁语中意为“相关的”，源于小潜鸭与斑背潜鸭的相似性。

Aythya americana.extract: The redhead is a medium-sized diving duck. The scientific name is derived from Greek aithuia, an unidentified seabird mentioned by authors including Hesychius and Aristotle, and Latin americana, of America. The redhead is 40–56 cm (16–22 in) long with an 74–84 cm (29–33 in) wingspan; the weight ranges from 1,030–1,080 g (36–38 oz), with males weighing an average of 1,080 g (38 oz) and females an average of 1,030 g (36 oz). It belongs to the genus Aythya, together with 11 other described species. The redhead and the common pochard form a sister group which together is sister to the canvasback. This waterfowl is easily distinguished from most other ducks by the male's copper colored head and pale blue bill during the breeding season; from its close relative canvasback it is distinguished by the more rounded head, shorter bill, and yellow, not red, eye. The Eurasian common pochard is even more similar, but very rarely overlaps in range; it also differs in having a red eye, and a more acute, less rounded head shape.
Aythya americana.title: Redhead (bird)

zh-CN.title: 美洲潜鸭
zh-CN.extract: 美洲潜鸭是一种中等体型的潜水鸭。学名源自希腊语aithuia（一种未识别的海鸟，赫西基奥斯和亚里士多德等人提及）和拉丁语americana（美洲的）。美洲潜鸭体长40–56厘米，翼展74–84厘米；体重范围为1030–1080克，雄性平均1080克，雌性平均1030克。它属于潜鸭属，另有11个已描述的物种。美洲潜鸭和普通潜鸭组成姐妹群，后者与帆背潜鸭相邻。这种水禽在繁殖季节很容易与大多数其他鸭类区分，雄鸟有铜色头部和淡蓝色喙；与其近亲帆背潜鸭的区别在于更圆的头、更短的喙以及黄色（而非红色）的眼睛。欧亚的普通潜鸭甚至更相似，但分布重叠极少；其区别还在于红色眼睛以及更尖锐、不那么圆的头型。

Aythya collaris.extract: The ring-necked duck is a diving duck from North America commonly found in freshwater ponds and lakes. The scientific name is derived from Greek aithuia, an unidentified seabird mentioned by authors including Hesychius and Aristotle, and Latin collaris, "of the neck" from collum, "neck".
Aythya collaris.title: Ring-necked duck

zh-CN.title: 环颈潜鸭
zh-CN.extract: 环颈潜鸭是一种来自北美的潜水鸭，常见于淡水池塘和湖泊。学名源自希腊语aithuia（一种未识别的海鸟，赫西基奥斯和亚里士多德等人提及）和拉丁语collaris“颈的”（来自collum“颈”）。

Aythya ferina.extract: The common pochard, known simply as pochard in the United Kingdom, is a medium-sized diving duck in the family Anatidae. It is widespread across the Palearctic. It breeds primarily in the steppe regions of Scandinavia and Siberia, and winters farther south and west.
Aythya ferina.title: Common pochard

zh-CN.title: 普通潜鸭
zh-CN.extract: 普通潜鸭，在英国简称为潜鸭，是一种中等体型的潜水鸭，属于鸭科。它广泛分布于古北区。主要在斯堪的纳维亚和西伯利亚的草原地区繁殖，冬季向南和向西迁徙。

Aythya fuligula.extract: The tufted duck is a small diving duck with a population of nearly one million birds, found in northern Eurasia. They are partially migratory. The scientific name is derived from Ancient Greek aithuia, an unidentified seabird mentioned by authors such as Hesychius and Aristotle, and Latin fuligo 'soot' and gula 'throat'. It is a game bird.
Aythya fuligula.title: Tufted duck

zh-CN.title: 凤头潜鸭
zh-CN.extract: 凤头潜鸭是一种小型潜水鸭，数量近百万只，分布于欧亚大陆北部。它们部分迁徙。学名源自古希腊语aithuia（一种未明海鸟，赫西基奥斯和亚里士多德等作者提及）和拉丁语fuligo（煤烟）及gula（喉咙）。它是一种猎禽。

Aythya marila.extract: The greater scaup, just scaup in Europe or, colloquially, "bluebill" in North America, is a mid-sized diving duck, larger than the closely related lesser scaup and tufted duck. It spends the summer months breeding in Iceland, east across Scandinavia, northern Russia and Siberia, Alaska, and northern Canada. During the winter, it migrates south to the coasts of Europe, eastern Asia, and North America.
Aythya marila.title: Greater scaup

zh-CN.title: 斑背潜鸭
zh-CN.extract: 斑背潜鸭，在欧洲简称潜鸭，在北美俗称“蓝嘴鸭”，是一种中型潜水鸭，比近亲的小潜鸭和凤头潜鸭体型更大。夏季在冰岛、斯堪的纳维亚半岛东部、俄罗斯北部和西伯利亚、阿拉斯加以及加拿大北部繁殖。冬季南迁至欧洲、东亚和北美沿海地区。

Aythya nyroca.extract: The ferruginous duck, also known as the ferruginous pochard, common white-eye or white-eyed pochard, is a medium-sized diving duck native to the Palearctic. The scientific name is derived from the Ancient Greek word, αἴθυιᾰ, an unknown seabird mentioned by authors including Hesychius and Aristotle, and the Russian word, нырок, the Russian word for pochard, which occurs in the bird's Russian common name.
Aythya nyroca.title: Ferruginous duck

zh-CN.title: 白眼潜鸭
zh-CN.extract: 白眼潜鸭，也称白眼睛潜鸭或白眼鸭，是一种中型潜水鸭，原产于古北界。学名源自古希腊语αίθυια（一种未知海鸟，赫西基奥斯和亚里士多德等作者提及）以及俄语нырок（潜鸭的俄语名称，出现在该鸟的俄语俗名中）。

Aythya valisineria.extract: The canvasback is a species of diving duck, the largest found in North America.
Aythya valisineria.title: Canvasback

zh-CN.title: 帆背潜鸭
zh-CN.extract: 帆背潜鸭是一种潜水鸭，是北美体型最大的潜水鸭。

Baeolophus inornatus.extract: The oak titmouse is a passerine bird in the tit family Paridae. The American Ornithologists' Union split the plain titmouse into the oak titmouse and the juniper titmouse in 1996, due to distinct differences in song, preferred habitat, and genetic makeup.
Baeolophus inornatus.title: Oak titmouse

zh-CN.title: 纯色冠山雀
zh-CN.extract: 纯色冠山雀是山雀科山雀属的雀形目鸟类。美国鸟类学家联盟于1996年将纯色山雀分为纯色冠山雀和杜松冠山雀，原因是它们在鸣声、栖息地偏好和基因构成上存在明显差异。

Bambusicola thoracicus.extract: The Chinese bamboo partridge is a small Galliform bird. It is one of three species in the genus Bambusicola, along with the mountain bamboo partridge of the Himalayas, and the Taiwan bamboo partridge of Taiwan. Chinese bamboo partridge is a monotypic species.
Bambusicola thoracicus.title: Chinese bamboo partridge

zh-CN.title: 灰胸竹鸡
zh-CN.extract: 灰胸竹鸡是一种小型鸡形目鸟类。它是竹鸡属三个物种之一，其他两种是喜马拉雅山的棕胸竹鸡和台湾的台湾竹鸡。灰胸竹鸡是单型种。

Blythipicus pyrrhotis.extract: The bay woodpecker is a species of bird in the family Picidae.
Blythipicus pyrrhotis.title: Bay woodpecker

zh-CN.title: 赤胸拟啄木鸟
zh-CN.extract: 赤胸拟啄木鸟是啄木鸟科的一种鸟类。

Bombycilla cedrorum.extract: The cedar waxwing is a member of the family Bombycillidae or waxwing family of passerine birds. It is a medium-sized bird that is mainly brown, gray, and yellow. Some of the wing feathers have red tips which resemble sealing wax, giving these birds their common name. It is a native of North and Central America, breeding in open wooded areas in southern Canada and wintering in the southern half of the United States, Central America, and the far northwest of South America. Its diet includes cedar cones, fruit, holly berries, and insects. The cedar waxwing is listed as least concern on the IUCN Red List.
Bombycilla cedrorum.title: Cedar waxwing

zh-CN.title: 雪松太平鸟
zh-CN.extract: 雪松太平鸟是太平鸟科太平鸟属的雀形目鸟类。它是一种中型鸟类，主要呈棕色、灰色和黄色。一些翅羽有红色尖端，类似封蜡，因此得名。原产于北美和中美洲，在加拿大南部开阔林地繁殖，冬季在美国南部、中美洲和南美洲最西北部越冬。食物包括雪松球果、水果、冬青浆果和昆虫。雪松太平鸟被列为世界自然保护联盟红色名录中的无危物种。

Bombycilla garrulus.extract: The Bohemian waxwing is a starling-sized passerine bird that breeds in the northern forests of the Palearctic and North America. It has mainly buff-grey plumage, black face markings and a pointed crest. Its wings are patterned with white and bright yellow, and some of the wing feathers have red tips, the resemblance of which to sealing wax gives these birds their common name. The two or three subspecies show only minor differences in appearance. Females are similar to males, although young birds are less well-marked and have few or no waxy wingtips. Although the Bohemian waxwing's range overlaps those of the cedar and Japanese waxwings, it is easily distinguished from them by size and plumage differences.
Bombycilla garrulus.title: Bohemian waxwing

zh-CN.title: 太平鸟
zh-CN.extract: 太平鸟是一种体型与椋鸟相当的雀形目鸟类，繁殖于古北界和北美洲的北方森林。它主要呈灰褐色羽毛，面部有黑色斑纹，头顶具尖状羽冠。翅膀上有白色和亮黄色的斑纹，部分飞羽尖端呈红色，形似封蜡，因此得名。两个或三个亚种在外观上只有微小差异。雌鸟与雄鸟相似，但幼鸟的斑纹不太明显，且几乎没有或完全没有蜡质翼尖。尽管太平鸟的分布区与雪松太平鸟和日本太平鸟重叠，但通过体型和羽毛差异很容易区分。

Bombycilla japonica.extract: The Japanese waxwing is a fairly small passerine bird in the waxwing family found in the eastern Palaearctic, where it breeds south of the breeding range of the related Bohemian waxwing, but overlaps extensively with it in winter. It feeds mainly on fruit and berries but also eats insects during the summer. The nest is a cup of twigs lined with grass and moss which is built in a tree. In males, the secondary wing feathers have red tips, the resemblance of which to sealing wax gives these birds their common name. It is listed by IUCN as Near Threatened, due to loss and degradation of its preferred forest habitat.
Bombycilla japonica.title: Japanese waxwing

zh-CN.title: 小太平鸟
zh-CN.extract: 小太平鸟是太平鸟科中一种相当小的雀形目鸟类，分布于东古北界，繁殖于近缘种太平鸟繁殖区的南侧，但冬季与后者大面积重叠。它主要以水果和浆果为食，夏季也吃昆虫。巢由树枝构成杯状，内衬草和苔藓，筑于树上。雄鸟的次级飞羽尖端呈红色，形似封蜡，因此得名。由于偏好森林栖息地的丧失和退化，它被世界自然保护联盟列为近危物种。

Botaurus stellaris.extract: The Eurasian bittern or great bittern is a wading bird in the bittern subfamily (Botaurinae) of the heron family Ardeidae. There are two subspecies, the northern race breeding in parts of Europe and across the Palearctic, as well as on the northern coast of Africa, while the southern race is endemic to parts of southern Africa. It is a secretive bird, seldom seen in the open as it prefers to skulk in reed beds and thick vegetation near water bodies. Its presence is apparent in the spring, when the booming call of the male during the breeding season can be heard. It feeds on fish, small mammals, fledgling birds, amphibians, crustaceans and insects.
Botaurus stellaris.title: Eurasian bittern

zh-CN.title: 大麻鳽
zh-CN.extract: 大麻鳽（又称巨麻鳽）是鹭科麻鳽亚科的一种涉禽。有两个亚种：北方种群繁殖于欧洲、古北界部分地区以及非洲北部沿海，而南方亚种特有于非洲南部部分地区。它是一种隐蔽的鸟类，很少在开阔地带出现，更喜欢潜伏在水体附近的芦苇床和茂密植被中。春季繁殖期，雄鸟发出的低沉鸣叫声可被察觉。它以鱼类、小型哺乳动物、雏鸟、两栖动物、甲壳类和昆虫为食。

Brachypteryx leucophris.extract: The lesser shortwing is a species of chat. This species is now classified in the family Muscicapidae.
Brachypteryx leucophris.title: Lesser shortwing

zh-CN.title: 白眉短翅鸫
zh-CN.extract: 白眉短翅鸫是一种鸲类。该物种目前被归类于鹟科。

Branta bernicla.extract: The brant or brent goose is a small goose of the genus Branta. There are three subspecies, all of which winter along temperate-zone sea-coasts and breed on the high-Arctic tundra.
Branta bernicla.title: Brant (goose)

zh-CN.title: 黑雁
zh-CN.extract: 黑雁（又称藤壶雁）是黑雁属的一种小型雁。有三个亚种，均在温带沿海地区越冬，并在高北极冻原繁殖。

Branta canadensis.extract: The Canada goose is a large species of goose with a black head and neck, white cheeks, white under its chin, and a brown body. It is native to the Arctic and temperate regions of North America, and it is occasionally found during migration across the Atlantic in northern Europe. It has been introduced to France, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Scandinavia, New Zealand, Japan, Chile, Argentina, and the Falkland Islands. Like most geese, the Canada goose is primarily herbivorous and normally migratory; often found on or close to fresh water, the Canada goose is also common in brackish marshes, estuaries, and lagoons.
Branta canadensis.title: Canada goose

zh-CN.title: 加拿大雁
zh-CN.extract: 加拿大雁是一种大型雁类，头颈黑色，脸颊白色，下巴下方白色，身体棕色。它原产于北美洲的北极和温带地区，偶尔在迁徙时穿越北大西洋到达北欧。它已被引入法国、英国、爱尔兰、斯堪的纳维亚、新西兰、日本、智利、阿根廷和福克兰群岛。与大多数雁类一样，加拿大雁主要是草食性且通常迁徙；常见于淡水或其附近，也常见于半咸水沼泽、河口和泻湖。

Bubo bubo.extract: The Eurasian eagle-owl is a species of eagle-owl, a type of bird that resides much over Eurasia. It is often just called the eagle-owl in Europe and Asia.
Bubo bubo.title: Eurasian eagle-owl

zh-CN.title: 雕鸮
zh-CN.extract: 雕鸮是雕鸮属的一种，一种广泛分布于欧亚大陆的鸟类。在欧洲和亚洲，它通常直接被称为雕鸮。

Bubo virginianus.extract: The great horned owl, also known as the tiger owl or the hoot owl, is a large owl native to the Americas. It is an extremely adaptable bird with a vast range and is the most widely distributed true owl in the Americas. Its diet consists primarily of rabbits and hares, rats and mice, and voles; it remains one of the few regular predators of skunk. Hunting also includes rodents, larger mid-sized mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, and invertebrates.
Bubo virginianus.title: Great horned owl

zh-CN.title: 大角鸮
zh-CN.extract: 大角鸮，又称虎鸮或鸣角鸮，是一种原产于美洲的大型鸮类。它是一种适应力极强的鸟类，分布范围广阔，是美洲分布最广的真鸮。其食物主要包括兔类、野兔、大鼠、小鼠和田鼠；它也是少数能定期捕食臭鼬的捕食者之一。捕猎对象还包括啮齿动物、较大的中型哺乳动物、鸟类、爬行动物、两栖动物和无脊椎动物。

Bubulcus ibis.extract: The western cattle egret is a species of heron found in the tropics, subtropics and warm temperate zones. Formerly, most taxonomic authorities lumped this species and the eastern cattle egret together, but the two cattle egrets are now treated as separate species. Despite the similarities in plumage to the egrets of the genus Egretta, it is more closely related to the herons of Ardea. Originally native to parts of Africa, southwest Asia and southern Europe, it has undergone a rapid expansion in its distribution and successfully colonised much of the New World in the last century.
Bubulcus ibis.title: Western cattle egret

zh-CN.title: 西方牛背鹭
zh-CN.extract: 西方牛背鹭是一种鹭科鸟类，分布于热带、亚热带和暖温带地区。此前，大多数分类学权威将本种与东方牛背鹭合并，但现在两种牛背鹭被视为独立物种。尽管其羽毛与白鹭属（Egretta）的鹭类相似，但它与鹭属（Ardea）的苍鹭亲缘关系更近。原产于非洲部分地区、西南亚和南欧，上世纪其分布范围迅速扩大，并成功殖民新世界的大部分地区。

Bucephala albeola.extract: The bufflehead is a small sea duck of the genus Bucephala, the goldeneyes. It breeds in Alaska and Canada and migrates in winter to southern North America. This species was first described by Carl Linnaeus in his landmark 1758 10th edition of Systema Naturae as Anas albeola.
Bucephala albeola.title: Bufflehead

zh-CN.title: 白枕鹊鸭
zh-CN.extract: 白枕鹊鸭是鹊鸭属（Bucephala）的一种小型海鸭，该属包括金眼鸭。它在阿拉斯加和加拿大繁殖，冬季迁徙至北美南部。该物种由卡尔·林奈在其1758年具有里程碑意义的《自然系统》第十版中首次描述，命名为Anas albeola。

Bucephala clangula.extract: The common goldeneye or simply goldeneye is a medium-sized sea duck of the genus Bucephala, the goldeneyes. Its closest relative is the similar Barrow's goldeneye. The genus name is derived from the Ancient Greek boukephalos, a reference to the bulbous head shape of the bufflehead. The species name is derived from the Latin clangere.
Bucephala clangula.title: Common goldeneye

zh-CN.title: 鹊鸭
zh-CN.extract: 鹊鸭或称普通金眼鸭，是鹊鸭属（Bucephala）的一种中型海鸭，该属包括金眼鸭。其近亲是相似的巴氏鹊鸭。属名来源于古希腊语boukephalos，指白枕鹊鸭的球状头部形状。种名来源于拉丁语clangere。

Bulweria bulwerii.extract: Bulwer's petrel is a small petrel in the family Procellariidae that is found in tropical and subtropical regions of the Atlantic, Indian and Pacific Oceans. It is named after the English naturalist James Bulwer.
Bulweria bulwerii.title: Bulwer's petrel

zh-CN.title: 布尔氏鹱
zh-CN.extract: 布尔氏鹱是鹱科（Procellariidae）的一种小型鹱，分布于大西洋、印度洋和太平洋的热带及亚热带地区。它得名于英国博物学家詹姆斯·布尔沃。

Butastur indicus.extract: The grey-faced buzzard is an Asian bird of prey. It is typically 41–46 cm (16–18 in) in length, making it a small-sized raptor. It breeds in Manchuria, Korea and Japan; it winters in South-east Asia.
Butastur indicus.title: Grey-faced buzzard

zh-CN.title: 灰脸鵟鹰
zh-CN.extract: 灰脸鵟鹰是一种亚洲猛禽。体长通常为41–46厘米（16–18英寸），属于小型猛禽。繁殖于满洲、韩国和日本；冬季迁徙至东南亚。

Buteo jamaicensis.extract: The red-tailed hawk is a bird of prey and one of the most common hawks in North America. In the United States, it is one of three species colloquially known as the "chickenhawk". The red-tailed hawk breeds throughout most of the continent, from western Alaska and northern Canada to as far south as Panama and the West Indies. The red-tailed hawk occupies a wide range of habitats and altitudes, including deserts, grasslands, coniferous and deciduous forests, agricultural fields, and urban areas. It is absent in areas of unbroken forest and in the high arctic. It is legally protected in Canada, Mexico, and the United States by the Migratory Bird Treaty.
Buteo jamaicensis.title: Red-tailed hawk

zh-CN.title: 红尾鵟
zh-CN.extract: 红尾鵟是一种猛禽，也是北美最常见的鵟之一。在美国，它是俗称“鸡鹰”的三种物种之一。红尾鵟在北美大陆大部分地区繁殖，从阿拉斯加西部和加拿大北部一直延伸到巴拿马和西印度群岛。它栖息于多种环境和海拔，包括沙漠、草原、针叶林和落叶林、农田以及城市区域。在没有断层的森林和高北极地区则没有分布。它受到加拿大、墨西哥和美国《候鸟保护条约》的法律保护。

Buteo japonicus.extract: The eastern buzzard or Japanese buzzard is a medium to large bird of prey that is sometimes considered a subspecies of the widespread common buzzard. Some scientists treated is as a distinct species starting in 2008, but others still treat it as either one or three subspecies. It is native to East Asia and some parts of Russia and South Asia, with some birds wintering in Southeast Asia. It is similar to the steppe buzzard. It is carnivorous.
Buteo japonicus.title: Eastern buzzard

zh-CN.title: 东方鵟
zh-CN.extract: 东方鵟（或称日本鵟）是一种中大型猛禽，有时被视为广泛分布的普通鵟的一个亚种。自2008年起，一些科学家将其视为独立物种，但其他人仍将其视为一个或三个亚种。它原产于东亚及俄罗斯和南亚的部分地区，部分鸟类在东南亚越冬。它与草原鵟相似。为肉食性。

Buteo lagopus.extract: The rough-legged buzzard (Europe) or rough-legged hawk is a medium-large bird of prey. It is found in arctic and subarctic regions of North America, Europe, and Asia during the breeding season, and migrates south for the winter. Historically, it was also known as "rough-legged falcon" in such works as John James Audubon's The Birds of America.
Buteo lagopus.title: Rough-legged buzzard

zh-CN.title: 毛脚鵟
zh-CN.extract: 毛脚鵟（在欧洲称rough-legged buzzard）是一种中大型猛禽。繁殖季节分布于北美洲、欧洲和亚洲的北极及亚北极地区，冬季向南迁徙。历史上，它曾在约翰·詹姆斯·奥杜邦的《美洲鸟类》等著作中被称为“毛脚隼”。

Buteo lineatus.extract: The red-shouldered hawk is a medium-sized buteo. Its breeding range spans eastern North America and along the coast of California and northern to northeastern-central Mexico. It is a permanent resident throughout most of its range, though northern birds do migrate, mostly to central Mexico. The main conservation threat to the widespread species is deforestation.
Buteo lineatus.title: Red-shouldered hawk

zh-CN.title: 红肩鹰
zh-CN.extract: 红肩鹰是一种中等体型的鵟。其繁殖范围涵盖北美东部以及加利福尼亚海岸和墨西哥中北部至东北部。在其大部分分布区内为留鸟，但北部个体会迁徙，主要前往墨西哥中部。对该广泛分布物种的主要保护威胁是森林砍伐。

Buteo regalis.extract: The ferruginous hawk is a large bird of prey and belongs to the broad-winged buteo hawks. An old colloquial name is ferrugineous rough-leg, due to its similarity to the closely related rough-legged hawk.
Buteo regalis.title: Ferruginous hawk

zh-CN.title: 锈色鵟
zh-CN.extract: 锈色鵟是一种大型猛禽，属于宽翅的鵟类。一个古老的俗名是“铁锈色粗腿鵟”，因为它与近缘的粗腿鵟相似。

Buteo swainsoni.extract: Swainson's hawk is a large bird species in the Accipitriformes order. This species was named after William Swainson, a British naturalist. It is colloquially known as the grasshopper hawk or locust hawk, as it is very fond of Acrididae and will voraciously eat these insects whenever they are available.
Buteo swainsoni.title: Swainson's hawk

zh-CN.title: 斯氏鵟
zh-CN.extract: 斯氏鵟是鹰形目中的一种大型鸟类。该物种以英国博物学家威廉·斯温森命名。它俗称蚱蜢鵟或蝗虫鵟，因为非常喜欢蝗科昆虫，每当有这些昆虫时便会贪婪地捕食。

Butorides virescens.extract: The green heron is a small heron of North and Central America. Butorides is from Middle English butor "bittern" and Ancient Greek -oides, "resembling", and virescens is Latin for "greenish".
Butorides virescens.title: Green heron

zh-CN.title: 绿鹭
zh-CN.extract: 绿鹭是北美和中美洲的一种小型鹭。属名Butorides源自中古英语butor（“麻鳽”）和古希腊语-oides（“类似”），种加词virescens是拉丁语“淡绿色”的意思。

Cacomantis merulinus.extract: The plaintive cuckoo is a species of bird belonging to the genus Cacomantis in the cuckoo family Cuculidae. It is native to Asia, from India, Nepal and China to Indonesia.
Cacomantis merulinus.title: Plaintive cuckoo

zh-CN.title: 哀声杜鹃
zh-CN.extract: 哀声杜鹃是杜鹃科杜鹃属的一种鸟类。原产于亚洲，从印度、尼泊尔和中国到印度尼西亚。

Cairina moschata.extract: The Muscovy duck is a species of duck native to the Americas, from the Lower Rio Grande Valley of Texas and Mexico south to Argentina and Uruguay. The species has been domesticated, and feral Muscovy ducks can be found locally in New Zealand, Australia, the United States, and in Central and Eastern Europe.
Cairina moschata.title: Muscovy duck

zh-CN.title: 番鸭
zh-CN.extract: 番鸭是一种原产于美洲的鸭种，从德克萨斯州下格兰德河谷和墨西哥向南到阿根廷和乌拉圭。该物种已被驯化，在新西兰、澳大利亚、美国以及中欧和东欧部分地区可以发现野生番鸭。

Calamospiza melanocorys.extract: The lark bunting is a medium-sized American bunting native to central and western North America. It was designated the state bird of Colorado in 1931.
Calamospiza melanocorys.title: Lark bunting

zh-CN.title: 云雀鹀
zh-CN.extract: 云雀鹀是一种中等体型的美国鹀，原产于北美中部和西部。1931年被指定为科罗拉多州州鸟。

Calandrella dukhunensis.extract: The Mongolian short-toed lark or Sykes's short-toed lark is a species of lark in the family Alaudidae. It breeds in China and Mongolia and winters in southern Asia.
Calandrella dukhunensis.title: Mongolian short-toed lark

zh-CN.title: 蒙古短趾百灵
zh-CN.extract: 蒙古短趾百灵或赛克斯短趾百灵，是百灵科的一种百灵。繁殖于中国和蒙古，冬季迁至南亚。

Calcarius lapponicus.extract: The Lapland longspur, also known as the Lapland bunting, is a passerine bird in the longspur family Calcariidae. It is a circumpolar arctic breeder and the only member of the genus Calcarius present in Eurasia.
Calcarius lapponicus.title: Lapland longspur

zh-CN.title: 拉普兰铁爪鹀
zh-CN.extract: 拉普兰铁爪鹀，也称为拉普兰鹀，是铁爪鹀科Calcariidae中的一种雀形目鸟类。它是一种环北极的繁殖鸟，也是欧亚大陆上Calcarius属的唯一成员。

Calidris acuminata.extract: The sharp-tailed sandpiper is a small-medium migratory wader or shorebird, found mostly in Siberia during the summer breeding period and Australia for wintering.
Calidris acuminata.title: Sharp-tailed sandpiper

zh-CN.title: 尖尾滨鹬
zh-CN.extract: 尖尾滨鹬是一种中小型迁徙涉禽或岸鸟，夏季繁殖期主要在西伯利亚，冬季在澳大利亚越冬。

Calidris alba.extract: The sanderling is a small wading bird. It is a circumpolar Arctic breeder, being among the most extreme northern breeding birds in the world, nesting only on the coldest tundra, north of the 5°C July isotherm; in Europe, its southernmost breeding locality is Svalbard, where only a handful (5–15) pairs breed. It is a long-distance migrant, wintering south to South America, western and southern Europe, Africa, and Australia. It is highly gregarious in winter, sometimes forming large flocks on coastal mudflats or sandy beaches.
Calidris alba.title: Sanderling

zh-CN.title: 三趾滨鹬
zh-CN.extract: 三趾滨鹬是一种小型涉禽。它是环北极的繁殖鸟，是世界上繁殖地最北端的鸟类之一，仅在7月5°C等温线以北的最寒冷苔原上筑巢；在欧洲，其最南端的繁殖地点是斯瓦尔巴群岛，那里只有少数（5-15对）繁殖。它是一种长距离迁徙鸟类，越冬地南至南美洲、西欧和南欧、非洲以及澳大利亚。冬季非常群居，有时在沿海泥滩或沙滩上形成大群。

Calidris alpina.extract: The dunlin is a small wader in the genus Calidris. The English name is a dialect form of "dunling", first recorded in 1531–1532. It derives from dun, "dull brown", with the suffix -ling, meaning a person or thing with the given quality.
Calidris alpina.title: Dunlin

zh-CN.title: 黑腹滨鹬
zh-CN.extract: 黑腹滨鹬是滨鹬属的一种小型涉禽。其英文名是'dunling'的方言形式，最早记录于1531–1532年。它源自dun，意为'暗褐色'，加上后缀-ling，表示具有该特质的人或物。

Calidris canutus.extract: The red knot or just knot is a medium-sized shorebird which breeds in tundra and the Arctic Cordillera in the far north of Canada, Europe, and Russia. It is a large member of the Calidris sandpipers, second only to the great knot. Six subspecies are recognised.
Calidris canutus.title: Red knot

zh-CN.title: 红腹滨鹬
zh-CN.extract: 红腹滨鹬是一种中型滨鸟，在加拿大、欧洲和俄罗斯最北端的苔原和北极科迪勒拉山脉繁殖。它是滨鹬属中体型较大的成员，仅次于大滨鹬。有六个亚种被确认。

Calidris falcinellus.extract: The broad-billed sandpiper is a small wading bird. The scientific specific name falcinellus is the diminutive from Latin falx, falcis, "a small sickle". It was formerly treated in its own monospecific genus Limicola, but this was found to be embedded within the wider genus Calidris, into which it was transferred in 2004.
Calidris falcinellus.title: Broad-billed sandpiper

zh-CN.title: 阔嘴滨鹬
zh-CN.extract: 阔嘴滨鹬是一种小型涉禽。其学名种加词falcinellus源自拉丁语falx, falcis（小镰刀）的指小词。它曾被归入其自己的单型属Limicola，但后来发现该属嵌入了更广泛的滨鹬属，并于2004年被转入该属。

Calidris ferruginea.extract: The curlew sandpiper is a small wader. It is a long-distance migrant, breeding in the bogs and coastal lowlands of the Siberian Arctic, arriving there in June and staying until August or September. After the breeding season, it migrates south to spend the winter in Africa and along the coasts of Oceania and southern Eurasia, occupying tidal mudflats and saltpans.
Calidris ferruginea.title: Curlew sandpiper

zh-CN.title: 弯嘴滨鹬
zh-CN.extract: 弯嘴滨鹬是一种小型涉禽。它是一种长距离迁徙鸟类，在西伯利亚北极地区的沼泽和沿海低地繁殖，6月到达并停留至8月或9月。繁殖季节后，它向南迁徙，在非洲以及大洋洲和欧亚大陆南部的沿海地区越冬，栖息于潮间泥滩和盐田。

Calidris melanotos.extract: The pectoral sandpiper, often abbreviated pec, is a small, migratory wader that breeds in arctic regions of North America and Asia, wintering in South America and Oceania. It eats small invertebrates. Its nest, a hole scraped in the ground and with a thick lining, is deep enough to protect its four eggs from the cool breezes of its breeding grounds. The pectoral sandpiper is 19–23 cm (7.5–9.1 in) long, with a wingspan of 38–46 cm (15–18 in).
Calidris melanotos.title: Pectoral sandpiper

zh-CN.title: 斑胸滨鹬
zh-CN.extract: 斑胸滨鹬，常缩写为pec，是一种小型迁徙涉禽，在北美和亚洲的北极地区繁殖，在南美洲和大洋洲越冬。它以小型无脊椎动物为食。其巢穴是在地面上挖出的一个洞，内有厚厚的衬垫，深度足以保护其四枚卵免受繁殖地凉风的侵袭。斑胸滨鹬体长19–23厘米，翼展38–46厘米。

Calidris minuta.extract: The little stint is a very small wader. It breeds in arctic Europe and Asia, and is a long-distance migrant, wintering south to Africa and south Asia. It occasionally is a vagrant to North America and to Australia. The genus name is from Ancient Greek kalidris or skalidris, a term used by Aristotle for some grey-coloured waterside birds. The specific minuta is Latin for "small.
Calidris minuta.title: Little stint

zh-CN.title: 小滨鹬
zh-CN.extract: 小滨鹬是一种非常小的涉禽。它在北极的欧洲和亚洲繁殖，是一种长距离迁徙鸟，冬季南迁至非洲和南亚。偶尔会迷路到北美和澳大利亚。属名来自古希腊语kalidris或skalidris，亚里士多德用来指代一些灰色水边鸟类。种加词minuta在拉丁语中意为“小”。

Calidris pugnax.extract: The ruff is a medium-sized wading bird that breeds in marshes and wet meadows across northern Eurasia. This highly gregarious sandpiper is migratory and sometimes forms huge flocks in its winter grounds, which include southern and western Europe, Africa, southern Asia and Australia.
Calidris pugnax.title: Ruff (bird)

zh-CN.title: 流苏鹬
zh-CN.extract: 流苏鹬是一种中型涉禽，在欧亚大陆北部的沼泽和湿草地繁殖。这种高度群居的鹬是候鸟，有时在越冬地形成巨大的鸟群，越冬地包括南欧和西欧、非洲、南亚和澳大利亚。

Calidris pygmaea.extract: The spoon-billed sandpiper is a small wader which breeds on the coasts of the Bering Sea and winters in Southeast Asia. This species is highly threatened, and it is said that since the 1970s the breeding population has decreased significantly. By 2000, the estimated breeding population of the species was 350–500.
Calidris pygmaea.title: Spoon-billed sandpiper

zh-CN.title: 勺嘴鹬
