zh-CN.extract: 勺嘴鹬是一种小型涉禽，在白令海沿岸繁殖，在东南亚越冬。该物种受到高度威胁，据说自20世纪70年代以来繁殖种群数量显著下降。到2000年，该物种的估计繁殖种群数量为350-500只。

Calidris ruficollis.extract: The red-necked stint or rufous-necked stint is a small migratory wader that breeds in northeast Russia and spends the non-breeding season along the coastlines of Southeast Asia and Australasia.
Calidris ruficollis.title: Red-necked stint

zh-CN.title: 红颈滨鹬
zh-CN.extract: 红颈滨鹬是一种小型迁徙涉禽，在俄罗斯东北部繁殖，非繁殖期在东南亚和澳大拉西亚的海岸线度过。

Calidris subminuta.extract: The long-toed stint is a small wader. The genus name is from Ancient Greek kalidris or skalidris, a term used by Aristotle for some grey-coloured waterside birds. The specific subminuta is from Latin sub, "near to" and minuta, "small" from its similarity to the little stint, Calidris minuta.
Calidris subminuta.title: Long-toed stint

zh-CN.title: 长趾滨鹬
zh-CN.extract: 长趾滨鹬是一种小型涉禽。属名来自古希腊语kalidris或skalidris，亚里士多德用来指代一些灰色水边鸟类。种加词subminuta来自拉丁语sub（接近）和minuta（小），因其与小滨鹬Calidris minuta相似。

Calidris temminckii.extract: Temminck's stint is a small wader native to the Old World. This bird's common name and Latin binomial commemorate the Dutch naturalist Coenraad Jacob Temminck. The genus name is from Ancient Greek kalidris or skalidris, a term used by Aristotle for some grey-coloured waterside birds.
Calidris temminckii.title: Temminck's stint

zh-CN.title: 青脚滨鹬
zh-CN.extract: 青脚滨鹬是一种原产于旧大陆的小型涉禽。这种鸟的常用名和拉丁双名是为了纪念荷兰博物学家康拉德·雅各布·特明克。属名来自古希腊语kalidris或skalidris，亚里士多德用来指代一些灰色水边鸟类。

Calidris tenuirostris.extract: The great knot is a medium-sized wader. It is one of the largest species in the genus Calidris. It is a migratory bird which breeds in eastern Siberia, Russia, and flies to southern Asia and Australia in the northern winter.
Calidris tenuirostris.title: Great knot

zh-CN.title: 大滨鹬
zh-CN.extract: 大滨鹬是一种中型涉禽。它是滨鹬属中最大的物种之一。它是一种候鸟，在俄罗斯东西伯利亚繁殖，并在北半球冬季飞往南亚和澳大利亚。

Calliope calliope.extract: The Siberian rubythroat is a small passerine bird first described by Peter Simon Pallas in 1776. It was formerly classed as a member of the thrush family, Turdidae, but is now more generally considered to be an Old World flycatcher of the family Muscicapidae. The Siberian rubythroat and similar small European species are often called chats.
Calliope calliope.title: Siberian rubythroat

zh-CN.title: 红喉歌鸲
zh-CN.extract: 红喉歌鸲是一种小型雀形目鸟类，由彼得·西蒙·帕拉斯于1776年首次描述。它以前被归类为鸫科（Turdidae）成员，但现在更普遍被认为是鹟科（Muscicapidae）的旧大陆鹟。红喉歌鸲和类似的小型欧洲物种常被称为石䳭。

Callipepla californica.extract:
The California quail, also known as the California valley quail or Valley quail, is a small ground-dwelling bird in the New World quail family. These birds have a curving crest, plume or topknot made of six feathers, that droops forward: black in males and brown in females; the flanks are brown with white streaks. Males have a dark brown cap and a black face with a brown back, a grey-blue chest and a light brown belly. Females and immature birds are mainly grey-brown with a light-colored belly.
Their closest relative is Gambel's quail, which has a more southerly distribution and a longer crest at 2.5 in (6.4 cm), a brighter head and lacks the scaly appearance of the California quail. The two species separated about 1–2 million years ago, during the Late Pliocene or Early Pleistocene. It was selected as the state bird of California in 1931.
Callipepla californica.title: California quail

zh-CN.title: 加州鹑
zh-CN.extract: 加州鹑，也称加州谷鹑或谷鹑，是一种新大陆鹑科的小型地面栖息鸟类。这些鸟有一个由六根羽毛组成的弯曲冠羽、羽饰或顶髻，向前下垂：雄性为黑色，雌性为棕色；两胁为棕色，有白色条纹。雄性有深棕色头冠和黑色面部，背部棕色，胸部灰蓝色，腹部浅棕色。雌性和幼鸟主要为灰棕色，腹部浅色。它们最近的近亲是甘贝尔氏鹑，后者分布更靠南，冠羽更长（2.5英寸/6.4厘米），头部颜色更亮，且没有加州鹑的鳞状外观。这两个物种大约在1-2百万年前，即上新世晚期或更新世早期分离。1931年被选为加利福尼亚州州鸟。

Calothorax lucifer.extract: The lucifer sheartail or lucifer hummingbird is a medium-sized, 10 cm long, green hummingbird with a slightly curved bill and distinctive outward flare of its gorget feathers. Its habitat is in high-altitude areas of northern Mexico and southwestern United States. It winters in central Mexico.
Calothorax lucifer.title: Lucifer sheartail

zh-CN.title: 路西法蜂鸟
zh-CN.extract: 路西法蜂鸟是一种中型（10厘米长）的绿色蜂鸟，喙略微弯曲，喉部羽毛向外展开，形成独特的喇叭状。其栖息地位于墨西哥北部和美国西南部的高海拔地区。冬季在墨西哥中部过冬。

Calypte anna.extract: Anna's hummingbird is a North American species of hummingbird named after Anna Masséna, Duchess of Rivoli.
Calypte anna.title: Anna's hummingbird

zh-CN.title: 安娜蜂鸟
zh-CN.extract: 安娜蜂鸟是一种北美蜂鸟，以里沃利公爵夫人安娜·马塞纳命名。

Calypte costae.extract: Costa's hummingbird is a species of hummingbird in the family Trochilidae. It breeds in the arid, semi-arid and Mediterranean climate zones of the Southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico, mainly in Southern California and the Baja California Peninsula. Like many hummingbirds in the region, it can be found on the Pacific coast, often visiting backyard hummingbird feeders and gardens with flowering plants, as well as in more wild ecosystems, such as the conifer and oak forests, chaparral, and high desert habitats found further inland. When not in the US, the species often winters in western Mexico.
Calypte costae.title: Costa's hummingbird

zh-CN.title: 科氏蜂鸟
zh-CN.extract: 科氏蜂鸟是蜂鸟科的一种。它在美国西南部和墨西哥西北部的干旱、半干旱和地中海气候区繁殖，主要在南加州和下加利福尼亚半岛。与许多该地区的蜂鸟一样，它可以在太平洋沿岸找到，经常访问后院的蜂鸟喂食器和有开花植物的花园，也出现在更野生的生态系统中，如针叶林和橡树林、灌木丛以及更向内陆的高沙漠栖息地。不在美国时，该物种通常在墨西哥西部过冬。

Caprimulgus affinis.extract: The savanna nightjar, also known as allied nightjar or Franklin's nightjar, is a species of nightjar found in South and Southeast Asia. The IUCN Red List has assessed the species to be of least concern because it has a large range and its population trend is stable. As other nightjars, this nocturnal bird is characterised by its large eyes, gaping mouth and excellent camouflage. It can be distinguished from similar south Asian nightjar species, like the chirruping nightjar, by its unique vocalisations.
Caprimulgus affinis.title: Savanna nightjar

zh-CN.title: 草原夜鹰
zh-CN.extract: 草原夜鹰，也称为同盟夜鹰或富兰克林夜鹰，是一种分布于南亚和东南亚的夜鹰。世界自然保护联盟红色名录将其评估为无危物种，因为其分布范围广，种群趋势稳定。与其他夜鹰一样，这种夜行鸟类以其大眼睛、大嘴和极好的伪装为特征。可以通过其独特的叫声与类似南亚夜鹰物种（如叽喳夜鹰）区分开来。

Caprimulgus jotaka.extract: The grey nightjar is a species of nightjar found in East Asia, breeding from southeastern Russia south through China, the Korean Peninsula and Japan to northern Indochina and westward along the Himalayas. It is largely migratory, wintering in Indochina south to Java in Indonesia, but is resident in warmer areas in the south of its breeding range. It is sometimes treated as a subspecies of the jungle nightjar, its South Asian relative. The grey nightjar breeds and forages in early successional habitats surrounded by forests; its populations have declined since the 1970s in Japan. Like all nightjars, it is crepuscular to nocturnal, feeding on flying insects, including moths, beetles, flying ants, grasshoppers, and others.
Caprimulgus jotaka.title: Grey nightjar

zh-CN.title: 灰夜鹰
zh-CN.extract: 灰夜鹰是一种分布于东亚的夜鹰，繁殖范围从俄罗斯东南部向南经过中国、朝鲜半岛和日本到印度支那北部，并沿喜马拉雅山脉向西。它主要是迁徙性的，在印度支那南至印度尼西亚爪哇岛越冬，但在其繁殖区南部的温暖地区为留鸟。有时被视为其南亚近亲丛林夜鹰的一个亚种。灰夜鹰在森林环绕的早期演替栖息地繁殖和觅食；自1970年代以来，其在日本的数量有所下降。与所有夜鹰一样，它在黄昏到夜间活动，以飞行昆虫为食，包括蛾子、甲虫、飞蚁、蚱蜢等。

Cardellina pusilla.extract: Wilson's warbler is a small New World warbler. It is greenish above and yellow below, with rounded wings and a long, slim tail. The male has a black crown patch; depending on the subspecies, that mark is reduced or absent in the female. It breeds across Canada and south through the western United States, and winters from Mexico south through much of Central America. It is a very rare vagrant to western Europe.
Cardellina pusilla.title: Wilson's warbler

zh-CN.title: 威尔逊莺
zh-CN.extract: 威尔逊莺是一种小型新大陆莺。它上身绿色，下身黄色，翅膀圆形，尾巴长而细。雄性头部有黑色冠斑；根据亚种不同，雌性的该斑纹减小或缺失。它在加拿大和美国西部繁殖，越冬范围从墨西哥向南到中美洲大部分地区。它是西欧非常罕见的迷鸟。

Cardellina rubrifrons.extract: The red-faced warbler is a species of New World warbler.
Cardellina rubrifrons.title: Red-faced warbler

zh-CN.title: 红脸莺
zh-CN.extract: 红脸莺是一种新大陆莺。

Carpodacus erythrinus.extract: The common rosefinch or scarlet rosefinch is the most widespread and common rosefinch of Asia and Europe.
Carpodacus erythrinus.title: Common rosefinch

zh-CN.title: 普通朱雀
zh-CN.extract: 普通朱雀或猩红朱雀是亚洲和欧洲最常见、分布最广的朱雀。

Cathartes aura.extract: The turkey vulture is the most widespread of the New World vultures. One of three species in the genus Cathartes of the family Cathartidae, the turkey vulture ranges from southern Canada to the southernmost tip of South America. It inhabits a variety of open and semi-open areas, including subtropical forests, shrublands, pastures, and deserts.
Cathartes aura.title: Turkey vulture

zh-CN.title: 红头美洲鹫
zh-CN.extract: 红头美洲鹫是新大陆鹫中分布最广的一种。作为鹫科（Cathartidae）红头美洲鹫属（Cathartes）三种物种之一，其分布范围从加拿大南部一直延伸到南美洲最南端。栖息于多种开阔或半开阔区域，包括亚热带森林、灌木丛、牧场和沙漠。

Catharus guttatus.extract: The hermit thrush is a medium-sized North American thrush.
Catharus guttatus.title: Hermit thrush

zh-CN.title: 隐士夜鸫
zh-CN.extract: 隐士夜鸫是一种中等体型的北美鸫鸟。

Catharus ustulatus.extract: Swainson's thrush, also called olive-backed thrush, russet-backed thrush, and salmonberry bird is a medium-sized thrush. It is a member of genus Catharus and is typical of it in terms of its subdued coloration and beautiful, ascending flute-like voice. Swainson's thrush was named after William Swainson, an English ornithologist.
Catharus ustulatus.title: Swainson's thrush

zh-CN.title: 斯氏夜鸫
zh-CN.extract: 斯氏夜鸫，又称橄榄背夜鸫、红褐背夜鸫和鲑莓鸟，是一种中等体型的鸫鸟。它是夜鸫属（Catharus）的成员，以其低调的羽色和优美、渐升的笛声般的鸣叫而典型。斯氏夜鸫以英国鸟类学家威廉·斯温森（William Swainson）命名。

Catherpes mexicanus.extract: The canyon wren is a small North American songbird of the wren family Troglodytidae. A non-migratory species, these birds are found throughout western North America in dry, rocky environments such as cliffs, outcrops, and canyons. It is a small bird that is hard to see on its rocky habitat, and is often located by its loud distinctive song. It is currently in a monotypic taxon and is the only species in the genus Catherpes.
Catherpes mexicanus.title: Canyon wren

zh-CN.title: 峡谷鹪鹩
zh-CN.extract: 峡谷鹪鹩是一种小型北美鸣禽，属于鹪鹩科（Troglodytidae）。这种非迁徙性鸟类分布于北美西部干燥多岩的环境，如悬崖、露头和峡谷。它是一种体型小巧的鸟类，在其岩石栖息地中难以被发现，常通过其响亮独特的歌声定位。目前它属于单型分类单元，是峡谷鹪鹩属（Catherpes）的唯一物种。

Cecropis daurica.extract: The eastern red-rumped swallow is a small passerine bird in the swallow family Hirundinidae. It is found in open, often hilly, areas with clearings and cultivation across Southeast Asia to north-eastern India and Taiwan.
Cecropis daurica.title: Eastern red-rumped swallow

zh-CN.title: 东方金腰燕
zh-CN.extract: 东方金腰燕是燕科（Hirundinidae）的一种小型雀形目鸟类。常见于东南亚至印度东北部和台湾的开阔、通常多丘陵的地区，这些地区有空旷地和农田。

Centropus bengalensis.extract: The lesser coucal is a species of cuckoo in the family Cuculidae. It has a wide distribution range that overlaps with several other similar species. The habitat in which it is found is often marshy land with grass and tree cover. It is distinguished by its smaller size, less prominent bill, pale shaft streaks on the feathers of the head and back. It has a much longer claw on its hind toe and a distinct call. It is also among the few coucals that show season plumage differences but like in other coucals, the sexes cannot be distinguished in the field.
Centropus bengalensis.title: Lesser coucal

zh-CN.title: 小鸦鹃
zh-CN.extract: 小鸦鹃是杜鹃科（Cuculidae）的一种杜鹃。其分布范围广泛，与多种其他相似物种重叠。栖息地通常是带有草地和树木覆盖的沼泽地。以其较小的体型、不太突出的喙、头部和背部羽毛上的浅色羽干纹而区分。后趾有更长的爪，叫声独特。它也是少数表现出季节性羽色差异的鸦鹃之一，但与其他鸦鹃一样，野外无法区分性别。

Centropus sinensis.extract: The greater coucal or crow pheasant, is a large non-parasitic member of the cuckoo order of birds, the Cuculiformes. A widespread resident in the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia, it is divided into several subspecies, some being treated as full species. They are large, crow-like with a long tail and coppery brown wings and found in a wide range of habitats from jungle to cultivation and urban gardens. They are weak fliers, and are often seen clambering about in vegetation or walking on the ground as they forage for insects, eggs and nestlings of other birds. They have a familiar deep resonant call which is associated with omens in many parts of its range.
Centropus sinensis.title: Greater coucal

zh-CN.title: 褐翅鸦鹃
zh-CN.extract: 褐翅鸦鹃或乌鸦雉，是杜鹃目（Cuculiformes）中一种大型非寄生性杜鹃。它是印度次大陆和东南亚的广泛留鸟，分为多个亚种，其中一些被视为独立物种。体型大、似乌鸦、尾长、翅呈铜褐色，栖息地广泛，从丛林到农田和城市花园。飞行能力弱，常看到它们在植被中攀爬或在地面上行走，觅食昆虫、其他鸟类的卵和雏鸟。其深沉洪亮的叫声在分布区的许多地方被认为与预兆相关。

Certhia americana.extract: The brown creeper, also known as the American treecreeper, is a small songbird, the only North American member of the treecreeper family Certhiidae.
Certhia americana.title: Brown creeper

zh-CN.title: 棕旋木雀
zh-CN.extract: 棕旋木雀，也称为美洲旋木雀，是一种小型鸣禽，是旋木雀科Certhiidae在北美唯一的成员。

Ceryle rudis.extract: The pied kingfisher is a species of water kingfisher widely distributed across Africa and Asia. Originally described by Carl Linnaeus in 1758, it has five recognised subspecies, and is the only member of the genus Ceryle. Its black and white plumage and crest, as well as its habit of hovering over clear lakes and rivers before diving for fish, make it distinctive. Males have a double band across the breast, while females have a single broken breast band. They are usually found in pairs or small family groups. When perched, they often bob their head and flick up their tail.
Ceryle rudis.title: Pied kingfisher

zh-CN.title: 斑鱼狗
zh-CN.extract: 斑鱼狗是一种广泛分布于非洲和亚洲的水翠鸟。最初由卡尔·林奈于1758年描述，有五个公认的亚种，是Ceryle属的唯一成员。其黑白相间的羽毛和冠羽，以及在清澈湖泊和河流上空盘旋然后潜入水中捕鱼的习性，使其独具特色。雄性胸部有双重带，雌性胸部有一条断裂的带。它们通常成对或小家庭群出现。栖息时，常点头并翘尾。

Chaetura vauxi.extract: Vaux's swift is a small swift native to North America, Central America, and northern South America. It was named for the American scientist William Sansom Vaux.
Chaetura vauxi.title: Vaux's swift

zh-CN.title: 沃克斯雨燕
zh-CN.extract: 沃克斯雨燕是一种小型雨燕，原产于北美洲、中美洲和南美洲北部。它以美国科学家威廉·桑瑟姆·沃克斯的名字命名。

Chalcophaps indica.extract: The emerald dove or common emerald dove, also called Asian emerald dove and grey-capped emerald dove, is a widespread resident breeding pigeon native to the tropical and subtropical parts of the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia. The dove is also known by the names of green dove and green-winged pigeon. The common emerald dove is the state bird of the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. The Pacific emerald dove and Stephan's emerald dove were both considered conspecific.
Chalcophaps indica.title: Common emerald dove

zh-CN.title: 绿翅金鸠
zh-CN.extract: 绿翅金鸠，也称普通翡翠鸽、亚洲翡翠鸽和灰顶翡翠鸽，是一种广泛分布的原产于印度次大陆和东南亚热带和亚热带地区的留鸟繁殖鸽。它也被称为绿鸽和绿翅鸽。绿翅金鸠是印度泰米尔纳德邦的州鸟。太平洋翡翠鸽和斯蒂芬翡翠鸽曾被认为是同种。

Charadrius hiaticula.extract: The common ringed plover, great ringed plover or ringed plover is a species of bird in the family Charadriidae. It breeds across much of northern Eurasia, as well as Greenland.
Charadrius hiaticula.title: Common ringed plover

zh-CN.title: 环颈鸻
zh-CN.extract: 环颈鸻，也称大环颈鸻或环颈鸻，是鸻科的一种鸟类。它在欧亚大陆北部大部分地区以及格陵兰繁殖。

Charadrius vociferus.extract: The killdeer is a large plover found in the Americas. Its shrill, two-syllable call is often heard, sounding like "kill deer". It was described and given its current scientific name in 1758 by Carl Linnaeus in the 10th edition of his Systema Naturae. Three subspecies are described. Its upperparts are mostly brown with rufous fringes, the head has patches of white and black, and two black bands cross the breast. The belly and the rest of the breast are white. The nominate subspecies breeds from southeastern Alaska and southern Canada to Mexico. It is seen year-round in the southern half of its breeding range; the subspecies C. v. ternominatus is resident in the West Indies, and C. v. peruvianus inhabits Peru and surrounding South American countries throughout the year. North American breeders winter from their resident range south to Central America, the West Indies, and the northernmost portions of South America.
Charadrius vociferus.title: Killdeer

zh-CN.title: 双领鸻
zh-CN.extract: 双领鸻是一种在美洲发现的大型鸻。它尖锐的两音节叫声常被听到，听起来像“kill deer”。它由卡尔·林奈于1758年在其《自然系统》第10版中描述并赋予现名。描述了三个亚种。其上半身主要为棕色，带有红褐色边缘，头部有白色和黑色斑块，胸部有两道黑色横带。腹部和胸部其余部分为白色。指名亚种从阿拉斯加东南部和加拿大南部繁殖到墨西哥。在其繁殖范围的南半部全年可见；亚种C. v. ternominatus在西印度群岛留居，C. v. peruvianus全年栖息于秘鲁和周边南美国家。北美繁殖鸟从它们的留居范围向南迁徙到中美洲、西印度群岛和南美洲最北部越冬。

Chlidonias hybrida.extract: The whiskered tern is a tern in the family Laridae. The genus name is from Ancient Greek khelidonios, "swallow-like", from khelidon, "swallow". The specific hybridus is Latin for hybrid; Peter Simon Pallas thought it might be a hybrid of white-winged black tern and common tern, writing "Sterna fissipes [Chlidonias leucopterus] et Hirundine [Sterna hirundo] natam".
Chlidonias hybrida.title: Whiskered tern

zh-CN.title: 须浮鸥
zh-CN.extract: 须浮鸥是鸥科的一种燕鸥。属名来自古希腊语khelidonios，“燕子般的”，源自khelidon，“燕子”。种加词hybridus是拉丁语“杂交”的意思；彼得·西蒙·帕拉斯认为它可能是白翅黑燕鸥和普通燕鸥的杂交种，写道“Sterna fissipes [白翅黑燕鸥] et Hirundine [普通燕鸥] natam”。

Chlidonias leucopterus.extract: The white-winged tern or white-winged black tern is a species of tern in the family Laridae. It is a small species generally found in or near bodies of fresh water across much of the world, including Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. The genus name is from Ancient Greek khelidonios, "swallow-like", from khelidon, "swallow".
Chlidonias leucopterus.title: White-winged tern

zh-CN.title: 白翅浮鸥
zh-CN.extract: 白翅浮鸥或白翅黑燕鸥是鸥科的一种燕鸥。它是一种小型物种，通常在世界各地的淡水水体中或附近发现，包括欧洲、非洲、亚洲和澳大利亚。属名来自古希腊语khelidonios，“燕子般的”，源自khelidon，“燕子”。

Chloris sinica.extract: The Oriental greenfinch, also known as the grey-capped greenfinch, is a small passerine bird in the finch family Fringillidae that breeds in broadleaf and conifer woodlands of the East Palearctic.
Chloris sinica.title: Oriental greenfinch

zh-CN.title: 东方金翅雀
zh-CN.extract: 东方金翅雀，又名灰头金翅雀，是一种小型雀形目鸟类，属于燕雀科，繁殖于东古北界的阔叶林和针叶林中。

Chloropsis aurifrons.extract: The golden-fronted leafbird is a species of leafbird. It is found from the Indian subcontinent and south-western China, to south-east Asia and Sumatra.
Chloropsis aurifrons.title: Golden-fronted leafbird

zh-CN.title: 金额叶鹎
zh-CN.extract: 金额叶鹎是叶鹎属的一种。分布于印度次大陆、中国西南部、东南亚及苏门答腊。

Chloropsis hardwickii.extract: The orange-bellied leafbird is a bird native to the central and eastern Himalayas, Yunnan and northern parts of Southeast Asia. The greyish-crowned leafbird, which is found in Hainan, is again considered conspecific. The scientific name commemorates the English naturalist Thomas Hardwicke.
Chloropsis hardwickii.title: Orange-bellied leafbird

zh-CN.title: 橙腹叶鹎
zh-CN.extract: 橙腹叶鹎是一种鸟类，原产于喜马拉雅山脉中东部、云南及东南亚北部。分布于海南的灰冠叶鹎再次被视为同种物种。其学名纪念英国博物学家托马斯·哈德威克。

Chondestes grammacus.extract: The lark sparrow is a fairly large New World sparrow. It is the only member of the genus Chondestes.
Chondestes grammacus.title: Lark sparrow

zh-CN.title: 歌带鹀
zh-CN.extract: 歌带鹀是一种体型较大的新大陆鹀。它是歌带鹀属的唯一成员。

Chordeiles minor.extract: The common nighthawk or bullbat is a medium-sized crepuscular or nocturnal bird of the Americas within the nightjar (Caprimulgidae) family, whose presence and identity are best revealed by its vocalization. Typically dark, displaying cryptic colouration and intricate patterns, this bird is difficult to spot with the naked eye during the day. This bird is most conspicuous when in its buoyant and erratic flight. The most remarkable feature of this aerial insectivore is its small beak that belies the massiveness of its mouth. Some claim appearance similarities to owls. With its horizontal stance and short legs, the common nighthawk does not travel frequently on the ground, instead preferring to perch horizontally, parallel to branches, on posts, on the ground or on a roof. The males of this species may roost together but the bird is primarily solitary. The common nighthawk shows variability in territory size.
Chordeiles minor.title: Common nighthawk

zh-CN.title: 美洲夜鹰
zh-CN.extract: 美洲夜鹰，又称牛夜鹰，是一种中等体型、在黄昏或夜间活动的美洲鸟类，属于夜鹰科。其存在和身份最好通过其鸣叫声来识别。这种鸟通常呈暗色，具有隐蔽色和复杂图案，白天肉眼难以发现。最引人注目的是其轻盈而飘忽不定的飞行。这种空中食虫动物最显著的特征是其小喙，掩盖了嘴巴的巨大尺寸。有人声称其外形与猫头鹰相似。美洲夜鹰姿态水平，腿短，不常在地面活动，更喜欢水平栖息在树枝、柱子、地面或屋顶上。雄性可能会一起栖息，但这种鸟主要是独居的。美洲夜鹰的领地面积大小不一。

Chroicocephalus brunnicephalus.extract: The brown-headed gull is a small gull which breeds in the high plateaus of central Asia from Tajikistan to Ordos in Inner Mongolia. It is migratory, wintering on the coasts and large inland lakes of the Indian subcontinent. As is the case with many gulls, was traditionally placed in the genus Larus.
Chroicocephalus brunnicephalus.title: Brown-headed gull

zh-CN.title: 棕头鸥
zh-CN.extract: 棕头鸥是一种小型鸥，繁殖于中亚高原，从塔吉克斯坦到内蒙古的鄂尔多斯。它迁徙，冬季在印度次大陆的海岸和大型内陆湖泊越冬。与许多鸥类一样，传统上被归入鸥属。

Chroicocephalus genei.extract: The slender-billed gull is a mid-sized gull which breeds very locally around the Mediterranean and the north of the western Indian Ocean on islands and coastal lagoons. Most of the population is somewhat migratory, wintering further south to as far as North Africa and India. A few birds have wandered to western Europe. A vagrant individual was reportedly seen on Antigua, April 24, 1976.
Chroicocephalus genei.title: Slender-billed gull

zh-CN.title: 细嘴鸥
zh-CN.extract: 细嘴鸥是一种中等体型的鸥，局部繁殖于地中海沿岸和西印度洋北部岛屿及沿海泻湖。大部分种群有一定迁徙性，冬季向南远至北非和印度。少数个体游荡至西欧。据报道，1976年4月24日有一只迷鸟在安提瓜出现。

Chroicocephalus novaehollandiae.extract: The silver gull is a gull in Oceania. It is the most common gull of Australia. It has been found throughout the continent, but particularly at or near coastal areas. It is smaller than the Pacific gull, which also lives in Australia.
Chroicocephalus novaehollandiae.title: Silver gull

zh-CN.title: 银鸥
zh-CN.extract: 银鸥是大洋洲的一种鸥。它是澳大利亚最常见的鸥类。遍布整个大陆，尤其是沿海地区。它比同样生活在澳大利亚的太平洋鸥体型小。

Chroicocephalus ridibundus.extract: The black-headed gull is a small gull that breeds in much of the Palearctic in Europe and Asia, and also locally in smaller numbers in coastal eastern Canada. Most of the population is migratory and winters further south, but many also remain in the milder areas of northwestern Europe. It was formerly sometimes cited as "common black-headed gull" to distinguish it from "great black-headed gull".
Chroicocephalus ridibundus.title: Black-headed gull

zh-CN.title: 红嘴鸥
zh-CN.extract: 红嘴鸥是一种小型鸥类，繁殖于欧亚大陆大部分古北界地区，也在加拿大东部沿海局部有小数量分布。大部分种群为候鸟，冬季南迁，但也有许多留在西北欧较温和的地区。曾被称为“普通红嘴鸥”，以区别于“大黑头鸥”。

Chrysococcyx maculatus.extract: The Asian emerald cuckoo is a species of cuckoo in the family Cuculidae. It is found in Bangladesh, Bhutan, Cambodia, China, India, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Thailand, and Vietnam. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical moist montane forest.
Chrysococcyx maculatus.title: Asian emerald cuckoo

zh-CN.title: 翠金鹃
zh-CN.extract: 翠金鹃是杜鹃科杜鹃属的一种鸟类。分布于孟加拉国、不丹、柬埔寨、中国、印度、印度尼西亚、老挝、马来西亚、缅甸、尼泊尔、斯里兰卡、泰国和越南。其自然栖息地为亚热带或热带湿润低地森林以及亚热带或热带湿润山地森林。

Chrysolophus pictus.extract: The golden pheasant, also known as the Chinese pheasant, and rainbow pheasant, is a gamebird of the order Galliformes and the family Phasianidae (pheasants). The genus name is from Ancient Greek khrusolophos, "with golden crest", and pictus is Latin for "painted" from pingere, "to paint".
Chrysolophus pictus.title: Golden pheasant

zh-CN.title: 红腹锦鸡
zh-CN.extract: 红腹锦鸡，又名中国雉鸡或彩虹雉，是一种鸡形目雉科（雉类）的猎禽。属名源自古希腊语khrusolophos，意为“金色冠羽”，种加词pictus在拉丁语中意为“彩绘”，来自动词pingere（意为“绘画”）。

Ciconia nigra.extract: The black stork is a large bird in the stork family Ciconiidae. It was first described by Carl Linnaeus in the 10th edition of his Systema Naturae. Measuring on average 95 to 100 cm from beak tip to end of tail with a 145-to-155 cm (57-to-61 in) wingspan, the adult black stork has mainly black plumage, with white underparts, long red legs and a long pointed red beak. A widespread but uncommon species, it breeds in scattered locations across Europe, and east across the Palearctic to the Pacific Ocean. It is a long-distance migrant, with European populations wintering in tropical Sub-Saharan Africa, and Asian populations in the Indian subcontinent. When migrating between Europe and Africa, it avoids crossing broad expanses of the Mediterranean Sea and detours via the Levant in the east, the Strait of Sicily in the center, or the Strait of Gibraltar in the west. An isolated non-migratory population lives in Southern Africa.
Ciconia nigra.title: Black stork

zh-CN.title: 黑鹳
zh-CN.extract: 黑鹳是鹳科鹳属的一种大型鸟类。最早由卡尔·林奈在其《自然系统》第十版中描述。从喙尖到尾端平均体长95至100厘米，翼展145至155厘米（57至61英寸）。成鸟黑鹳羽毛以黑色为主，腹部白色，有长而红的腿和尖长的红喙。这是一种分布广泛但不常见的物种，繁殖于欧洲各地零星地点，向东延伸至古北界直至太平洋。为长距离迁徙鸟，欧洲种群冬季前往热带撒哈拉以南非洲，亚洲种群则迁至印度次大陆。在欧非迁徙时，避免横渡广阔的地中海，而是东绕黎凡特地区，中经西西里海峡，或西经直布罗陀海峡。非洲南部有一孤立的不迁徙种群。

Cinclus mexicanus.extract: The American dipper, also known as a water ouzel, is a semiaquatic bird species native from North America.
Cinclus mexicanus.title: American dipper

zh-CN.title: 美洲河乌
zh-CN.extract: 美洲河乌，又名水乌鸫，是一种原产于北美洲的半水生鸟类。

Cinclus pallasii.extract: The brown dipper, also known as Pallas's dipper, Asian dipper or the Asiatic dipper, is an aquatic songbird found in the mountains of the east Palearctic. It is a thrush-like bird with a cocked tail. Its plumage is chocolate-brown with a slightly lighter coloured back and breast. At 22 cm (8.7 in) and 87 g (3.1 oz), it is the largest of the dippers. This species, which is not often seen, is found at medium to low elevations where mountain streams flow.
Cinclus pallasii.title: Brown dipper

zh-CN.title: 褐河乌
zh-CN.extract: 褐河乌，又名帕拉斯河乌、亚洲河乌或东亚河乌，是一种生活在东古北界山区的水栖鸣禽。体型似鸫，尾常上翘。羽毛为巧克力棕色，背部和胸部颜色稍浅。体长22厘米（8.7英寸），体重87克（3.1盎司），是河乌中体型最大的。此鸟不常见，见于中低海拔的山区溪流处。

Circus cyaneus.extract: The hen harrier is a bird of prey. It breeds in open areas such as marshes and grasslands in Eurasia and is migratory, moving further south outside of the breeding season. Birds in milder regions, such as France and Great Britain, may be resident year-round, but the higher altitudes are largely deserted in winter. The species is sexually dimorphic; males are smaller and mostly grey and white with black wingtips, whereas females average larger and are predominantly brown and have buff underparts with brown barring. Both sexes have a white rump patch, although it is more noticeable on females and juveniles.
Circus cyaneus.title: Hen harrier

zh-CN.title: 白尾鹞
zh-CN.extract: 白尾鹞是一种猛禽。繁殖于欧亚大陆的沼泽和草地等开阔地带，为候鸟，繁殖季节后南迁。气候温和地区（如法国和英国）的鸟类可能全年留居，但高海拔地区冬季多被遗弃。该物种具有性别二态性：雄鸟较小，多为灰白色且翼尖黑色；雌鸟平均体型较大，主要为褐色，腹部浅黄色带有褐色横纹。两性均有白色腰斑，但在雌鸟和幼鸟上更为明显。

Circus hudsonius.extract: The northern harrier, also known as the marsh hawk or ring-tailed hawk, is a bird of prey. It breeds throughout the northern parts of the Northern Hemisphere in Canada and the northernmost United States.
Circus hudsonius.title: Northern harrier

zh-CN.title: 北鹞
zh-CN.extract: 北鹞，又名沼泽鹰或环尾鹰，是一种猛禽。繁殖于北半球北部地区，包括加拿大和美国最北端。

Circus melanoleucos.extract: The pied harrier is a bird of prey in the family Accipitridae, named for the male's distinctive white and black colouration.
Circus melanoleucos.title: Pied harrier

zh-CN.title: 鹊鹞
zh-CN.extract: 鹊鹞是鹰科的一种猛禽，因其雄性独特的黑白配色而得名。

Circus spilonotus.extract: The eastern marsh harrier is a bird of prey belonging to the marsh harrier group of harriers. It was previously considered to be conspecific with the western marsh harrier but is now usually classified as a separate species. It has two subspecies: C. s. spilonotus in eastern Asia and C. s. spilothorax in New Guinea.
Circus spilonotus.title: Eastern marsh harrier

zh-CN.title: 东方泽鹞
zh-CN.extract: 东方泽鹞是一种属于泽鹞类群的猛禽。它以前被认为是西方泽鹞的同种，但现在通常被归类为一个独立物种。它有两个亚种：在东亚的C. s. spilonotus和在新几内亚的C. s. spilothorax。

Cissa hypoleuca.extract: The Indochinese green magpie, also known as the yellow-breasted magpie, is a small colourful bird native to the forests of China and Vietnam.
Cissa hypoleuca.title: Indochinese green magpie

zh-CN.title: 印支绿鹊
zh-CN.extract: 印支绿鹊，又称黄胸绿鹊，是一种色彩鲜艳的小型鸟类，原产于中国和越南的森林。

Cisticola exilis.extract: The golden-headed cisticola, also known as the bright-capped cisticola, is a species of warbler in the family Cisticolidae, found in Australia and thirteen Asian countries. Growing to 9–11.5 cm (3.5–4.5 in) long, it is usually brown and cream in colour, but has a different appearance during the mating season, with a gold-coloured body and a much shorter tail. It is an omnivore and frequently makes a variety of vocalizations. Known as the "finest tailor of all birds", it constructs nests out of plants and spider threads. It mates in the rainy season. It has a very large range and population, which is thought to be increasing.
Cisticola exilis.title: Golden-headed cisticola

zh-CN.title: 金头扇尾莺
zh-CN.extract: 金头扇尾莺，又称亮冠扇尾莺，是扇尾莺科的一种莺，分布于澳大利亚和13个亚洲国家。体长9–11.5厘米，通常为棕色和奶油色，但在交配季节外观不同，身体呈金色，尾巴更短。它是杂食动物，经常发出各种叫声。被称为“最好的鸟类裁缝”，用植物和蜘蛛丝筑巢。它在雨季交配。其分布范围和种群数量非常大，且被认为正在增加。

Cisticola juncidis.extract: The zitting cisticola, formerly also fan-tailed warbler or streaked fantail warbler is a widely distributed Old World warbler in the family Cisticolidae, whose breeding range includes western and southern Europe, Africa outside the deserts and rainforest, and southern Asia down to northern Australia. A small bird found mainly in grasslands, it is best identified by its rufous rump; in addition it lacks any gold on the collar and the brownish tail is tipped with white. During the breeding season males have a zigzagging flight display accompanied by regular "zit" calls that give it its English name. They build their pouch nest suspended within a clump of grass.
Cisticola juncidis.title: Zitting cisticola

zh-CN.title: 棕扇尾莺
zh-CN.extract: 棕扇尾莺，以前也称为扇尾莺或纹翅扇尾莺，是广泛分布的旧大陆莺科鸟类，繁殖范围包括西欧和南欧、非洲（除沙漠和雨林外）以及南亚至澳大利亚北部。它是一种主要生活于草地的小鸟，最明显的特征是栗色腰臀；此外，颈圈没有金色，褐色尾羽尖端白色。繁殖季节，雄性会有锯齿状的飞行展示，并伴有规律的“zit”叫声，这也是其英文名的由来。它们在草丛中建造袋状巢穴。

Cistothorus palustris.extract: The marsh wren is a small North American songbird of the wren family. It was formerly called the long-billed marsh wren to distinguish it from the sedge wren, then known as the short-billed marsh wren.
Cistothorus palustris.title: Marsh wren

zh-CN.title: 沼泽鹪鹩
zh-CN.extract: 沼泽鹪鹩是北美的一种小型鸣禽，属于鹪鹩科。它以前被称为长嘴沼泽鹪鹩，以区别于短嘴沼泽鹪鹩（即莎草鹪鹩）。

Clamator coromandus.extract: The chestnut-winged cuckoo or red-winged crested cuckoo is a cuckoo found in Southeast Asia and parts of South Asia. It has dark glossy upperparts, a black head with long crest chestnut wings, a long graduated glossy black tail, rufous throat dusky underside and a narrow white nuchal half collar. They breed along the Himalayas and migrate south in winter to Sri Lanka, southern India and tropical Southeast Asia including parts of Indonesia, Thailand and the Philippines. It is about 47 cm (19 in) long.
Clamator coromandus.title: Chestnut-winged cuckoo

zh-CN.title: 栗翅杜鹃
zh-CN.extract: 栗翅杜鹃，或称红翅冠杜鹃，是一种分布于东南亚和南亚部分地区的杜鹃。它上体暗亮，头部黑色，有长冠羽，翅膀栗色，尾长而渐尖，黑色有光泽，喉部红褐色，下体暗色，后颈有窄的白色半领。它们沿喜马拉雅山脉繁殖，冬季南迁至斯里兰卡、印度南部和热带东南亚，包括印度尼西亚部分地区、泰国和菲律宾。体长约47厘米。

Clanga clanga.extract: The greater spotted eagle, also called the spotted eagle, is a large migratory bird of prey in the family Accipitridae.
Clanga clanga.title: Greater spotted eagle

zh-CN.title: 乌雕
zh-CN.extract: 乌雕，也称花雕，是鹰科的一种大型迁徙猛禽。

Coccothraustes vespertinus.extract: The evening grosbeak is a passerine bird in the finch family Fringillidae found in North America.
Coccothraustes vespertinus.title: Evening grosbeak

zh-CN.title: 黄昏蜡嘴雀
zh-CN.extract: 黄昏蜡嘴雀是一种雀科（Fringillidae）的雀形目鸟类，分布于北美。

Colaptes auratus.extract: The northern flicker or common flicker is a medium-sized bird of the woodpecker family. It is native to most of North America, parts of Central America, Cuba, and the Cayman Islands, and is one of the few woodpecker species that migrate. Over 100 common names for the northern flicker are known, including yellowhammer, clape, gaffer woodpecker, harry-wicket, heigh-ho, wake-up, walk-up, wick-up, yarrup, and gawker bird. Many of these names derive from attempts to imitate some of its calls.
Colaptes auratus.title: Northern flicker

zh-CN.title: 北扑翅䴕
zh-CN.extract: 北扑翅䴕或普通扑翅䴕是一种中等体型的啄木鸟科鸟类。它原产于北美大部分地区、中美洲部分地区、古巴和开曼群岛，是少数几种迁徙的啄木鸟之一。已知北扑翅䴕有超过100个常用名称，包括yellowhammer、clape、gaffer woodpecker、harry-wicket、heigh-ho、wake-up、walk-up、wick-up、yarrup和gawker bird。其中许多名称源于模仿其叫声的尝试。

Columba livia.extract: The rock dove, also known as the common pigeon or rock pigeon, is a member of the bird family Columbidae. In common usage, it is often simply referred to as the "pigeon", although the rock dove is the wild form of the bird; the pigeons familiar to most people are the domesticated forms of the wild rock dove.
Columba livia.title: Rock dove

zh-CN.title: 原鸽
zh-CN.extract: 原鸽，也称为普通鸽子或岩鸽，是鸽科（Columbidae）鸟类的一员。在常用语中，它常被简称为“鸽子”，但原鸽是这种鸟的野生形态；大多数人所熟悉的鸽子是野生原鸽的驯化形式。

Columbina passerina.extract: The common ground dove is a small bird that inhabits the southern United States, parts of Central America, the Caribbean and northern South America. It is considered to be the smallest dove that inhabits the United States. As its name suggests, the bird spends the majority of its time on the ground walking but still has the ability to fly.
Columbina passerina.title: Common ground dove

zh-CN.title: 普通地鸠
zh-CN.extract: 普通地鸠是一种小型鸟类，栖息于美国南部、中美洲部分地区、加勒比地区和南美洲北部。它被认为是栖息在美国的最小鸠鸽。顾名思义，这种鸟大部分时间都在地上行走，但仍具备飞行能力。

Contopus sordidulus.extract: The western wood pewee is a small tyrant flycatcher.
Contopus sordidulus.title: Western wood pewee

zh-CN.title: 西林鹟
zh-CN.extract: 西林鹟是一种小型霸鹟科鸟类。

Copsychus malabaricus.extract: The white-rumped shama is a passerine bird in the Old World flycatcher family Muscicapidae. Native to densely vegetated habitats in the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia, its popularity as a cage-bird and songster has led to it being introduced elsewhere. The Larwo shama, the Kangean shama and the Sri Lanka shama were formerly considered to be conspecific with the white-rumped shama.
Copsychus malabaricus.title: White-rumped shama

zh-CN.title: 白腰鹊鸲
zh-CN.extract: 白腰鹊鸲是一种鹟科（Muscicapidae）的雀形目鸟类，属于旧大陆鹟类。原产于印度次大陆和东南亚植被茂密的栖息地，因其作为笼鸟和歌手而受欢迎，已被引入其他地区。拉武鹊鸲、康厄安鹊鸲和斯里兰卡鹊鸲曾被认为是白腰鹊鸲的同种。

Copsychus saularis.extract: The Oriental magpie-robin is a small passerine bird that was formerly classed as a member of the thrush family Turdidae, but now considered an Old World flycatcher. The males are distinctive black and white birds with a long tail that is held upright as they forage on the ground or perch conspicuously. Occurring across most of the Indian subcontinent and parts of Southeast Asia, they are common birds in urban gardens as well as forests. They are particularly well known for their songs and were once popular as cagebirds.
Copsychus saularis.title: Oriental magpie-robin

zh-CN.title: 鹊鸲
zh-CN.extract: 鹊鸲是一种小型雀形目鸟类，曾归类为鸫科（Turdidae），但现在被认为是旧大陆鹟类。雄鸟是醒目的黑白相间的鸟，尾巴长，当它们在地面觅食或显眼地栖息时，尾巴会竖起。分布于印度次大陆大部分地区和东南亚部分地区，它们在城市花园和森林中都很常见。它们以歌声闻名，曾作为笼鸟流行。

Coragyps atratus.extract: The black vulture, also known as the American black vulture, Mexican vulture, zopilote, urubu, or gallinazo, is a bird in the New World vulture family whose range extends from the southeastern United States to Peru, Central Chile and Uruguay in South America, and common throughout Brazil where it can be seen in large scavenging groups. Although a common and widespread species, it has a somewhat more restricted distribution than its compatriot, the turkey vulture, which breeds well into Canada and all the way south to Tierra del Fuego. It is the only extant member of the genus Coragyps, which is in the family Cathartidae. Despite the similar name and appearance, this species is not closely related to the Eurasian black vulture, an Old World vulture, of the family Accipitridae. For ease of locating animal corpses, black vultures tend to inhabit relatively open areas with scattered trees, such as chaparral, in addition to subtropical forested areas and parts of the Brazilian pantanal.
Coragyps atratus.title: Black vulture

zh-CN.title: 黑美洲鹫
zh-CN.extract: 黑美洲鹫，也称为美国黑鹫、墨西哥鹫、zopilote、urubu或gallinazo，是新大陆秃鹫科的一种鸟类，其分布范围从美国东南部延伸至秘鲁、智利中部和乌拉圭（南美洲），在巴西也很常见，常以大型食腐群体出现。尽管是一种常见且分布广泛的物种，但其分布范围比其同伴火鸡秃鹫稍有限制，火鸡秃鹫繁殖范围远至加拿大，一直向南到火地岛。它是Cathartidae科中Coragyps属的唯一现存物种。尽管名称和外观相似，但该物种与欧亚黑鹫（一种旧大陆秃鹫，属于鹰科Accipitridae）没有密切关系。为了便于寻找动物尸体，黑美洲鹫倾向于栖息在相对开阔、有零星树木的地区，如灌木丛，以及亚热带森林地区和巴西潘塔纳尔的部分区域。

Corvus brachyrhynchos.extract: The American crow is a large passerine bird species of the family Corvidae. It is a common bird found throughout much of North America, only absent from the tundra biome. The American crow is the New World counterpart to the carrion crow and the hooded crow of Eurasia, occupying similar ecological niches.
Corvus brachyrhynchos.title: American crow

zh-CN.title: 美洲乌鸦
zh-CN.extract: 美洲乌鸦是鸦科的一种大型雀形目鸟类。它是一种常见鸟类，遍布北美大部分地区，仅缺席于冻原生物群落。美洲乌鸦是欧亚大陆的食腐乌鸦和 hooded crow 在新世界的对应物种，占据相似的生态位。

Corvus corax.extract: The common raven or northern raven is a large all-black passerine bird. It is the most widely distributed of all corvids, found across the Northern Hemisphere. There are 11 accepted subspecies with little variation in appearance, although recent research has demonstrated significant genetic differences among populations from various regions. It is one of the two largest corvids, alongside the thick-billed raven, and is the heaviest passerine bird; at maturity, the common raven averages 63 centimetres in length and 1.47 kilograms in weight, up to 2 kg (4.4 lb) in the heaviest individuals. Although their typical lifespan is considerably shorter, common ravens can live more than 23 years in the wild. Young birds may travel in flocks but later mate for life, with each mated pair defending a territory.
Corvus corax.title: Common raven

zh-CN.title: 普通渡鸦
zh-CN.extract: 普通渡鸦或北方渡鸦是一种大型全身黑色的雀形目鸟类。它是所有鸦科中分布最广的，遍布北半球。有11个公认的亚种，外观差异很小，尽管最近的研究表明不同地区的种群之间存在显著的遗传差异。它是两种最大的鸦科鸟类之一（另一种是厚嘴渡鸦），也是体型最重的雀形目鸟类；成熟时，普通渡鸦平均体长63厘米，体重1.47公斤，最重的个体可达2公斤。虽然它们的典型寿命要短得多，但普通渡鸦在野外可以活超过23年。幼鸟可能会成群旅行，但后来会终生配对，每对配偶会保卫领地。

Corvus frugilegus.extract: The rook is a member of the family Corvidae in the passerine order of birds. It is found in the Palearctic, its range extending from Scandinavia and western Europe to eastern Siberia. It is a large, gregarious, black-feathered bird, distinguished from similar species by the whitish featherless area on the face. Rooks nest collectively in the tops of tall trees, often close to farms or villages; the groups of nests are known as rookeries.
Corvus frugilegus.title: Rook (bird)

zh-CN.title: 秃鼻乌鸦
zh-CN.extract: 秃鼻乌鸦是雀形目鸦科鸦属的一种鸟类。分布于古北界，其范围从斯堪的纳维亚和西欧一直延伸到东西伯利亚。它是一种大型、群居、黑色羽毛的鸟类，与相似物种的区别在于面部无羽毛的白色区域。秃鼻乌鸦在高大树木的顶部群居筑巢，通常靠近农场或村庄；这些巢群被称为秃鼻乌鸦群栖地。

Corvus macrorhynchos.extract: The large-billed crow, formerly referred to widely as the jungle crow, is a widespread Asian species of crow. It is very adaptable and is able to survive on a wide range of food sources, making it capable of colonizing new areas, due to which it is often considered a nuisance, especially on islands. It has a large bill, which is the source of its scientific name macrorhynchos and it is sometimes known by the common name thick-billed crow. It can also be mistaken for a common raven. The eastern jungle crow and Indian jungle crow were once considered conspecific and together called the jungle crow.
Corvus macrorhynchos.title: Large-billed crow

zh-CN.title: 大嘴乌鸦
zh-CN.extract: 大嘴乌鸦，以前常被称为丛林鸦，是一种广泛分布的亚洲鸦种。它适应性很强，能够依赖多种食物来源生存，因此能够开拓新区域，常被视为一种害鸟，尤其是在岛屿上。它有一个大嘴，这也是其学名 macrorhynchos 的由来，有时也被称为厚嘴乌鸦。它也可能被误认为是普通渡鸦。东部丛林鸦和印度丛林鸦曾被视为同种，并统称为丛林鸦。

Corvus splendens.extract: The house crow, also known as the Indian, greynecked, Ceylon or Colombo crow, is a common bird of the crow family that is of Asian origin but now found in many parts of the world, where they arrived assisted by shipping. It is between the jackdaw and the carrion crow in size but is slimmer than either. The forehead, crown, throat and upper breast are a richly glossed black, whilst the neck and breast are a lighter grey-brown in colour. The wings, tail and legs are black. There are regional variations in the thickness of the bill and the depth of colour in areas of the plumage.
Corvus splendens.title: House crow

zh-CN.title: 家鸦
zh-CN.extract: 家鸦，也被称为印度鸦、灰颈鸦、锡兰鸦或科伦坡鸦，是鸦科的一种常见鸟类，原产于亚洲，但现在借助航运出现在世界许多地方。其体型介于寒鸦和食腐乌鸦之间，但比两者更修长。前额、头顶、喉咙和上胸呈浓亮黑色，而颈部和胸部颜色较浅，为灰褐色。翅膀、尾巴和腿为黑色。不同地区的喙厚度和羽毛区域的颜色深度存在差异。

Coturnix japonica.extract: The Japanese quail, also known as the coturnix quail, is a species of Old World quail found in East Asia. First considered a subspecies of the common quail, it is now considered as a separate species. The Japanese quail has played an active role in the lives of humanity since the 12th century, and continues to play major roles in industry and scientific research. Where it is found, the species is abundant across most of its range. Currently, there are a few true breeding mutations of the Japanese quail. The varieties currently found in the United States include Pharaoh, Italian, Manchurian, Tibetan, Rosetta, along with the following mutations: sex-linked brown, fee, roux, silver, andalusian, blue/blau, white winged pied, progressive pied, albino, calico, sparkly, as well as non-color mutations such as celadon, which lay blue-tinted eggs.
Coturnix japonica.title: Japanese quail

zh-CN.title: 日本鹌鹑
zh-CN.extract: 日本鹌鹑，也称为 coturnix 鹌鹑，是一种分布于东亚的古北界鹌鹑物种。最初被认为是普通鹌鹑的一个亚种，现在被视为一个独立物种。自12世纪以来，日本鹌鹑在人类生活中发挥了积极作用，并继续在工业和科学研究中扮演重要角色。在其分布区域，该物种在其大部分范围内数量丰富。目前，日本鹌鹑有少数几种纯种突变。目前在美国发现的品种包括法老、意大利、满洲、西藏、罗塞塔，以及以下突变：性连锁棕色、fee、rux、银色、安达卢西亚、蓝色/blau、白翅花斑、渐进花斑、白化、花斑、闪光，以及非颜色突变如 celadon（产蓝色调蛋）。

Crithagra mozambica.extract: The yellow-fronted canary is a small passerine bird in the finch family. It is sometimes known in aviculture as the green singing finch or the green singer.
Crithagra mozambica.title: Yellow-fronted canary

zh-CN.title: 黄额丝雀
zh-CN.extract: 黄额丝雀是雀科的一种小型雀形目鸟类。在鸟类饲养中，它有时被称为绿歌雀或绿歌手。

Cuculus canorus.extract: The cuckoo, common cuckoo, European cuckoo or Eurasian cuckoo is a member of the cuckoo order of birds, Cuculiformes, which includes the roadrunners, the anis and the coucals.
Cuculus canorus.title: Common cuckoo

zh-CN.title: 大杜鹃
zh-CN.extract: 杜鹃、大杜鹃、欧洲杜鹃或欧亚杜鹃是杜鹃目杜鹃科的成员，该目包括走鹃、犀鹃和地鹃。

Cuculus micropterus.extract: The  Indian cuckoo or short-winged cuckoo is a member of the cuckoo order of birds, the Cuculiformes, that is found in the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia. It ranges from India, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Nepal and Sri Lanka east to Indonesia and north to China and Russia. It is a solitary and shy bird, found in forests and open woodland at up to 3,600 m (11,800 ft).
Cuculus micropterus.title: Indian cuckoo

zh-CN.title: 印度杜鹃
zh-CN.extract: 印度杜鹃或短翅杜鹃是杜鹃目鸟类的一种，分布于印度次大陆和东南亚。其分布范围从印度、孟加拉国、不丹、尼泊尔和斯里兰卡向东至印度尼西亚，向北至中国和俄罗斯。它是一种独居且害羞的鸟类，栖息于森林和开阔林地，海拔高达3,600米（11,800英尺）。

Cuculus optatus.extract: The Oriental cuckoo or Horsfield's cuckoo is a bird belonging to the genus Cuculus in the cuckoo family Cuculidae. It was formerly classified as a subspecies of the Himalayan cuckoo, with the name 'Oriental cuckoo' used for the combined species. Differences in voice and size suggest that it should be treated as a separate species. The binomial name Cuculus horsfieldi has often been used instead of Cuculus optatus, but is now usually considered to be a junior synonym.
Cuculus optatus.title: Oriental cuckoo

zh-CN.title: 东方杜鹃
zh-CN.extract: 东方杜鹃或霍氏杜鹃是杜鹃属的一种鸟类。它曾被视为喜马拉雅杜鹃的一个亚种，当时“东方杜鹃”这一名称用于合并种。声音和体型上的差异表明它应被视为独立物种。双名法Cuculus horsfieldi常被用来代替Cuculus optatus，但现在通常被认为是次定同物异名。

Cyanocitta stelleri.extract: Steller's jay is a bird native to western North America and the mountains of Central America, closely related to the blue jay found in eastern North America. It is the only crested jay west of the Rocky Mountains. It is also sometimes colloquially called a "blue jay" in the Pacific Northwest, but is distinct from the blue jay of eastern North America. The species inhabits pine-oak and coniferous forests.
Cyanocitta stelleri.title: Steller's jay

zh-CN.title: 斯氏鸦
zh-CN.extract: 斯氏鸦是一种原产于北美西部和中美洲山区的鸟类，与北美洲东部发现的蓝鸦亲缘关系密切。它是落基山脉以西唯一有冠的鸦。在太平洋西北地区，它也常被俗称为“蓝鸦”，但与北美东部的蓝鸦不同。该物种栖息于松栎林和针叶林。

Cygnus buccinator.extract: The trumpeter swan, or simply the trumpeter, is a species of swan found in North America. The heaviest living bird native to North America, it is also the largest extant species of waterfowl, with a wingspan of 185 to 304.8 cm. It is the American counterpart and a close relative of the whooper swan of Eurasia and has even been considered the same species by some authorities. By 1933, fewer than 70 wild individuals were known to exist; extinction seemed imminent until aerial surveys discovered a Pacific population of several thousand trumpeter swans around Alaska's Copper River. Careful reintroductions by wildlife agencies and the Trumpeter Swan Society gradually restored the North American wild population to over 46,000 birds by 2010.
Cygnus buccinator.title: Trumpeter swan

zh-CN.title: 号手天鹅
zh-CN.extract: 号手天鹅，或简称为号手，是一种发现于北美洲的天鹅。它是北美洲最重的原生鸟类，也是现存最大的水禽，翼展为185至304.8厘米。它是欧亚大陆大天鹅的美洲对应种和近亲，甚至曾被一些权威认为是同一物种。到1933年，已知的野生个体不到70只；灭绝似乎迫在眉睫，直到空中调查发现阿拉斯加铜河附近有数千只号手天鹅的太平洋种群。通过野生动物机构和号手天鹅协会的谨慎重新引入，到2010年，北美野生种群逐渐恢复到超过46,000只。

Cypseloides niger.extract: The American black swift, or more simply black swift, is a species of bird that is found from northern British Columbia in Canada through the United States and Mexico to Costa Rica and Brazil. They are also found in the Caribbean.
Cypseloides niger.title: American black swift

zh-CN.title: 美洲黑雨燕
zh-CN.extract: 美洲黑雨燕，或更简单地称为黑雨燕，是一种从加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省北部，经美国和墨西哥到哥斯达黎加和巴西发现的鸟类。它们也见于加勒比地区。

Dryobates nuttallii.extract: Nuttall's woodpecker is a species of woodpecker named after naturalist Thomas Nuttall in 1843. They are found in oak woodlands of California and are similar to the ladder-backed woodpecker in both genetics and appearance.
Dryobates nuttallii.title: Nuttall's woodpecker

zh-CN.title: 纳氏啄木鸟
zh-CN.extract: 纳氏啄木鸟是一种以博物学家托马斯·纳托尔命名的啄木鸟物种，命名于1843年。它们发现于加利福尼亚的橡树林，在遗传和外观上与梯背啄木鸟相似。

Dryobates pubescens.extract: The downy woodpecker is a species of woodpecker, the smallest in North America. Length ranges from 14 to 18 cm. Downy woodpeckers primarily live in forested areas throughout the United States and Canada, with the exception of deserts in the southwest and the northern tundra. The bird nests in tree cavities and feeds primarily on insects, although it supplements its diet with seeds and berries. The downy woodpecker is very similar in appearance to the hairy woodpecker, although they are not closely related.
Dryobates pubescens.title: Downy woodpecker

zh-CN.title: 绒啄木鸟
zh-CN.extract: 绒啄木鸟是一种啄木鸟，是北美最小的啄木鸟。体长范围为14到18厘米。绒啄木鸟主要生活在美国和加拿大的森林地区，除了西南部的沙漠和北部的冻原。该鸟在树洞中筑巢，主要以昆虫为食，但也补充种子和浆果。绒啄木鸟在外观上与长嘴啄木鸟非常相似，尽管它们亲缘关系并不近。

Dryobates villosus.extract: The hairy woodpecker is a medium-sized woodpecker that is found over a large area of North America. It is approximately 250 mm (9.8 in) in length with a 380 mm (15 in) wingspan. With an estimated population in 2020 of almost nine million individuals, the hairy woodpecker is listed by the IUCN as a species of least concern. The species was previously placed in the genus Dryobates.
Dryobates villosus.title: Hairy woodpecker

zh-CN.title: 长嘴啄木鸟
zh-CN.extract: 长嘴啄木鸟是一种中型啄木鸟，分布在北美洲的广大区域。它的长度约为250毫米（9.8英寸），翼展为380毫米（15英寸）。2020年估计种群数量近九百万只，长嘴啄木鸟被IUCN列为无危物种。该物种之前曾被归入Dryobates属。

Dryocopus pileatus.extract: The pileated woodpecker is a large, crow-sized woodpecker with a prominent red crest, white neck stripe, and a mostly black body and most grow up to 3 feet tall. This woodpecker is native to North America, where it is the largest confirmed extant woodpecker species and the third-largest extant species of woodpecker in the world, after the great slaty woodpecker and the black woodpecker. It inhabits deciduous forests in eastern North America, the Great Lakes, the boreal forests of Canada, and parts of the Pacific Coast. This woodpecker is primarily an insectivore, eating insects that live in trees; it is famous for making large, nearly rectangular carvings into trees, which are used to extract prey inside the tree or to make a nest. The species has a large range and an increasing population, causing it to be categorized as a species of "least concern" by the IUCN.
Dryocopus pileatus.title: Pileated woodpecker

zh-CN.title: 北美黑啄木鸟
zh-CN.extract: 北美黑啄木鸟是一种大型、乌鸦大小的啄木鸟，具有显眼的红色羽冠、白色颈纹和几乎全黑的躯体，大多数可长到3英尺高。这种啄木鸟原产于北美，是当地现存最大的确认啄木鸟物种，也是世界上第三大现存啄木鸟物种，仅次于大灰啄木鸟和黑啄木鸟。它栖息于北美东部的落叶林、五大湖区、加拿大的北方森林以及太平洋沿岸的部分地区。这种啄木鸟主要以昆虫为食，捕食树木中的昆虫；它以在树上制造近乎矩形的大型凿痕而闻名，这些凿痕用于提取树内的猎物或筑巢。该物种分布范围广泛且种群数量正在增长，因此被国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）列为“无危”物种。

Egretta caerulea.extract: The little blue heron is a small heron of the genus Egretta. It is a small, darkly colored heron with a two-toned bill. Juveniles are entirely white, bearing resemblance to the snowy egret. During the breeding season, adults develop different coloration on the head, legs, and feet.
Egretta caerulea.title: Little blue heron

zh-CN.title: 小蓝鹭
zh-CN.extract: 小蓝鹭是白鹭属的一种小型鹭鸟。它是一种体型小巧、颜色深暗的鹭，喙部呈双色调。幼鸟全身白色，与雪鹭相似。在繁殖季节，成鸟的头部、腿部和脚部会出现不同的颜色。

Egretta thula.extract: The snowy egret is a small white heron. The genus name comes from Provençal French for the little egret, aigrette, which is a diminutive of aigron, 'heron'. The species name thula is the Mapudungun term for the black-necked swan, applied to this species in error by Chilean naturalist Juan Ignacio Molina in 1782.
Egretta thula.title: Snowy egret

zh-CN.title: 雪鹭
zh-CN.extract: 雪鹭是一种小型白色鹭鸟。属名源自普罗旺斯法语中表示小白鹭的词语“aigrette”，它是“aigron”（意为鹭）的指小词。种名“thula”是马普切语中黑颈天鹅的名称，由智利博物学家胡安·伊格纳西奥·莫利纳于1782年错误地用于该物种。

Elanus leucurus.extract: The white-tailed kite is a small raptor found in western North America and parts of South America. It replaces the related Old World black-winged kite in its native range.
Elanus leucurus.title: White-tailed kite

zh-CN.title: 白尾鸢
zh-CN.extract: 白尾鸢是一种小型猛禽，分布于北美西部和南美洲部分地区。它在原生分布区取代了相关的旧大陆黑翅鸢。

Empidonax difficilis.extract: The western flycatcher is a small insectivorous bird in the family Tyrannidae. It is native to western North America, where it breeds in the Rocky Mountains and Pacific Coast forests and mountain ranges from California to Alaska and south to central Mexico; northern populations migrate south to Mexico for the winter.
Empidonax difficilis.title: Western flycatcher

zh-CN.title: 西部鹟
zh-CN.extract: 西部鹟是霸鹟科的一种小型食虫鸟类。它原产于北美西部，繁殖于落基山脉和太平洋沿岸森林，从加利福尼亚州到阿拉斯加州以及向南至墨西哥中部的山脉；北部种群会迁徙到墨西哥过冬。

Empidonax hammondii.extract: Hammond's flycatcher is a flycatcher in the family Tyrannidae. This small insectivorous bird inhabits the coniferous and mixed forests of western North America. The name of this bird commemorates William Alexander Hammond who was the surgeon general of the US Army. Hammond collected bird specimens for Spencer Fullerton Baird.
Empidonax hammondii.title: Hammond's flycatcher

zh-CN.title: 哈氏鹟
zh-CN.extract: 哈氏鹟是霸鹟科的一种鹟鸟。这种小型食虫鸟类栖息于北美西部的针叶林和混交林中。这种鸟的名字是为了纪念美国陆军军医总监威廉·亚历山大·哈蒙德。哈蒙德曾为斯宾塞·富勒顿·贝尔德收集鸟类标本。

Empidonax oberholseri.extract: The American dusky flycatcher, or simply dusky flycatcher, is a small insectivorous passerine of the tyrant flycatcher family.
Empidonax oberholseri.title: American dusky flycatcher

zh-CN.title: 美洲暗鹟
zh-CN.extract: 美洲暗鹟，或简称暗鹟，是霸鹟科的一种小型食虫鸣禽。

Empidonax traillii.extract: The willow flycatcher is a small insect-eating, migrant bird of the tyrant flycatcher family native to North America.
Empidonax traillii.title: Willow flycatcher

zh-CN.title: 柳鹟
zh-CN.extract: 柳鹟是一种小型食虫性候鸟，属于霸鹟科，原产于北美。

Empidonax wrightii.extract: The American gray flycatcher, American grey flycatcher, or just gray flycatcher as it is known in North America, is a small, insectivorous passerine in the tyrant flycatcher family. It is common in the arid regions of western North America, especially the Great Basin. From sagebrush steppes to pinyon-juniper woodlands and ponderosa pine forests, this flycatcher forages for insects from shrubs or low tree branches.
Empidonax wrightii.title: American gray flycatcher

zh-CN.title: 美国灰鹟
zh-CN.extract: 美国灰鹟（American gray flycatcher），在北美洲常简称为灰鹟（gray flycatcher），是一种小型食虫性雀形目鸟类，属于霸鹟科。常见于北美洲西部的干旱地区，尤其是大盆地。从蒿草草原到矮松-杜松林地及黄松林，这种鹟常在灌木或低矮树枝上觅食昆虫。

Eremophila alpestris.extract: The horned lark or shore lark is a species of lark in the family Alaudidae found across the northern hemisphere. It is known as "horned lark" in North America for distinctive feathers on the heads of the male birds in summer, and as "shore lark" in Europe because it can be found on shorelines in the winter.
Eremophila alpestris.title: Horned lark

zh-CN.title: 角百灵
zh-CN.extract: 角百灵（horned lark）或 shore lark 是百灵科的一种鸟类，分布于北半球。在北美洲因其雄性夏季头部独特的羽毛而被称为“角百灵”，在欧洲则因其冬季可在海岸线发现而被称为“shore lark”。

Euphagus cyanocephalus.extract: Brewer's blackbird is a medium-sized New World blackbird. It is named after the ornithologist Thomas Mayo Brewer.
Euphagus cyanocephalus.title: Brewer's blackbird

zh-CN.title: 布氏黑鹂
zh-CN.extract: 布氏黑鹂（Brewer's blackbird）是一种中等体型的新大陆黑鹂。以鸟类学家托马斯·梅奥·布鲁尔命名。

Falco columbarius.extract: The merlin is a small species of falcon from the Northern Hemisphere, with numerous subspecies throughout North America and Eurasia. A bird of prey, the merlin breeds in the northern Holarctic; some migrate to subtropical and northern tropical regions in winter. Males typically have wingspans of 53–58 centimetres (21–23 in), with females being slightly larger. They are swift fliers and skilled hunters which specialize in preying on small birds in the size range of sparrows to doves and medium-sized shorebirds. In recent decades merlin populations in North America have been significantly increasing, with some merlins becoming so well adapted to city life that they forgo migration; in Europe, populations increased up to about 2000 but have been steady subsequently. The merlin has for centuries been well regarded as a falconry bird.
Falco columbarius.title: Merlin (bird)

zh-CN.title: 灰背隼
zh-CN.extract: 灰背隼（merlin）是北半球的一种小型隼，在北美和欧亚大陆有多个亚种。作为一种猛禽，灰背隼在北极北部地区繁殖；部分个体会在冬季迁徙至亚热带和北部热带地区。雄鸟翼展通常为53–58厘米，雌鸟略大。它们飞行迅速，是熟练的猎手，专门捕食麻雀到鸽子大小的小型鸟类以及中等体型的涉禽。近几十年来，北美洲的灰背隼数量明显增加，有些个体甚至适应城市生活而放弃迁徙；在欧洲，数量至2000年左右有所增长，随后趋于稳定。灰背隼几个世纪以来一直被视为优秀的猎隼。

Falco mexicanus.extract: The prairie falcon is a medium-sized falcon found in Western North America. A separate species from the peregrine falcon, with which it shares some visual similarities, the prairie falcon is, essentially, an arid-climate divergence of earlier peregrine falcon lineage. It is thus able to thrive on a more meager, opportunistic diet compared to that of the peregrine, and is generally lighter in weight than a peregrine of similar wingspan. Having evolved in harsher and desert environments, often with low prey density, the prairie falcon has developed into an aggressive and opportunistic hunter of a wide range of both mammalian and avian prey, as well as occasional reptiles. It will regularly take prey from the size of sparrows or finches to birds approximately its own weight, and occasionally much larger.
Falco mexicanus.title: Prairie falcon

zh-CN.title: 草原隼
zh-CN.extract: 草原隼（prairie falcon）是分布于北美洲西部的一种中型隼。它与游隼是不同物种，但外观上有相似之处。草原隼本质上是早期游隼谱系适应干旱气候的分支。因此，与游隼相比，它能以更贫乏、机会主义的食物为生，且体重通常比相同翼展的游隼更轻。由于在更严酷的沙漠环境中进化，通常猎物密度低，草原隼已成为一种攻击性强的机会主义猎手，捕食范围广泛的哺乳动物、鸟类以及偶尔的爬行动物。它经常捕食从麻雀或雀类大小到与其自身重量相当的鸟类，有时甚至更大。

Falco peregrinus.extract: The peregrine falcon, also referred to simply as the peregrine, is a bird of prey (raptor) in the family Falconidae known for its speed. A large, crow-sized falcon, it has a blue-grey back, barred white underparts and a black head. As is typical for bird-eating (avivore) raptors, peregrine falcons are sexually dimorphic, with females being considerably larger than males. Historically, the bird has also been known as the "black-cheeked falcon" in Australia and the "duck hawk" in North America.
Falco peregrinus.title: Peregrine falcon

zh-CN.title: 游隼
zh-CN.extract: 游隼（peregrine falcon），常简称为 peregrine，是隼科的一种猛禽，以其速度著称。它是一种大型、乌鸦大小的隼，背部蓝灰色，腹部白色带横纹，头部黑色。与典型的食鸟猛禽一样，游隼具有性别二态性，雌鸟远大于雄鸟。历史上，在澳大利亚被称为“黑颊隼”，在北美洲被称为“鸭鹰”。

Falco sparverius.extract: The American kestrel is the smallest and most common falcon in North America. Though it has been called the American sparrowhawk, this common name is a misnomer; the American kestrel is a true falcon, while neither the Eurasian sparrowhawk nor the other species called sparrowhawks are in the Falconidae family, hence only very distantly related to the American kestrel. It has a roughly two-to-one range in size over subspecies and sex, varying in size from about the weight of a blue jay to a mourning dove. It also ranges to South America and is a well-established species that has evolved into 17 subspecies adapted to different environments and habitats throughout the Americas. It exhibits sexual dimorphism in size and plumage, although both sexes have a rufous back with noticeable barring. Its plumage is colorful and attractive, and juveniles are similar in plumage to adults.
Falco sparverius.title: American kestrel

zh-CN.title: 美洲隼
zh-CN.extract: 美洲隼（American kestrel）是北美洲最小且最常见的隼。尽管曾被称为“美洲雀鹰”，但这一俗名是个误称；美洲隼是真正的隼，而欧亚雀鹰及其他被称为雀鹰的物种并不属于隼科，因此与美洲隼的亲缘关系甚远。不同亚种和性别之间体型差异约为二比一，大小从蓝松鸦到哀鸽的重量不等。它也分布至南美洲，是一种已形成17个亚种的稳定物种，适应美洲各地的不同环境和栖息地。它在体型和羽毛上表现出性别二态性，但两性背部均为红褐色且带有明显斑纹。其羽毛色彩鲜艳，幼鸟羽毛与成鸟相似。

Gavia immer.extract: The common loon or great northern diver is a large member of the loon, or diver, family of birds. Breeding adults have a plumage that includes a broad black head and neck with a greenish, purplish, or bluish sheen, blackish or blackish-grey upperparts, and pure white underparts except some black on the undertail coverts and vent. Non-breeding adults are brownish with a dark neck and head marked with dark grey-brown. Their upperparts are dark brownish-grey with an unclear pattern of squares on the shoulders, and the underparts, lower face, chin, and throat are whitish. The sexes look alike, though males are significantly heavier than females. During the breeding season, loons live on lakes and other waterways in Canada, the northern United States, and southern parts of Greenland and Iceland. Small numbers breed on Svalbard and sporadically elsewhere in Arctic Eurasia. Common loons winter on both coasts of North America as far north as Newfoundland and Alaska, and as far south as Mexico, as well as on the Atlantic coast of Europe.
Gavia immer.title: Common loon

zh-CN.title: 普通潜鸟
zh-CN.extract: 普通潜鸟（common loon）或 great northern diver 是潜鸟科的一种大型鸟类。繁殖期成鸟的羽毛包括宽大的黑色头部和颈部，带有绿色、紫色或蓝色光泽；上体黑色或黑灰色；下体纯白色，但尾下覆羽和泄殖腔处有部分黑色。非繁殖期成鸟呈褐色，颈部和头部暗色并带有深灰褐色斑纹。上体暗灰褐色，肩部有不清晰的方形图案；下体、下脸、颏和喉部白色。两性外观相似，但雄性显著重于雌性。繁殖季节，潜鸟生活在加拿大、美国北部以及格陵兰和冰岛南部的湖泊和其他水域。少量在斯瓦尔巴群岛和欧亚北极其他地区零星繁殖。普通潜鸟冬季分布于北美两岸，北至纽芬兰和阿拉斯加，南至墨西哥，以及欧洲大西洋沿岸。

Geothlypis tolmiei.extract: MacGillivray's warbler is a species of New World warbler. These birds are sluggish and heavy warblers, preferring to spend most of their time on, or near the ground, except when singing.
Geothlypis tolmiei.title: MacGillivray's warbler

zh-CN.title: 麦氏黄喉地莺
zh-CN.extract: 麦氏黄喉地莺是一种新世界莺科鸟类。这种鸟行动迟缓、体型较重，除鸣叫时外，更倾向于在地面或近地面处活动。

Geothlypis trichas.extract: The common yellowthroat is a New World warbler. It is an abundant breeder in North America, ranging from southern Canada to central Mexico. In the northern parts of its range the birds are migratory, wintering in the southern parts of the breeding range, Central America and the West Indies. Southern forms are largely resident. Historically, it has also been known as the "yellow bandit", Maryland yellow-throat, and yellow-breasted warbler.
Geothlypis trichas.title: Common yellowthroat

zh-CN.title: 普通黄喉地莺
zh-CN.extract: 普通黄喉地莺是一种新世界莺科鸟类。它在北美地区繁殖数量丰富，分布范围从加拿大南部至墨西哥中部。在其分布区的北部，这些鸟是候鸟，冬季在繁殖区南部、中美洲和西印度群岛越冬。南方的种群大部分为留鸟。历史上，它也被称为“黄色强盗”、马里兰黄喉莺和黄胸莺。

Glaucidium gnoma.extract: The mountain pygmy owl, or northern pygmy owl, is a small species of owl from the family Strigidae. They reside throughout southern Arizona, New Mexico and Mexico.
Glaucidium gnoma.title: Mountain pygmy owl

zh-CN.title: 山鸺鹠
zh-CN.extract: 山鸺鹠，也称北方鸺鹠，是鸱鸮科的一种小型猫头鹰。它们栖息于美国亚利桑那州南部、新墨西哥州和墨西哥。

Gymnogyps californianus.extract: The California condor is a New World vulture and the largest North American land bird. It became extinct in the wild in 1987 when all remaining wild individuals were captured, but has since been reintroduced to northern Arizona and southern Utah, the coastal mountains of California, and northern Baja California in Mexico. It is the only surviving member of the genus Gymnogyps, although four extinct members of the genus are also known. The species is listed by IUCN as critically endangered, and similarly considered Critically Imperiled by NatureServe.
Gymnogyps californianus.title: California condor

zh-CN.title: 加州神鹫
zh-CN.extract: 加州神鹫是一种新世界秃鹫，也是北美最大的陆栖鸟类。它于1987年在野外灭绝，当时所有剩余的野生个体均被捕获，但此后已被重新引入亚利桑那州北部和犹他州南部、加利福尼亚州的沿海山脉以及墨西哥的下加利福尼亚州北部。它是Gymnogyps属唯一存活的成员，尽管该属还有四个已知的灭绝物种。该物种被世界自然保护联盟列为极危物种，并被NatureServe同样视为极危物种。

Haemorhous mexicanus.extract: The house finch is a North American bird in the finch family. It is native to Mexico and southwestern United States, but has since been introduced to the eastern part of North America and Hawaiʻi; it is now found year-round in almost all parts of the United States and most of Mexico, with breeding grounds well into Canada as far north as northern Alberta. There are estimated to be 40 million house finches across North America, making it the second-most populous finch, just behind the American goldfinch. The house finch and the other two American rosefinches are placed in the genus Haemorhous.
Haemorhous mexicanus.title: House finch

zh-CN.title: 家朱雀
zh-CN.extract: 家朱雀是雀科的一种北美鸟类。它原产于墨西哥和美国西南部，但后来被引入北美东部和夏威夷；如今全年几乎遍布美国所有地区和墨西哥大部分地区，繁殖范围远至加拿大北部，直至艾伯塔省北部。据估计，北美有4000万只家朱雀，使其成为数量第二多的雀类，仅次于美洲金翅雀。家朱雀和其他两种美洲朱雀被归入Haemorhous属。

Haemorhous purpureus.extract: The purple finch is a bird in the finch family, Fringillidae. It breeds in the northern United States, southern Canada, and the west coast of North America.
Haemorhous purpureus.title: Purple finch

zh-CN.title: 紫朱雀
zh-CN.extract: 紫朱雀是雀科（Fringillidae）的一种鸟类。它在美国北部、加拿大南部和北美西海岸繁殖。

Haliaeetus leucocephalus.extract: The bald eagle is a bird of prey found in North America. A sea eagle, it has two known subspecies and forms a species pair with the white-tailed eagle, which occupies the same niche as the bald eagle in the Palearctic. Its range includes most of Canada and Alaska, all of the contiguous United States, and northern Mexico. It is found near large bodies of open water with an abundant food supply and old-growth trees for nesting.
Haliaeetus leucocephalus.title: Bald eagle

zh-CN.title: 白头海雕
zh-CN.extract: 白头海雕是一种发现于北美的猛禽。作为一种海雕，它有两个已知亚种，并与白尾海雕形成一对物种，后者在古北界占据与白头海雕相同的生态位。其分布范围包括加拿大和阿拉斯加的大部分地区、美国本土全部以及墨西哥北部。它常见于拥有丰富食物来源和用于筑巢的古树的大型开阔水域附近。

Himantopus mexicanus.extract: The black-necked stilt, also called the pied stilt, is a locally abundant shorebird of North and South American wetlands and coastlines. It is found from the coastal areas of California through much of the interior western United States and along the Gulf of Mexico as far east as Florida, then south through Central America and the Caribbean to Brazil, Peru and the Galápagos Islands, with an isolated population, the Hawaiian stilt, in Hawaii. The northernmost populations, particularly those from inland, are migratory, wintering from the extreme south of the United States to southern Mexico, rarely as far south as Costa Rica; on the Baja California peninsula it is only found regularly in winter. Some authorities, including the IUCN, treat it as a synonym of Himantopus himantopus.
Himantopus mexicanus.title: Black-necked stilt

zh-CN.title: 黑颈长脚鹬
zh-CN.extract: 黑颈长脚鹬，也称为斑长脚鹬，是北美和南美湿地及海岸线一种局部丰富的滨鸟。它分布于加利福尼亚州沿海地区，穿过美国西部内陆大部分地区，沿墨西哥湾东至佛罗里达州，然后向南经过中美洲和加勒比地区至巴西、秘鲁和加拉帕戈斯群岛，并在夏威夷有一个孤立种群，即夏威夷长脚鹬。最北部的种群，尤其是内陆种群，是候鸟，冬季从美国最南部到墨西哥南部，罕见南至哥斯达黎加；在下加利福尼亚半岛仅定期在冬季出现。一些权威机构，包括世界自然保护联盟，将其视为黑翅长脚鹬（Himantopus himantopus）的同义词。

Hirundo rustica.extract: The barn swallow is the most widespread species of swallow in the world, occurring on all continents, with vagrants reported even in Antarctica. It is a distinctive passerine bird with blue upperparts and a long, deeply forked tail. In Anglophone Europe, it is just called the swallow; in northern Europe, it is the only member of family Hirundinidae called a "swallow" rather than a "martin".
Hirundo rustica.title: Barn swallow

zh-CN.title: 家燕
zh-CN.extract: 家燕是世界上分布最广的燕子种类，遍布各大洲，甚至在南极洲也有迷鸟记录。它是一种独特的雀形目鸟类，上身蓝色，尾巴长且深叉。在英语欧洲，它直接被称为swallow；在北欧，它是燕科中唯一被称为"swallow"而非"martin"的成员。

Hydroprogne caspia.extract: The Caspian tern is the world's largest species of tern, with a subcosmopolitan but scattered distribution. Despite its extensive range, it is monotypic of its genus, and has no accepted subspecies. The genus name is from Ancient Greek hudro-, "water-", and Latin progne, "swallow". The specific caspia is from Latin and, like the English name, refers to the Caspian Sea.
Hydroprogne caspia.title: Caspian tern

zh-CN.title: 红嘴巨鸥
zh-CN.extract: 红嘴巨鸥是世界上体型最大的鸥类，分布广泛但不连续。尽管分布范围广阔，但它属于单型属，没有公认的亚种。属名来自古希腊语hudro-（水）和拉丁语progne（燕子）。种加词caspia来自拉丁语，像英文名一样指里海。

Icteria virens.extract: The yellow-breasted chat is a large songbird in the New World blackbirds family Icteridae that is found in North and Central America. It has sometimes been placed in its own family Icteriidae and in the New World warbler family Parulidae.
Icteria virens.title: Yellow-breasted chat

zh-CN.title: 黄胸大䳭
zh-CN.extract: 黄胸大䳭是一种大型鸣禽，属于新大陆黑鹂科拟黄鹂科，分布于北美和中美洲。它有时被归入自己的科Icteriidae，或新大陆莺科Parulidae。

Icterus bullockii.extract: Bullock's oriole is a small New World blackbird. At one time, this species and the Baltimore oriole were considered to be a single species, the northern oriole. This bird is named after William Bullock, an English amateur naturalist.
Icterus bullockii.title: Bullock's oriole

zh-CN.title: 布洛克拟黄鹂
zh-CN.extract: 布洛克拟黄鹂是一种小型新大陆黑鹂。曾一度与巴尔的摩拟黄鹂被视为同一物种，即北方拟黄鹂。这种鸟以英国业余博物学家威廉·布洛克命名。

Icterus cucullatus.extract: The hooded oriole is a medium-sized New World oriole. The male of this species ranges in color from a bright orange to a paler yellow, with a black back, face, tail and bib, with the wing containing two white bars. The female is more of an olive color with some yellow accents.
Icterus cucullatus.title: Hooded oriole

zh-CN.title: 巾冠拟黄鹂
zh-CN.extract: 巾冠拟黄鹂是一种中等体型的新大陆拟黄鹂。该物种的雄性颜色从亮橙色到淡黄色不等，背部、脸部、尾巴和围兜为黑色，翅膀上有两条白色条纹。雌性更多为橄榄色，带有一些黄色点缀。

Icterus galbula.extract: The Baltimore oriole is a small icterid blackbird common in eastern North America as a migratory breeding bird. It received its name from the resemblance of the male's colors to those on the coat-of-arms of 17th-century Lord Baltimore. Observations of interbreeding between the Baltimore oriole and the western Bullock's oriole Icterus bullockii, led to both being classified as a single species, called the northern oriole, from 1973 to 1995. Research by James Rising, a professor of zoology at the University of Toronto, and others showed that the two birds actually did not interbreed significantly.
Icterus galbula.title: Baltimore oriole

zh-CN.title: 巴尔的摩拟黄鹂
zh-CN.extract: 巴尔的摩拟黄鹂是一种小型拟黄鹂科黑鹂，常见于北美东部，是一种迁徙繁殖鸟。其名字来源于雄鸟的颜色与17世纪巴尔的摩勋爵盾徽上的颜色相似。对巴尔的摩拟黄鹂与西部布洛克拟黄鹂（Icterus bullockii）杂交的观察导致两者从1973年到1995年被归类为同一物种，称为北方拟黄鹂。多伦多大学动物学教授詹姆斯·赖辛等人的研究表明，这两种鸟实际上并没有明显的杂交。

Icterus parisorum.extract: The Scott's oriole is a medium-sized icterid. The male of this species is bright yellow and black; the female is similar, but with more muted colors.
Icterus parisorum.title: Scott's oriole

zh-CN.title: 斯科特拟黄鹂
zh-CN.extract: 斯科特拟黄鹂是一种中等体型的拟黄鹂科鸟类。该物种的雄性为亮黄色和黑色；雌性相似，但颜色更柔和。

Ixoreus naevius.extract: The varied thrush is a member of the thrush family, Turdidae. It is the only species in the monotypic genus Ixoreus.
Ixoreus naevius.title: Varied thrush

zh-CN.title: 杂色鸫
zh-CN.extract: 杂色鸫是鸫科Turdidae的成员。它是单型属Ixoreus中唯一的物种。

Junco hyemalis.extract: The dark-eyed junco is a species of junco, a group of small, grayish New World sparrows. The species is common across much of temperate North America and in summer it ranges far into the Arctic. It is a variable species, much like the related fox sparrow, and its systematics are still not completely resolved.
Junco hyemalis.title: Dark-eyed junco

zh-CN.title: 暗眼灯草鹀
zh-CN.extract: 暗眼灯草鹀是灯草鹀属的一种，属于一组小型、灰色的新大陆麻雀。该物种在北美温带大部分地区常见，夏季分布范围远至北极。它是一个多变的物种，与相关的狐色麻雀类似，其系统分类学尚未完全解决。

Lanius ludovicianus.extract: The loggerhead shrike is a passerine bird in the family Laniidae. It is the only member of the shrike family endemic to North America; the related northern shrike occurs north of its range; however, it is also found in Siberia. It is nicknamed the butcherbird after its carnivorous tendencies, as it consumes prey such as insects, amphibians, lizards, small mammals and small birds, and some prey end up displayed and stored at a site, for example in a tree. Due to its small size and weak talons, this predatory bird relies on impaling its prey upon thorns or barbed wire for facilitated consumption. The numbers of loggerhead shrike have significantly decreased in recent years, especially in Midwestern, New England and Mid-Atlantic areas.
Lanius ludovicianus.title: Loggerhead shrike

zh-CN.title: 呆头伯劳
zh-CN.extract: 呆头伯劳是伯劳科的一种雀形目鸟类。它是伯劳科中唯一一种北美洲特有物种；同科的北方灰伯劳分布在其范围北部，但在西伯利亚也有分布。因其食肉习性而被称为“屠夫鸟”，它以昆虫、两栖动物、蜥蜴、小型哺乳动物和小鸟为食，一些猎物会被展示并储存在某个地点，例如树上。由于体型小、爪子弱，这种捕食性鸟类依靠将猎物刺穿在荆棘或带刺铁丝网上以便于进食。近年来，呆头伯劳的数量显著减少，尤其在中西部、新英格兰和大西洋中部地区。

Larus californicus.extract: The California gull is a medium-sized gull, smaller on average than the herring gull, but larger on average than the ring-billed gull. Although named after California, it can be found annually across most of western North America, from the Canadian prairie provinces in the northeast and south through western Mexico.
Larus californicus.title: California gull

zh-CN.title: 加州鸥
zh-CN.extract: 加州鸥是一种中型海鸥，平均体型小于银鸥，但大于环嘴鸥。虽然以加利福尼亚命名，但每年在北美西部大部分地区都能见到，从东北部的加拿大草原省份向南到墨西哥西部。

Larus delawarensis.extract: The ring-billed gull is a medium-sized gull native to North America, breeding in Canada and the northern Contiguous United States, and wintering mainly in the United States and northern Mexico. The genus name is from Latin Larus which appears to have referred to a gull or other large seabird. The specific delawarensis refers to the Delaware River.
Larus delawarensis.title: Ring-billed gull

zh-CN.title: 环嘴鸥
zh-CN.extract: 环嘴鸥是一种中型海鸥，原产于北美，在加拿大和美国本土北部繁殖，主要在美国和墨西哥北部越冬。属名来自拉丁语Larus，似乎指海鸥或其他大型海鸟。种名delawarensis指特拉华河。

Larus glaucescens.extract: The glaucous-winged gull is a large, white-headed gull. The genus name is from Latin Larus which appears to have referred to a gull or other large seabird. The specific glaucescens is Neo-Latin for "glaucous" from the Ancient Greek, glaukos, denoting the grey color of its wings.
Larus glaucescens.title: Glaucous-winged gull

zh-CN.title: 灰翅鸥
zh-CN.extract: 灰翅鸥是一种大型白头鸥。属名来自拉丁语Larus，似乎指海鸥或其他大型海鸟。种名glaucescens是新拉丁语“灰白色”，来自古希腊语glaukos，表示其翅膀的灰色。

Larus heermanni.extract: Heermann's gull is a gull resident in the United States, Mexico and extreme southwestern British Columbia, nearly all nesting on Isla Rasa in the Gulf of California. They are usually found near shores or well out to sea, very rarely inland. The species is named after Adolphus Lewis Heermann, nineteenth-century explorer and naturalist.
Larus heermanni.title: Heermann's gull

zh-CN.title: 赫曼鸥
zh-CN.extract: 赫曼鸥是一种海鸥，分布于美国、墨西哥和加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省最西南部，几乎全部在加利福尼亚湾的拉萨岛筑巢。它们通常出现在海岸附近或远海，很少在内陆。该物种以十九世纪探险家兼博物学家阿道夫斯·刘易斯·赫曼命名。

Larus occidentalis.extract: The western gull is a large white-headed gull that lives on the west coast of North America and the Pacific Ocean. The western gull ranges from British Columbia, Canada, to Baja California, Mexico.
Larus occidentalis.title: Western gull

zh-CN.title: 西方鸥
zh-CN.extract: 西方鸥是一种大型白头鸥，生活在北美西海岸和太平洋。西方鸥的分布范围从加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省到墨西哥下加利福尼亚州。

Leiothlypis celata.extract: The orange-crowned warbler is a small songbird of the New World warbler family.
Leiothlypis celata.title: Orange-crowned warbler

zh-CN.title: 橙冠莺
zh-CN.extract: 橙冠莺是莺科的一种小型鸣禽。

Leucophaeus atricilla.extract: The laughing gull is a medium-sized gull of North and South America. Named from its laugh-like call, it is an opportunistic omnivore and scavenger. It breeds in large colonies mostly along the Atlantic coast of North America, the Caribbean, and northern South America. Two subspecies are accepted, L. a. atricilla, which occurs from the West Indies to the Venezuelan islands, and L. a. megalopterus, which occurs from southeast Canada down to Central America. The laughing gull was long placed in the genus Larus until its present placement in Leucophaeus.
Leucophaeus atricilla.title: Laughing gull

zh-CN.title: 笑鸥
zh-CN.extract: 笑鸥是一种分布于南北美洲的中型鸥。因其叫声似笑而得名，是一种机会主义杂食动物和食腐动物。它主要沿北美大西洋沿岸、加勒比海和南美洲北部的大群繁殖。有两个公认的亚种：L. a. atricilla，分布于西印度群岛至委内瑞拉群岛；L. a. megalopterus，分布于加拿大东南部至中美洲。笑鸥曾长期被归入鸥属（Larus），直到现在被归入Leucophaeus属。

Leucophaeus pipixcan.extract: Franklin's gull is a small gull. The genus name Leucophaeus is from Ancient Greek leukos, "white", and phaios, "dusky". The specific pipixcan is a Nahuatl name for a type of gull. The English common name was given to commemorate the arctic explorer Sir John Franklin, who led an expedition in 1825 on which the type was collected.
Leucophaeus pipixcan.title: Franklin's gull

zh-CN.title: 弗氏鸥
zh-CN.extract: 弗氏鸥是一种小型鸥。属名Leucophaeus源自古希腊语leukos（白色）和phaios（暗色）。种加词pipixcan是纳瓦特尔语中一种鸥的名称。英文俗名是为了纪念北极探险家约翰·富兰克林爵士，他在1825年领导了一次探险，期间采集了模式标本。

Leucosticte tephrocotis.extract: The gray-crowned rosy finch or gray-crowned rosy-finch is a species of passerine bird in the family Fringillidae native to Alaska, western Canada, and the north-western United States. Due to its remote and rocky alpine habitat it is rarely seen. There are currently six recognized subspecies. It is one of four species of rosy finches.
Leucosticte tephrocotis.title: Gray-crowned rosy finch

zh-CN.title: 灰冠朱顶雀
zh-CN.extract: 灰冠朱顶雀是一种雀科（Fringillidae）雀形目鸟类，原产于阿拉斯加、加拿大西部和美国西北部。由于其偏远多岩石的高山栖息地，很少见到。目前有六个公认的亚种。它是四种朱顶雀之一。

Limosa fedoa.extract: The marbled godwit is a large migratory shorebird in the family Scolopacidae. On average, it is the largest of the four species of godwit.
Limosa fedoa.title: Marbled godwit

zh-CN.title: 云斑塍鹬
zh-CN.extract: 云斑塍鹬是鹬科（Scolopacidae）的一种大型迁徙滨鸟。平均而言，它是四种塍鹬中体型最大的。

Lophodytes cucullatus.extract: The hooded merganser is a species of fish-eating duck in the subfamily Anatinae. It is the only extant species in the genus Lophodytes. The genus name derives from the Greek language: lophos meaning 'crest', and dutes meaning 'diver'. The bird is striking in appearance; both sexes have crests that they can raise or lower, and the breeding plumage of the male is handsomely patterned and coloured. The hooded merganser has a sawbill but is not classified as a typical merganser.
Lophodytes cucullatus.title: Hooded merganser

zh-CN.title: 冠秋沙鸭
zh-CN.extract: 冠秋沙鸭是鸭科（Anatinae）的一种食鱼鸭。它是Lophodytes属唯一现存的物种。属名源自希腊语：lophos意为“冠”，dutes意为“潜水者”。该鸟外观引人注目；两性都有可竖起或放下的冠羽，雄鸟的繁殖羽图案和色彩华丽。冠秋沙鸭有锯齿喙，但不属于典型的秋沙鸭。

Loxia curvirostra.extract: The red crossbill or common crossbill is a small passerine bird in the finch family Fringillidae. Crossbills have distinctive mandibles, crossed at the tips, which enable them to extract seeds from conifer cones and other fruits.
Loxia curvirostra.title: Red crossbill

zh-CN.title: 红交嘴雀
zh-CN.extract: 红交嘴雀是一种雀科（Fringillidae）的小型雀形目鸟类。交嘴雀具有独特的喙，上下喙尖端交叉，这使它们能够从松果和其他果实中提取种子。

Mareca americana.extract: The American wigeon, also known as the baldpate, is a species of dabbling duck found in North America. Formerly assigned to Anas, this species is classified with the other wigeons in the dabbling duck genus Mareca. It is the New World counterpart of the Eurasian wigeon.
Mareca americana.title: American wigeon

zh-CN.title: 美洲赤颈鸭
zh-CN.extract: 美洲赤颈鸭，也称为秃头鸭，是一种在北美发现的涉水鸭。以前被归入Anas属，现在与其他赤颈鸭一起被归入涉水鸭属Mareca。它是欧亚赤颈鸭在新世界的对应物种。

Mareca strepera.extract: The gadwall is a common and widespread dabbling duck in the family Anatidae.
Mareca strepera.title: Gadwall

zh-CN.title: 赤膀鸭
zh-CN.extract: 赤膀鸭是鸭科（Anatidae）中一种常见且分布广泛的涉水鸭。

Megaceryle alcyon.extract: The belted kingfisher is a large, conspicuous water kingfisher, native to North America.
Megaceryle alcyon.title: Belted kingfisher

zh-CN.title: 带翠鸟
zh-CN.extract: 带翠鸟是一种大型、显眼的水翠鸟，原产于北美洲。

Megascops kennicottii.extract: The western screech owl is a small owl native to North and Central America, closely related to the eastern screech owl. The scientific name commemorates the American naturalist Robert Kennicott.
Megascops kennicottii.title: Western screech owl

zh-CN.title: 西美角鸮
zh-CN.extract: 西美角鸮是一种小型猫头鹰，原产于北美和中美洲，与东美角鸮亲缘关系密切。其学名是为了纪念美国博物学家罗伯特·肯尼科特。

Melanerpes formicivorus.extract: The acorn woodpecker is a medium-sized woodpecker with a length of around 20 cm (8 in), and an average weight of 85 g (3.0 oz). It is found across Central America, as well as North into the western United States and South into parts of Colombia.
Melanerpes formicivorus.title: Acorn woodpecker

zh-CN.title: 橡树啄木鸟
zh-CN.extract: 橡树啄木鸟是一种中型啄木鸟，体长约20厘米（8英寸），平均体重85克（3.0盎司）。分布于中美洲，北至美国西部，南至哥伦比亚部分地区。

Melanerpes lewis.extract: Lewis's woodpecker is a large North American species of woodpecker which ornithologist Alexander Wilson named after Meriwether Lewis. Lewis was one of the explorers who surveyed the areas bought by the United States of America as part of the Louisiana Purchase and first described this species of bird.
Melanerpes lewis.title: Lewis's woodpecker

zh-CN.title: 刘易斯啄木鸟
zh-CN.extract: 刘易斯啄木鸟是一种大型北美啄木鸟，鸟类学家亚历山大·威尔逊以梅里韦瑟·刘易斯命名。刘易斯是调查美国通过路易斯安那购地所购地区的探险家之一，并首次描述了这种鸟类。

Meleagris gallopavo.extract: The wild turkey is an upland game bird native to North America, one of two extant species of turkey and the heaviest member of the order Galliformes. It is the ancestor to the domestic turkey, which was originally derived from a southern Mexican subspecies of wild turkey.
Meleagris gallopavo.title: Wild turkey

zh-CN.title: 野生火鸡
zh-CN.extract: 野生火鸡是一种原产于北美洲的高地猎鸟，是现存两种火鸡之一，也是鸡形目中最重的成员。它是家养火鸡的祖先，家养火鸡最初源自野生火鸡的墨西哥南部亚种。

Melospiza georgiana.extract: The swamp sparrow is a medium-sized New World sparrow related to the song sparrow.
Melospiza georgiana.title: Swamp sparrow

zh-CN.title: 沼泽麻雀
zh-CN.extract: 沼泽麻雀是一种中型新世界麻雀，与歌带鹀有亲缘关系。

Melospiza lincolnii.extract: Lincoln's sparrow is a small sparrow native to North America. It is a less common passerine bird that often stays hidden under thick ground cover, but can be distinguished by its sweet, wrenlike song. Lincoln's sparrow is one of three species in the genus Melospiza which also includes the song sparrow and the swamp sparrow. It lives in well-covered brushy habitats, often near water. This bird is poorly documented because of its secretive nature and breeding habits solely in boreal regions.
Melospiza lincolnii.title: Lincoln's sparrow

zh-CN.title: 林肯氏麻雀
zh-CN.extract: 林肯氏麻雀是一种原产于北美的小型麻雀。它是一种不太常见的雀形目鸟类，常常隐藏在茂密的地面覆盖物下，但可以通过其甜美、类似鹪鹩的歌声来区分。林肯氏麻雀是歌带鹀属的三个物种之一，该属还包括歌带鹀和沼泽麻雀。它生活在植被茂密的灌木栖息地，通常靠近水域。由于该鸟生性隐秘且仅在北方地区繁殖，因此关于它的文献记载较少。

Melospiza melodia.extract: The song sparrow is a medium-sized New World sparrow. Among the native sparrows in North America, it is easily one of the most abundant, variable, and adaptable species.
Melospiza melodia.title: Song sparrow

zh-CN.title: 歌带鹀
zh-CN.extract: 歌带鹀是一种中型新世界麻雀。在北美本土麻雀中，它很容易成为最丰富、最多变和适应性最强的物种之一。

Melozone aberti.extract: Abert's towhee is a bird of the family Passerellidae, native to a small range in southwestern North America, generally the lower Colorado River and Gila River watersheds, nearly endemic to Arizona, but also present in small parts of California, Nevada, Utah, New Mexico, and Sonora in Mexico. The name of this bird commemorates the American ornithologist James William Abert (1820–1897).
Melozone aberti.title: Abert's towhee

zh-CN.title: 艾伯特的鹀
zh-CN.extract: 艾伯特的鹀是雀鹀科的一种鸟类，原产于北美西南部的小范围地区，主要是科罗拉多河下游和希拉河流域，几乎特产于亚利桑那州，但也出现在加利福尼亚州、内华达州、犹他州、新墨西哥州以及墨西哥索诺拉州的部分地区。这种鸟的名字是为了纪念美国鸟类学家詹姆斯·威廉·艾伯特（1820–1897）。

Melozone crissalis.extract: The California towhee is a bird of the family Passerellidae, native to the coastal regions of western Oregon and California in the United States and Baja California and Baja California Sur in Mexico.
Melozone crissalis.title: California towhee

zh-CN.title: 加州鹀
zh-CN.extract: 加州鹀是雀鹀科的一种鸟类，原产于美国俄勒冈州西部和加利福尼亚州的沿海地区，以及墨西哥的下加利福尼亚州和南下加利福尼亚州。

Melozone fusca.extract: The canyon towhee is a bird of the family Passerellidae. Until 1989, the canyon towhee and the California towhee were considered to be a single species which was called the brown towhee.
Melozone fusca.title: Canyon towhee

zh-CN.title: 峡谷鹀
zh-CN.extract: 峡谷鹀是雀鹀科的一种鸟类。直到1989年，峡谷鹀和加州鹀被认为是同一个物种，称为棕鹀。
