Mergus merganser.extract: The common merganser or goosander is a large sea duck of rivers and lakes in forested areas of Europe, Asia, and North America. The common merganser eats mainly fish. It nests in holes in trees. The name "common merganser" is used in North America, while "goosander" is used in Eurasia.
Mergus merganser.title: Common merganser

zh-CN.title: 普通秋沙鸭
zh-CN.extract: 普通秋沙鸭是一种大型海鸭，栖息于欧洲、亚洲和北美森林地区的河流和湖泊中。普通秋沙鸭主要以鱼类为食。它在树洞中筑巢。“普通秋沙鸭”这个名称在北美使用，而“goosander”在欧亚大陆使用。

Mimus polyglottos.extract: The northern mockingbird is a mockingbird commonly found in North America, of the family Mimidae. The species is also found in some parts of the Caribbean, as well as on the Hawaiian Islands. It is typically a permanent resident across much of its range, but northern mockingbirds may move farther south during inclement weather or prior to the onset of winter. The northern mockingbird has gray to brown upper feathers and a paler belly. Its tail and wings have white patches which are visible in flight.
Mimus polyglottos.title: Northern mockingbird

zh-CN.title: 反舌鸟
zh-CN.extract: 反舌鸟是嘲鸫科的一种嘲鸫，常见于北美。该物种也见于加勒比海部分地区以及夏威夷群岛。在其大部分分布区内，它通常是永久性留鸟，但在恶劣天气或冬季来临前，北方反舌鸟可能会向南移动。反舌鸟的上体羽毛呈灰色至棕色，腹部颜色较浅。尾部和翅膀上有白色斑块，飞行时可见。

Mniotilta varia.extract: The black-and-white warbler is a species of New World warbler, and the only member of its genus, Mniotilta. It breeds in northern and eastern North America and winters in Florida, Central America, and the West Indies down to Peru. It has been recorded as a vagrant in Northern Europe, especially Britain and Ireland. Relative to other New World warblers, it is not well studied.
Mniotilta varia.title: Black-and-white warbler

zh-CN.title: 黑白森莺
zh-CN.extract: 黑白森莺是新世界莺科的一种，也是其属Mniotilta的唯一成员。它在北美北部和东部繁殖，在佛罗里达、中美洲和西印度群岛直至秘鲁越冬。它曾作为迷鸟出现在北欧，尤其是英国和爱尔兰。相对于其他新世界莺科鸟类，对其研究尚不充分。

Molothrus ater.extract: The brown-headed cowbird is a small, obligate brood parasitic icterid native to temperate and subtropical North America. It is a permanent resident in the southern parts of its range; northern birds migrate to the southern United States and Mexico in winter, returning to their summer habitat around March or April.
Molothrus ater.title: Brown-headed cowbird

zh-CN.title: 褐头牛鹂
zh-CN.extract: 褐头牛鹂是一种小型、专性巢寄生的拟黄鹂科鸟类，原产于北美温带和亚热带地区。在其分布区南部为永久性留鸟；北方的鸟类在冬季迁徙到美国南部和墨西哥，大约在三月或四月返回夏季栖息地。

Myadestes townsendi.extract: Townsend's solitaire is a medium-sized thrush, the only solitaire native to America north of Mexico.
Myadestes townsendi.title: Townsend's solitaire

zh-CN.title: 汤森氏孤鸫
zh-CN.extract: 汤森氏孤鸫是一种中等体型的鸫科鸟类，是墨西哥以北美洲唯一原产的孤鸫。

Myiarchus cinerascens.extract: The ash-throated flycatcher is a passerine bird in the tyrant flycatcher family.
Myiarchus cinerascens.title: Ash-throated flycatcher

zh-CN.title: 灰喉蝇霸鹟
zh-CN.extract: 灰喉蝇霸鹟是霸鹟科的一种雀形目鸟类。

Nucifraga columbiana.extract:
Clark's nutcracker, also known as Clark's crow, is a passerine bird in the family Corvidae, native to the mountains of western North America. The nutcracker is an omnivore, but subsists mainly on pine nuts, burying seeds in the ground in the summer and then retrieving them in the winter by memory.
The bird was described by the Lewis and Clark Expedition, with William Clark first observing it in 1805 along the banks of the Salmon River, a tributary of the Columbia River.
Nucifraga columbiana.title: Clark's nutcracker

zh-CN.title: 克拉克星鸦
zh-CN.extract: 克拉克星鸦，又称克拉克乌鸦，是鸦科的一种雀形目鸟类，原产于北美西部山区。星鸦是杂食动物，但主要以松子为食，夏季将种子埋入地下，冬季依靠记忆取回。这种鸟由刘易斯与克拉克远征队描述，威廉·克拉克于1805年在哥伦比亚河支流鲑鱼河沿岸首次观察到。

Numenius americanus.extract: The long-billed curlew is a large North American shorebird of the family Scolopacidae. This species was also called "sicklebird" and the "candlestick bird". The species breeds in central and western North America, migrating southward and coastward for the winter.
Numenius americanus.title: Long-billed curlew

zh-CN.title: 长嘴杓鹬
zh-CN.extract: 长嘴杓鹬是鹬科的一种大型北美滨鸟。该物种也被称为“镰刀鸟”和“烛台鸟”。该物种在北美中部和西部繁殖，冬季向南和向海岸迁徙。

Nycticorax nycticorax.extract: The black-crowned night heron or black-capped night heron, commonly shortened to just night heron in Eurasia, is a medium-sized heron found throughout a large part of the world, including parts of Europe, Asia, and North and South America. In Australasia it is replaced by the closely related Nankeen night heron, with which it has hybridised in the area of contact.
Nycticorax nycticorax.title: Black-crowned night heron

zh-CN.title: 夜鹭
zh-CN.extract: 夜鹭或黑冠夜鹭，在欧亚大陆常简称为夜鹭，是一种中等体型的鹭，分布于世界大部分地区，包括欧洲、亚洲、南北美洲的部分地区。在澳大拉西亚，它被近缘的棕夜鹭取代，两者在接触区域有杂交。

Oreothlypis ruficapilla.extract: The Nashville warbler is a small songbird in the New World warbler family, found in North and Central America. It breeds in parts of the northern and western United States and southern Canada, and migrates to winter in southern California and Texas, Mexico, and the north of Central America. It has a gray head and a green back, and its underparts are yellow and white.
Oreothlypis ruficapilla.title: Nashville warbler

zh-CN.title: 纳什维尔莺
zh-CN.extract: 纳什维尔莺是森莺科的一种小型鸣禽，分布于北美和中美洲。它在北美北部和西部以及加拿大南部繁殖，冬季迁徙至加利福尼亚州南部、德克萨斯州、墨西哥和中美洲北部。它头部灰色，背部绿色，下体黄色和白色。

Pandion haliaetus.extract: The osprey, historically known as sea hawk, river hawk, and fish hawk, is a diurnal, fish-eating bird of prey with a cosmopolitan range. It is a large raptor, reaching more than 60 cm (24 in) in length and a wingspan of 180 cm (71 in). It is brown on the upperparts and predominantly greyish on the head and underparts.
Pandion haliaetus.title: Osprey

zh-CN.title: 鹗
zh-CN.extract: 鹗，历史上称为海鹰、河鹰和鱼鹰，是一种昼行性食鱼猛禽，分布范围广泛。它是一种大型猛禽，体长超过60厘米（24英寸），翼展达180厘米（71英寸）。上体褐色，头部和下体主要为灰色。

Passer domesticus.extract: The house sparrow is a bird of the sparrow family Passeridae, found in most parts of the world. It is a small bird that has a typical length of 16 cm (6.3 in) and a mass of 24–39.5 g (0.85–1.39 oz). Females and young birds are coloured pale brown and grey, and males have brighter black, white, and brown markings. One of about 25 species in the genus Passer, the house sparrow is native to most of Europe, the Mediterranean Basin, and a large part of Asia. Its intentional or accidental introductions to many regions, including parts of Australasia, Africa, and the Americas, make it the most widely distributed wild bird.
Passer domesticus.title: House sparrow

zh-CN.title: 家麻雀
zh-CN.extract: 家麻雀是雀科雀属的一种鸟类，分布于世界大部分地区。它是一种小型鸟类，典型体长16厘米（6.3英寸），体重24–39.5克（0.85–1.39盎司）。雌鸟和幼鸟为淡褐色和灰色，雄鸟有更明亮的黑色、白色和棕色斑纹。作为雀属约25种之一，家麻雀原产于欧洲大部分地区、地中海盆地和亚洲大部分地区。其有意或无意引入许多地区，包括澳大拉西亚、非洲和美洲的部分地区，使其成为分布最广泛的野生鸟类。

Passerculus sandwichensis.extract: The Savannah sparrow is a small New World sparrow that is the only member of the genus Passerculus. It is a widespread and abundant species that occupies open grassland habitats in North America.
Passerculus sandwichensis.title: Savannah sparrow

zh-CN.title: 稀树草鹀
zh-CN.extract: 稀树草鹀是一种小型新世界麻雀，是稀树草鹀属的唯一成员。它是一种分布广泛且数量众多的物种，栖息于北美洲的开阔草地生境。

Passerella iliaca.extract: The fox sparrow is a large New World sparrow. It is the only member of the genus Passerella, although some authors split the species into four.
Passerella iliaca.title: Fox sparrow

zh-CN.title: 狐色带鹀
zh-CN.extract: 狐色带鹀是一种大型的新大陆鹀。它是狐色带鹀属（Passerella）的唯一成员，尽管有些作者将这种鸟分为四个物种。

Passerina amoena.extract: The lazuli bunting is a North American songbird named for the gemstone lapis lazuli.
Passerina amoena.title: Lazuli bunting

zh-CN.title: 青彩鹀
zh-CN.extract: 青彩鹀是一种北美鸣禽，以青金石（lapis lazuli）宝石命名。

Passerina cyanea.extract: The indigo bunting is a small seed-eating bird in the cardinal family, Cardinalidae. It is migratory, ranging from southern Canada to northern Florida during the breeding season, and from southern Florida to northern South America during the winter. It often migrates by night, using the stars to navigate. Its habitat is farmland, brush areas, and open woodland. The indigo bunting is closely related to the lazuli bunting and interbreeds with the species where their ranges overlap.
Passerina cyanea.title: Indigo bunting

zh-CN.title: 靛蓝彩鹀
zh-CN.extract: 靛蓝彩鹀是雀科（Cardinalidae）中的一种小型食籽鸟。它是候鸟，繁殖季节从加拿大南部到佛罗里达北部，冬季从佛罗里达南部到南美洲北部。它经常在夜间迁徙，利用星星导航。其栖息地为农田、灌木丛和开阔林地。靛蓝彩鹀与青彩鹀亲缘关系密切，并在分布重叠区域与后者杂交。

Patagioenas fasciata.extract: The band-tailed pigeon is a pigeon native to the Americas, and one of the largest pigeons in this region. It is largely gray, but with a thin white collar on the nape and a purple-gray breast.
Patagioenas fasciata.title: Band-tailed pigeon

zh-CN.title: 斑尾鸽
zh-CN.extract: 斑尾鸽是一种原产于美洲的鸽子，是该区域最大的鸽子之一。它主要是灰色，但后颈有细白领，胸部呈紫灰色。

Pelecanus erythrorhynchos.extract: The American white pelican is a large aquatic soaring bird from the order Pelecaniformes. It breeds in interior North America, moving south and to the coasts, as far as Costa Rica, in winter.
Pelecanus erythrorhynchos.title: American white pelican

zh-CN.title: 美洲白鹈鹕
zh-CN.extract: 美洲白鹈鹕是一种大型水栖翱翔鸟类，属于鹈形目（Pelecaniformes）。它在北美内陆繁殖，冬季向南和沿海地区移动，远至哥斯达黎加。

Pelecanus occidentalis.extract: The brown pelican is a bird of the pelican family, Pelecanidae, one of three species found in the Americas and one of two that feed by diving into water. It is found on the Atlantic Coast from New Jersey to the mouth of the Amazon River, and along the Pacific Coast from British Columbia to Peru, including the Galapagos Islands. The nominate subspecies in its breeding plumage has a white head with a yellowish wash on the crown. The nape and neck are dark maroon–brown. The upper sides of the neck have white lines along the base of the gular pouch, and the lower fore neck has a pale yellowish patch. The male and female are similar, but the female is slightly smaller. The nonbreeding adult has a white head and neck. The pink skin around the eyes becomes dull and gray in the nonbreeding season. It lacks any red hue, and the pouch is strongly olivaceous ochre-tinged and the legs are olivaceous gray to blackish-gray.
Pelecanus occidentalis.title: Brown pelican

zh-CN.title: 褐鹈鹕
zh-CN.extract: 褐鹈鹕是鹈鹕科（Pelecanidae）的一种鸟类，是美洲发现的三种鹈鹕之一，也是两种通过潜水入水觅食的鹈鹕之一。它分布在大西洋沿岸，从新泽西到亚马逊河口，以及太平洋沿岸，从不列颠哥伦比亚到秘鲁，包括加拉帕戈斯群岛。指名亚种在繁殖羽时头部白色，冠部有淡黄色晕染；后颈和颈部为深栗褐色；颈上侧沿喉囊基部有白色线纹，前颈下部有淡黄色斑块。雄鸟和雌鸟相似，但雌鸟略小。非繁殖成鸟头部和颈部白色；眼周粉红色皮肤在非繁殖季节变得暗淡灰色，缺乏任何红色色调；喉囊呈强烈橄榄赭色；腿为橄榄灰至黑灰色。

Perisoreus canadensis.extract: The Canada jay, also known as the grey jay, gray jay, camp robber, moose bird, gorby, or whisky jack, is a passerine bird of the family Corvidae. It is found in boreal forests of North America, north to the tree line, and in the Rocky Mountains subalpine zone south to New Mexico and Arizona. A fairly large songbird, the Canada jay has pale grey underparts, darker grey upperparts, and a grey-white head with a darker grey nape. It is one of three members of the genus Perisoreus, a genus more closely related to the magpie genus Cyanopica than to other birds known as jays. The Canada jay itself has nine recognized subspecies.
Perisoreus canadensis.title: Canada jay

zh-CN.title: 加拿大松鸦
zh-CN.extract: 加拿大松鸦，又称灰松鸦、营地强盗、驼鹿鸟、戈尔比或威士忌杰克，是鸦科（Corvidae）的一种雀形目鸟类。它分布于北美北部寒带针叶林，北至林线，并在落基山亚高山地带南至新墨西哥州和亚利桑那州。加拿大松鸦是一种相当大的鸣禽，下体浅灰色，上体深灰色，头部灰白色，后颈深灰色。它是松鸦属（Perisoreus）三个成员之一，该属与喜鹊属（Cyanopica）的亲缘关系比与其他被称为松鸦的鸟类更近。加拿大松鸦本身有九个公认的亚种。

Petrochelidon pyrrhonota.extract: The cliff swallow or  American cliff swallow is a member of the passerine bird family Hirundinidae, the swallows and martins. The generic name Petrochelidon is derived from the Ancient Greek petros meaning "stone" and khelidon (χελιδών) "swallow", and the specific name pyrrhonota comes from purrhos meaning "flame-coloured" and -notos "-backed".
Petrochelidon pyrrhonota.title: Cliff swallow

zh-CN.title: 红石燕
zh-CN.extract: 红石燕或美洲红石燕是雀形目燕科（Hirundinidae）中的一种（燕子和毛脚燕）。属名Petrochelidon来源于古希腊语petros意为“石头”和khelidon（χελιδών）意为“燕子”，种名pyrrhonota来自purrhos意为“火焰色的”和-notos意为“背部的”。

Phainopepla nitens.extract: The phainopepla or northern phainopepla is the most northerly representative of the mainly tropical Central American family Ptiliogonatidae, the silky flycatchers. Its name is from the Greek phain pepla meaning "shining robe" in reference to the male's plumage.
Phainopepla nitens.title: Phainopepla

zh-CN.title: 黑丝鹟
zh-CN.extract: 黑丝鹟或北方黑丝鹟是主要分布于热带中美洲的丝鹟科（Ptiliogonatidae）最北端的代表物种。其名称源自希腊语phain pepla，意为“闪亮的长袍”，指雄性羽毛的特征。

Phalacrocorax auritus.extract: The double-crested cormorant is a member of the cormorant family of water birds. It is found near rivers and lakes and in coastal areas and is widely distributed across North America, from the Aleutian Islands in Alaska down to Florida and Mexico. Measuring 70–90 cm (28–35 in) in length, it is entirely black except for a bare patch of orange-yellow facial skin and some extra plumage that it exhibits in the breeding season when it grows a double crest in which black feathers are mingled with white. Five subspecies are recognized. It mainly eats fish and hunts by swimming and diving. Its feathers, like all cormorants, are not waterproof, and it must dry them out after spending time in the water. Once threatened by the use of DDT, the numbers of this bird have increased markedly in recent years.
Phalacrocorax auritus.title: Double-crested cormorant

zh-CN.title: 双冠鸬鹚
zh-CN.extract: 双冠鸬鹚是水鸟鸬鹚科的一员。常见于河流、湖泊及沿海地区，广泛分布于北美洲，从阿拉斯加的阿留申群岛到佛罗里达州和墨西哥。体长70–90厘米（28–35英寸），全身黑色，仅面部有一块橙黄色裸露皮肤，繁殖期会生长出黑白相间的双冠羽。有五个亚种被确认。主要以鱼类为食，通过游泳和潜水捕猎。其羽毛与所有鸬鹚一样不防水，出水后需晾干。曾受DDT威胁，但近年来数量显著增长。

Phalaenoptilus nuttallii.extract: The common poorwill is a nocturnal bird of the family Caprimulgidae, the nightjars. It is found from British Columbia and southeastern Alberta, through the western United States to northern Mexico. The bird's habitat is dry, open areas with grasses or shrubs, and even stony desert slopes with very little vegetation.
Phalaenoptilus nuttallii.title: Common poorwill

zh-CN.title: 普通贫嘴鸱
zh-CN.extract: 普通贫嘴鸱是夜鹰科（Caprimulgidae）的夜行性鸟类。分布于不列颠哥伦比亚省和阿尔伯塔省东南部，经美国西部至墨西哥北部。栖息于干燥开阔的草地、灌木丛甚至植被稀少的石质荒漠斜坡。

Phasianus colchicus.extract: The common pheasant, ring-necked pheasant, or blue-headed pheasant, is a bird in the pheasant family (Phasianidae). The genus name comes from Latin phasianus 'pheasant'. The species name colchicus is Latin for 'of Colchis', a country on the Black Sea where pheasants became known to Europeans. Although Phasianus was previously thought to be closely related to the genus Gallus, the genus of junglefowl and domesticated chickens, recent studies show that they are in different subfamilies, having diverged over 20 million years ago.
Phasianus colchicus.title: Common pheasant

zh-CN.title: 环颈雉
zh-CN.extract: 环颈雉（也称普通雉鸡或蓝头雉）是雉科（Phasianidae）的一种鸟类。属名Phasianus源自拉丁语意为“雉鸡”，种加词colchicus意为“来自科尔基斯”（黑海沿岸国家，欧洲人由此认识雉鸡）。虽曾被认为与原鸡属（Gallus，含林鸡和家鸡）近缘，但近期研究表明其分属不同亚科，分化时间超过2000万年。

Pheucticus melanocephalus.extract: The black-headed grosbeak is a medium-sized, seed-eating bird in the family Cardinalidae. It is sometimes considered conspecific with the rose-breasted grosbeak with which it hybridizes on the American Great Plains.
Pheucticus melanocephalus.title: Black-headed grosbeak

zh-CN.title: 黑头蜡嘴雀
zh-CN.extract: 黑头蜡嘴雀是一种中等体型的食籽鸟类，属于美洲雀科（Cardinalidae）。有时被认为与玫胸蜡嘴雀为同种，两者在美国大平原地区存在杂交。

Pica nuttalli.extract: The yellow-billed magpie, also known as the California magpie, is a bird that is endemic to California's Central Valley and the adjacent chaparral foothills and mountains. Apart from its having a yellow bill and a yellow streak around the eye and being slightly smaller, it is virtually identical to the black-billed magpie found in much of the rest of western North America. The scientific name commemorates the English naturalist Thomas Nuttall.
Pica nuttalli.title: Yellow-billed magpie

zh-CN.title: 黄嘴喜鹊
zh-CN.extract: 黄嘴喜鹊，又称加利福尼亚喜鹊，是加利福尼亚州中央谷地及其邻近的灌木丘陵和山区的特有鸟类。除黄色喙部、眼周黄色条纹和体型略小外，它与北美西部其他地区的黑嘴喜鹊几乎完全相同。学名纪念英国博物学家托马斯·纳托尔。

Picoides arcticus.extract: The black-backed woodpecker, also known as the Arctic three-toed woodpecker, is a medium-sized woodpecker inhabiting the forests of North America.
Picoides arcticus.title: Black-backed woodpecker

zh-CN.title: 黑背啄木鸟
zh-CN.extract: 黑背啄木鸟，也称北极三趾啄木鸟，是栖息于北美森林的中型啄木鸟。

Pinicola enucleator.extract: The pine grosbeak is a large member of the true finch family, Fringillidae. It is the only species in the genus Pinicola. It is found in coniferous woods across Alaska, the western mountains of the United States, Canada, and in subarctic Fennoscandia and across the Palearctic to Siberia. The species is a frugivore, especially in winter, favoring small fruits, such as rowans. With fruit-crop abundance varying from year to year, pine grosbeak is one of many subarctic-resident bird species that exhibit irruptive behavior. In irruption years, individuals can move long distances in search of suitable food supplies, bringing them farther south and/or downslope than is typical of years with large fruit crops.
Pinicola enucleator.title: Pine grosbeak

zh-CN.title: 松雀
zh-CN.extract: 松雀是雀科（Fringillidae）的大型成员，是松雀属（Pinicola）的唯一物种。分布于阿拉斯加、美国西部山区、加拿大、亚北极的芬诺斯坎底亚以及古北界至西伯利亚的针叶林。以水果为食，冬季尤其偏爱小型果实（如花楸果）。因果实产量年际波动，松雀是众多表现爆发性迁徙行为的亚北极留鸟之一。在爆发年份，个体为寻找充足食物可长距离移动，从而比丰年更广泛地出现在南方或低海拔地区。

Pipilo chlorurus.extract: The green-tailed towhee is a species of bird in the family Passerellidae, the New World sparrows. It is found in the western United States and much of Mexico.
Pipilo chlorurus.title: Green-tailed towhee

zh-CN.title: 绿尾鹀
zh-CN.extract: 绿尾鹀是一种属于鹀科（新世界麻雀）的鸟类。它分布于美国西部和墨西哥大部分地区。

Pipilo erythrophthalmus.extract: The eastern towhee, also known as chewink, joree, or joree bird, is a large New World sparrow. The taxonomy of the towhees has been under debate in recent decades, and formerly this bird and the spotted towhee were considered a single species, the rufous-sided towhee.
Pipilo erythrophthalmus.title: Eastern towhee

zh-CN.title: 东鹀
zh-CN.extract: 东鹀，也被称为chewink、joree或joree鸟，是一种大型的新世界麻雀。近几十年来，鹀的分类学一直存在争议，此前这种鸟和斑鹀被视为单一物种，即棕胁鹀。

Pipilo maculatus.extract: The spotted towhee is a large New World sparrow. The taxonomy of the towhees has been debated in recent decades, and until 1995 this bird and the eastern towhee were considered a single species, then named rufous-sided towhee. Another outdated name for the spotted towhee is the Oregon towhee. The call may be harsher and more varied than for the eastern towhee.
Pipilo maculatus.title: Spotted towhee

zh-CN.title: 斑鹀
zh-CN.extract: 斑鹀是一种大型的新世界麻雀。近几十年来，鹀的分类学一直存在争议，直到1995年，这种鸟和东鹀被视为单一物种，当时命名为棕胁鹀。斑鹀的另一个过时名称是俄勒冈鹀。它的叫声可能比东鹀更刺耳、更多样。

Piranga ludoviciana.extract: The western tanager is a medium-sized American songbird. Formerly placed in the tanager family (Thraupidae), it and other members of its genus are classified in the cardinal family (Cardinalidae). The species' plumage and vocalizations are similar to other members of the cardinal family.
Piranga ludoviciana.title: Western tanager

zh-CN.title: 西黄鹀
zh-CN.extract: 西黄鹀是一种中型的美洲鸣禽。它曾被归入裸鼻雀科，但现在它和同属的其他成员被归入主红雀科。该物种的羽毛和叫声与主红雀科的其他成员相似。

Piranga rubra.extract: The summer tanager is a medium-sized American songbird. Formerly placed in the tanager family (Thraupidae), it and other members of its genus are now classified in the cardinal family (Cardinalidae). The species's plumage and vocalizations are similar to other members of the cardinal family.
Piranga rubra.title: Summer tanager

zh-CN.title: 夏黄鹀
zh-CN.extract: 夏黄鹀是一种中型的美洲鸣禽。它曾被归入裸鼻雀科，但现在它和同属的其他成员被归入主红雀科。该物种的羽毛和叫声与主红雀科的其他成员相似。

Plegadis chihi.extract: The white-faced ibis is a wading bird in the ibis family, Threskiornithidae.
Plegadis chihi.title: White-faced ibis

zh-CN.title: 白脸鹮
zh-CN.extract: 白脸鹮是一种属于鹮科（朱鹭科）的涉禽。

Podiceps nigricollis.extract: The black-necked grebe or eared grebe is a member of the grebe family of water birds. It was described in 1831 by Christian Ludwig Brehm. Its breeding plumage features distinctive ochre-coloured feathers which extend behind its eye and over its ear coverts. The rest of the upper parts, including the head, neck, and breast, are coloured black to blackish brown. The flanks are tawny rufous to maroon-chestnut, and the abdomen is white. In its non-breeding plumage, this bird has greyish-black upper parts, including the top of the head and a vertical stripe on the back of the neck. The flanks are also greyish-black. The rest of the body is a white or whitish colour. The juvenile has more brown in its darker areas. This species is present in parts of Africa, Eurasia, and the Americas.
Podiceps nigricollis.title: Black-necked grebe

zh-CN.title: 黑颈䴙䴘
zh-CN.extract: 黑颈䴙䴘（或称耳䴙䴘）是水鸟䴙䴘科的一员。它于1831年由Christian Ludwig Brehm描述。其繁殖羽的特征是眼睛后方和耳羽上方独特的赭色羽毛。其余上体部分，包括头部、颈部和胸部，为黑色至黑褐色。胁部为浅红褐色至栗色，腹部为白色。非繁殖羽时，该鸟上体为灰黑色，包括头顶和后颈的垂直条纹。胁部也是灰黑色。身体其余部分为白色或淡白色。幼鸟的深色区域带有更多棕色。该物种分布于非洲、欧亚大陆和美洲的部分地区。

Podilymbus podiceps.extract: The pied-billed grebe is a species of the grebe family of water birds primarily found in ponds throughout the Americas.
Podilymbus podiceps.title: Pied-billed grebe

zh-CN.title: 斑嘴巨䴙䴘
zh-CN.extract: 斑嘴巨䴙䴘是一种属于水鸟䴙䴘科的物种，主要分布于美洲的池塘中。

Poecile gambeli.extract: The mountain chickadee is a small songbird, a passerine bird in the tit family Paridae.
Poecile gambeli.title: Mountain chickadee

zh-CN.title: 黑冠山雀
zh-CN.extract: 黑冠山雀是一种小型鸣禽，属于山雀科山雀属的雀形目鸟类。

Poecile rufescens.extract: The chestnut-backed chickadee is a small passerine bird in the tit family, native to western North America.
Poecile rufescens.title: Chestnut-backed chickadee

zh-CN.title: 栗背山雀
zh-CN.extract: 栗背山雀是一种小型雀形目鸟，属于山雀科，原产于北美西部。

Polioptila caerulea.extract: The blue-gray gnatcatcher is a very small gnatcatcher native to North America.
Polioptila caerulea.title: Blue-gray gnatcatcher

zh-CN.title: 蓝灰蚋鹟
zh-CN.extract: 蓝灰蚋鹟是一种非常小的蚋鹟，原产于北美。

Pooecetes gramineus.extract: The vesper sparrow is a medium-sized New World sparrow. The only member of the genus Pooecetes, it is a pale sparrow with brown streaks that breeds across the grasslands of northern North America. It migrates to winter in the southern United States and Mexico.
Pooecetes gramineus.title: Vesper sparrow

zh-CN.title: 黄昏雀
zh-CN.extract: 黄昏雀是一种中等大小的新世界麻雀。它是Pooecetes属的唯一成员，是一种褐色条纹的淡色麻雀，在北美洲北部的草原繁殖。冬季迁徙到美国南部和墨西哥越冬。

Progne subis.extract: The purple martin is a passerine bird in the swallow family Hirundinidae. It is the largest swallow in North America. Despite its name, the purple martin is not truly purple. The dark blackish-blue feathers have an iridescent sheen caused by the diffraction of incident light giving them a bright blue to navy blue or deep purple appearance. In some light, they may even appear green in color.
Progne subis.title: Purple martin

zh-CN.title: 紫崖燕
zh-CN.extract: 紫崖燕是燕科的一种雀形目鸟。它是北美最大的燕子。尽管名字叫紫色，紫崖燕并非真正的紫色。深黑蓝色的羽毛具有由入射光衍射产生的彩虹光泽，使其呈现亮蓝色到深蓝色或深紫色外观。在某些光线下，它们甚至可能呈现绿色。

Psaltriparus minimus.extract: The American bushtit, or simply bushtit, is a social songbird belonging to the monotypic genus Psaltriparus. It is one of the smallest passerines in North America and it is the only species in the family Aegithalidae found in the Americas; the other eleven species occur in Eurasia.
Psaltriparus minimus.title: American bushtit

zh-CN.title: 丛山雀
zh-CN.extract: 美国丛山雀，或简称丛山雀，是一种社会性鸣禽，属于单型属Psaltriparus。它是北美最小的雀形目鸟之一，也是长尾山雀科在美洲唯一的物种；其他十一个物种分布在欧亚大陆。

Quiscalus mexicanus.extract: The great-tailed grackle or Mexican grackle is a medium-sized, highly social passerine bird native to North and South America. A member of the family Icteridae, it is one of 10 extant species of grackle and is closely related to the boat-tailed grackle and the extinct slender-billed grackle. In the southern and southwestern United States, the grackle is sometimes referred to simply as a "blackbird" or (erroneously) a "crow" due to its glossy black plumage; however, grackles form their own unique genus that is separate from other "blackbirds", such as the red-winged and Brewer's blackbirds, despite being in the same family (Icteridae). Superficially, Brewer's blackbird is one of the most visually similar species to grackles.
Quiscalus mexicanus.title: Great-tailed grackle

zh-CN.title: 大尾鹩哥
zh-CN.extract: 大尾鹩哥或墨西哥鹩哥是一种中等体型、高度社会化的雀形目鸟，原产于北美和南美。属于拟黄鹂科，是现存10种鹩哥之一，与船尾鹩哥和已灭绝的细嘴鹩哥亲缘关系密切。在美国南部和西南部，鹩哥有时被简称为“黑鸟”或（错误地）“乌鸦”，因为其有光泽的黑色羽毛；然而，鹩哥形成自己独特的属，与其他“黑鸟”（如红翅黑鸟和Brewer's黑鸟）分开，尽管属于同一科（拟黄鹂科）。从外表看，Brewer's黑鸟是与鹩哥视觉上最相似的物种之一。

Recurvirostra americana.extract: The American avocet is a large wader in the avocet and stilt family, Recurvirostridae, found in North America. It spends much of its time foraging in shallow water or on mud flats, often sweeping its bill from side to side in water as it seeks crustacean and insect prey.
Recurvirostra americana.title: American avocet

zh-CN.title: 美洲反嘴鹬
zh-CN.extract: 美洲反嘴鹬是一种大型涉禽，属于反嘴鹬科，发现于北美。它花费大量时间在浅水或泥滩上觅食，经常在水中左右摆动喙以寻找甲壳类和昆虫猎物。

Regulus calendula.extract: The ruby-crowned kinglet is a very small passerine bird found throughout North America. It is a member of the kinglet family. The bird has olive-green plumage with two white wing bars and a white eye-ring. Males have a red crown patch, which is often concealed. The sexes are identical apart from the crown, and juveniles are similar in plumage to adult females. It is one of the smallest songbirds in North America. The ruby-crowned kinglet is not closely related to other kinglets and was moved from Regulus to its own genus, Corthylio in 2021. Three subspecies are currently recognized.
Regulus calendula.title: Ruby-crowned kinglet

zh-CN.title: 红冠戴菊
zh-CN.extract: 红冠戴菊是一种非常小的雀形目鸟类，遍布北美。它是戴菊科的一员。这种鸟有橄榄绿色的羽毛，带有两条白色翼斑和一个白色眼圈。雄性有一个红色冠斑，通常隐藏。除冠部外，两性相同，幼鸟与成年雌鸟羽毛相似。它是北美最小的鸣禽之一。红冠戴菊与其他戴菊鸟亲缘关系不近，并于2021年从戴菊属移至其自己的属Corthylio。目前确认有三个亚种。

Regulus satrapa.extract: The golden-crowned kinglet is a very small songbird in the family Regulidae that lives throughout much of North America.
Regulus satrapa.title: Golden-crowned kinglet

zh-CN.title: 金冠戴菊
zh-CN.extract: 金冠戴菊是一种非常小的鸣禽，属于戴菊科，遍布北美大部分地区。

Riparia riparia.extract: The sand martin, also known as the collared sand martin or common sand martin, and in the Americas as the bank swallow, is a migratory passerine bird in the swallow family Hirundinidae. It has a wide range in summer, embracing practically the whole Holarctic area, from Europe, across Asia to the Pacific Ocean, and throughout North America. It winters in eastern and southern Africa, southern Asia, and South America.
Riparia riparia.title: Sand martin

zh-CN.title: 崖沙燕
zh-CN.extract: 崖沙燕，也称为环颈沙燕或普通沙燕，在美洲称为bank swallow，是一种迁徙雀形目鸟类，属于燕科。夏季分布范围广泛，几乎涵盖整个全北区，从欧洲、亚洲到太平洋，以及整个北美。冬季在东非和南部非洲、南亚和南美洲越冬。

Rynchops niger.extract: The black skimmer is a tern-like seabird, one of three similar bird species in the skimmer genus Rynchops in the gull family Laridae. It breeds in North and South America. Northern populations winter in the warmer waters of the Caribbean and the tropical and subtropical Pacific and Atlantic coasts, but South American populations make only shorter movements in response to annual floods which extend their feeding areas in the river shallows.
Rynchops niger.title: Black skimmer

zh-CN.title: 黑剪嘴鸥
zh-CN.extract: 黑剪嘴鸥是一种类似燕鸥的海鸟，是剪嘴鸥属三种相似鸟类之一，属于鸥科。它在北美和南美繁殖。北方种群在加勒比海以及热带和亚热带太平洋与大西洋较暖水域越冬，而南方种群仅因年度洪水而进行较短距离移动，洪水扩展了它们在河流浅滩的觅食区域。

Salpinctes obsoletus.extract: The rock wren is a small songbird of the wren family native to the rocky areas of western North America. There are 8 subspecies of the rock wren, one of which is extinct. They are similar in size to other wrens, with a grey-brown coat, a brown rump, and a speckled white throat.
Salpinctes obsoletus.title: Rock wren

zh-CN.title: 岩鹪鹩
zh-CN.extract: 岩鹪鹩是一种小型鸣禽，属于鹪鹩科，原产于北美西部的岩石区域。岩鹪鹩有8个亚种，其中一种已灭绝。它们与其他鹪鹩体型相似，有灰棕色羽毛、棕色腰部和斑点白色喉部。

Sayornis nigricans.extract: The black phoebe is a passerine bird in the tyrant-flycatcher family. It breeds from southwest Oregon and California south through Central and South America. It occurs year-round throughout most of its range and migrates less than the other birds in its genus though its northern populations are partially migratory. Six subspecies are commonly recognized although two are occasionally combined as a separate species, the white-winged phoebe.
Sayornis nigricans.title: Black phoebe

zh-CN.title: 黑菲比霸鹟
zh-CN.extract: 黑菲比霸鹟是一种雀形目鸟类，属于霸鹟科。它从俄勒冈州西南部和加利福尼亚州向南繁殖到中美洲和南美洲。全年大部分分布区都有出现，迁徙程度低于同属其他鸟类，但其北方种群部分迁徙。通常确认六个亚种，尽管其中两个偶尔被合并为一个独立物种——白翅菲比霸鹟。

Sayornis saya.extract: Say's phoebe is a passerine bird in the tyrant flycatcher family, Tyrannidae. A common bird across western North America, it prefers dry, desolate areas. It was named for Thomas Say, an American naturalist.
Sayornis saya.title: Say's phoebe

zh-CN.title: 赛氏菲比霸鹟
zh-CN.extract: 赛氏菲比霸鹟是一种雀形目鸟类，属于霸鹟科。它是北美西部常见的鸟类，偏好干燥荒凉地区。以美国博物学家托马斯·赛命名。

Selasphorus platycercus.extract: The broad-tailed hummingbird is a medium-sized hummingbird species found in highland regions from western United States and Western Canada to Mexico and Guatemala.
Selasphorus platycercus.title: Broad-tailed hummingbird

zh-CN.title: 宽尾煌蜂鸟
zh-CN.extract: 宽尾煌蜂鸟是一种中等体型的蜂鸟物种，发现于从美国西部和加拿大西部到墨西哥和危地马拉的高原地区。

Selasphorus rufus.extract: The rufous hummingbird is a small hummingbird, about 8 cm (3 in) long with a long, straight and slender bill. These birds are known for their extraordinary flight skills, flying 3,200 kilometres during their migratory transits. It is one of nine species in the genus Selasphorus.
Selasphorus rufus.title: Rufous hummingbird

zh-CN.title: 棕煌蜂鸟
zh-CN.extract: 棕煌蜂鸟是一种小型蜂鸟，体长约8厘米（3英寸），拥有长而直且细长的喙。这些鸟类以其非凡的飞行技巧而闻名，在迁徙途中飞行3200公里。它是煌蜂鸟属（Selasphorus）的九个物种之一。

Selasphorus sasin.extract: Allen's hummingbird is a species of hummingbird that breeds in the western United States. It is one of seven species in the genus Selasphorus.
Selasphorus sasin.title: Allen's hummingbird

zh-CN.title: 艾伦氏蜂鸟
zh-CN.extract: 艾伦氏蜂鸟是一种在美国西部繁殖的蜂鸟。它是煌蜂鸟属的七个物种之一。

Setophaga coronata.extract: The yellow-rumped warbler is a regular North American bird species that can be commonly observed all across the continent. Its extensive range connects both the Pacific and Atlantic coasts of the U.S. as well as Canada and Central America, with the population concentrated in the continent's northern reaches during the breeding season and migrating southwards to southern North and Central America in the winter. It generally prefers coniferous forests or mixed coniferous-deciduous forests as its breeding habitat, while during the winter it can be found inhabiting more open areas such as shrublands that offer food resources. The yellow-rumped warbler is primarily insectivorous, though the species does eat fruits such as juniper berries as well, especially in winter.
Setophaga coronata.title: Yellow-rumped warbler

zh-CN.title: 黄腰林莺
zh-CN.extract: 黄腰林莺是一种常见的北美鸟类，在整个大陆都可以普遍观察到。其分布范围广泛，连接了美国太平洋和大西洋沿岸，以及加拿大和中美洲，种群在繁殖季节集中于大陆北部，冬季向南迁徙至北美南部和中美洲。它通常偏好针叶林或针阔混交林作为繁殖栖息地，而在冬季则会栖息在更开阔的区域，如能提供食物资源的灌木丛。黄腰林莺主要以昆虫为食，但也吃水果，如杜松子，尤其是在冬季。

Setophaga magnolia.extract: The magnolia warbler is a member of the wood warbler family Parulidae.
Setophaga magnolia.title: Magnolia warbler

zh-CN.title: 木兰林莺
zh-CN.extract: 木兰林莺是森莺科（Parulidae）林莺属的一员。

Setophaga nigrescens.extract: The black-throated gray warbler or black-throated grey warbler is a passerine bird of the New World warbler family Parulidae. It is 13 cm (5.1 in) long and has gray and white plumage with black markings. The male has the bold black throat of its name, and black stripes on its head, as well as black streaks on its flanks; the female is a paler version of the male, with a white throat and less distinct black markings on the flanks and wings. It breeds in western North America from British Columbia to New Mexico, and winters in Mexico and the southwestern United States. The habitats it prefers are coniferous and mixed forests and scrubland, especially those with pinyon pines, junipers, sagebrush, and oaks. Its nest is an open cup of plant fibers lined with feathers, built a few metres from the ground in the branches of a tree or shrub. Three to five eggs are laid, and young are fed by both parents. Common in its breeding range, it does not seem to be seriously threatened by human activities, unlike many migratory warblers.
Setophaga nigrescens.title: Black-throated gray warbler

zh-CN.title: 黑喉灰林莺
zh-CN.extract: 黑喉灰林莺是一种雀形目鸟类，属于新大陆莺科（Parulidae）。体长13厘米（5.1英寸），羽毛呈灰色和白色，带有黑色斑纹。雄性有如其名的醒目黑色喉部，头部有黑色条纹，两胁也有黑色纵纹；雌性是雄性的较淡版本，喉部白色，两胁和翼上的黑色斑纹不太明显。它在北美西部繁殖，从不列颠哥伦比亚省到新墨西哥州，冬季在墨西哥和美国西南部过冬。它偏好的栖息地是针叶林、混交林和灌木丛，尤其是那些有松树、杜松、艾灌丛和橡树的地方。它的巢是一个由植物纤维构成的开放式杯状结构，内衬羽毛，筑在离地面几米高的树枝或灌木上。每次产3到5枚卵，幼鸟由双亲喂养。在其繁殖范围内很常见，与许多迁徙林莺不同，它似乎没有受到人类活动的严重威胁。

Setophaga occidentalis.extract: The hermit warbler is a small perching bird. It is a species of New World warbler or wood-warbler. They are a migratory bird, the breeding range spanning the majority of the west coast of the United States. Their winter range includes parts of Mexico and Central America as well as parts of the southern California coast.
Setophaga occidentalis.title: Hermit warbler

zh-CN.title: 隐士林莺
zh-CN.extract: 隐士林莺是一种小型鸣禽。它是新大陆莺科或林莺属的物种。它们是候鸟，繁殖范围覆盖美国西海岸的大部分地区。冬季范围包括墨西哥和中美洲的部分地区，以及加利福尼亚南部海岸的部分地区。

Setophaga palmarum.extract: The palm warbler is a small songbird in the New World warbler family.
Setophaga palmarum.title: Palm warbler

zh-CN.title: 棕榈林莺
zh-CN.extract: 棕榈林莺是新大陆莺科中的一种小型鸣禽。

Setophaga petechia.extract: The yellow warbler is a New World warbler species. Yellow warblers are the most widespread species in the diverse genus Setophaga, breeding in almost the whole of North America, the Caribbean, as well as northern South America.
Setophaga petechia.title: Yellow warbler

zh-CN.title: 黄林莺
zh-CN.extract: 黄林莺是一种新大陆莺科物种。黄林莺是多样的林莺属（Setophaga）中分布最广的物种，几乎在北美、加勒比地区以及南美洲北部的整个区域繁殖。

Setophaga ruticilla.extract: The American redstart is a New World warbler. It is unrelated to the Old World (common) redstart.
Setophaga ruticilla.title: American redstart

zh-CN.title: 美洲红尾鸲
zh-CN.extract: 美洲红尾鸲是一种新世界莺。它与旧世界（普通）红尾鸲没有亲缘关系。

Setophaga townsendi.extract: Townsend's warbler is a small songbird of the New World warbler family.
Setophaga townsendi.title: Townsend's warbler

zh-CN.title: 汤氏莺
zh-CN.extract: 汤氏莺是一种小型鸣禽，属于新世界莺科。

Sialia currucoides.extract: The mountain bluebird is a migratory small thrush that is found in mountainous districts of western North America. It has a light underbelly and black eyes. Adult males have thin bills and are bright turquoise-blue and somewhat lighter underneath. Adult females have duller blue wings and tail, grey breast, grey crown, throat and back. In fresh fall plumage, the female's throat and breast are tinged with red-orange which is brownish near the flank, contrasting with white tail underparts. Their call is a thin 'few' while their song is a warbled high 'chur chur'. The mountain bluebird is the state bird of Idaho and Nevada. This bird is an omnivore and it can live 6 to 10 years in the wild. It eats spiders, grasshoppers, flies and other insects, and small fruits. The mountain bluebird is a relative of the eastern and western bluebirds.
Sialia currucoides.title: Mountain bluebird

zh-CN.title: 山蓝鸲
zh-CN.extract: 山蓝鸲是一种迁徙的小型鸫，分布于北美西部的山区。它有浅色的下腹部和黑色的眼睛。成年雄鸟喙细窄，身体呈亮绿松石蓝色，下方略浅。成年雌鸟翅膀和尾巴为较暗的蓝色，胸部灰色，冠部、喉咙和背部灰色。在秋季新羽时，雌鸟的喉咙和胸部带有红橙色，靠近胁部呈褐色，与白色尾下覆羽形成对比。它们的叫声是单薄的“few”，歌声是高音颤音的“chur chur”。山蓝鸲是爱达荷州和内华达州的州鸟。这种鸟是杂食动物，在野外可活6到10年。它以蜘蛛、蚱蜢、苍蝇和其他昆虫以及小果实为食。山蓝鸲是东部蓝鸲和西部蓝鸲的近亲。

Sialia mexicana.extract: The western bluebird is a small North American thrush.
Sialia mexicana.title: Western bluebird

zh-CN.title: 西部蓝鸲
zh-CN.extract: 西部蓝鸲是一种小型北美鸫。

Sitta canadensis.extract: The red-breasted nuthatch is a small songbird. The adult has blue-grey upperparts with cinnamon underparts, a white throat and face with a black stripe through the eyes, a straight grey bill and a black crown. Its call, which has been likened to a tin trumpet, is high-pitched and nasal. It breeds in coniferous forests across Canada, Alaska and the northeastern and western United States. Though often a permanent resident, it regularly irrupts further south if its food supply fails. There are records of vagrants occurring as far south as the Gulf Coast and northern Mexico. It forages on the trunks and large branches of trees, often descending head first, sometimes catching insects in flight. It eats mainly insects and seeds, especially from conifers. It excavates its nest in dead wood, often close to the ground, smearing the entrance with pitch.
Sitta canadensis.title: Red-breasted nuthatch

zh-CN.title: 红胸䴓
zh-CN.extract: 红胸䴓是一种小型鸣禽。成鸟上体蓝灰色，下体肉桂色，白色喉咙和脸部有黑色眼纹，喙直灰色，冠部黑色。它的叫声被比作锡号，高音且带鼻音。它在加拿大、阿拉斯加以及美国东北部和西部的针叶林中繁殖。尽管通常是留鸟，但食物短缺时会定期向南暴发性迁徙。有记录显示迷鸟可远至墨西哥湾沿岸和墨西哥北部。它在树干和粗枝上觅食，常头朝下下行，有时在空中捕虫。主要吃昆虫和种子，尤其是针叶树的种子。它在枯木中挖巢，通常靠近地面，用树脂涂抹入口。

Sitta carolinensis.extract: The white-breasted nuthatch is a species of bird in the nuthatch family Sittidae. It is a medium-sized nuthatch, measuring approximately 15.5 cm (6.1 in) in length. Coloration varies somewhat along the species' range, but the upperparts are light blue-gray, with a black crown and nape in males, while females have a dark gray crown. The underparts are whitish, with a reddish tinge on the lower abdomen. Despite not being closely related, the white-breasted nuthatch and the white wagtail are very similar in plumage.
Sitta carolinensis.title: White-breasted nuthatch

zh-CN.title: 白胸䴓
zh-CN.extract: 白胸䴓是䴓科鸟类的一种。它是一种中等体型的䴓，体长约15.5厘米（6.1英寸）。颜色在整个分布区略有变化，但上体浅蓝灰色，雄鸟冠部和后颈黑色，雌鸟冠部暗灰色。下体白色，下腹部略带红色。尽管没有密切亲缘关系，白胸䴓和白鹡鸰的羽毛非常相似。

Sitta pygmaea.extract: The pygmy nuthatch is a tiny songbird, native to western North America.
Sitta pygmaea.title: Pygmy nuthatch

zh-CN.title: 小䴓
zh-CN.extract: 小䴓是一种极小的鸣禽，原产于北美西部。

Spatula clypeata.extract: The northern shoveler, often known simply as the shoveler where other related species do not occur, is a common and widespread duck. It breeds in northern areas of Europe and throughout the Palearctic and across most of North America, and winters in southern Europe, the Indian subcontinent, Southeast Asia, Central America, the Caribbean, and northern South America. It is a rare vagrant to Australia. In North America, it breeds along the southern edge of Hudson Bay and west of this body of water, and as far south as the Great Lakes west to Colorado, Nevada, and Oregon.
Spatula clypeata.title: Northern shoveler

zh-CN.title: 琵嘴鸭
zh-CN.extract: 琵嘴鸭，通常简称为琵嘴鸭（在无其他相关物种的区域），是一种常见且分布广泛的鸭子。它在欧洲北部和整个古北界以及北美大部分地区繁殖，冬季在南欧、印度次大陆、东南亚、中美洲、加勒比地区和南美洲北部越冬。在澳大利亚是罕见的迷鸟。在北美，它沿哈德逊湾南缘及该水域以西繁殖，南至五大湖西部至科罗拉多州、内华达州和俄勒冈州。

Spatula discors.extract: The blue-winged teal is a species of bird in the duck, goose, and swan family Anatidae. One of the smaller members of the dabbling duck group, it occurs in North America, where it breeds from southern Alaska to Nova Scotia, and south to northern Texas. It winters along the Pacific and Atlantic coasts and south into the Caribbean islands and Central America.
Spatula discors.title: Blue-winged teal

zh-CN.title: 蓝翅鸭
zh-CN.extract: 蓝翅鸭是鸭科（Anatidae）中的一种鸟类，属于鸭、鹅、天鹅科。它是涉鸭类群中较小的成员之一，分布于北美洲，繁殖范围从阿拉斯加南部到新斯科舍省，南至德克萨斯州北部。冬季沿太平洋和大西洋海岸向南迁徙至加勒比群岛和中美洲。

Sphyrapicus ruber.extract: The red-breasted sapsucker is a medium-sized woodpecker of the forests of the west coast of North America.
Sphyrapicus ruber.title: Red-breasted sapsucker

zh-CN.title: 红胸吸汁啄木鸟
zh-CN.extract: 红胸吸汁啄木鸟是一种中等体型的啄木鸟，栖息于北美西海岸的森林中。

Sphyrapicus thyroideus.extract: Williamson's sapsucker is a medium-sized woodpecker belonging to the genus Sphyrapicus (sapsuckers).
Sphyrapicus thyroideus.title: Williamson's sapsucker

zh-CN.title: 威廉逊吸汁啄木鸟
zh-CN.extract: 威廉逊吸汁啄木鸟是一种中等体型的啄木鸟，属于吸汁啄木鸟属（Sphyrapicus）。

Spinus lawrencei.extract: Lawrence's goldfinch is a small songbird of erratic distribution that breeds in California and Baja California and winters in the southwestern United States and northern Mexico.
Spinus lawrencei.title: Lawrence's goldfinch

zh-CN.title: 劳伦斯金翅雀
zh-CN.extract: 劳伦斯金翅雀是一种小型鸣禽，分布无常，繁殖于加利福尼亚州和下加利福尼亚州，冬季在美国西南部和墨西哥北部越冬。

Spinus pinus.extract: The pine siskin is a North American bird in the finch family. It is a migratory bird with an extremely sporadic winter range.
Spinus pinus.title: Pine siskin

zh-CN.title: 松金翅雀
zh-CN.extract: 松金翅雀是北美洲的一种雀科鸟类。它是一种候鸟，冬季分布范围极其零散。

Spinus psaltria.extract: The lesser goldfinch is a small finch in the genus Spinus native to the Americas.
Spinus psaltria.title: Lesser goldfinch

zh-CN.title: 小金翅雀
zh-CN.extract: 小金翅雀是一种小型雀类，属于金翅雀属（Spinus），原产于美洲。

Spinus tristis.extract: The American goldfinch is a small North American bird in the finch family. It is migratory, ranging from mid-Alberta to North Carolina during the breeding season, and from just south of the Canada–United States border to Mexico during the winter.
Spinus tristis.title: American goldfinch

zh-CN.title: 美洲金翅雀
zh-CN.extract: 美洲金翅雀是北美洲的一种小型雀科鸟类。它是候鸟，繁殖季节分布范围从阿尔伯塔省中部到北卡罗来纳州，冬季从美加边界以南到墨西哥。

Spizella atrogularis.extract: The black-chinned sparrow is a small bird in the genus Spizella, in the New World sparrow family Passerellidae. It is found in the southwestern United States and throughout much of Mexico north of the Isthmus of Tehuantepec; most populations in the US migrate south after breeding while those in Mexico are resident. It is a slim, long-tailed bird, primarily gray with a reddish-brown back streaked with black, brown wings and tail, a pink beak, and brownish legs and feet. In the breeding season, the male shows black on his throat, chin, and the front of his face. Females, youngsters and nonbreeding males show little or no black in these areas. An unobtrusive bird, it spends much of its time foraging slowly along the ground, either alone or in small groups, sometimes mixing with other Spizella species. It is an omnivore, feeding primarily on seeds during the winter and insects during the summer. It builds a cup-shaped nest of grasses, rootlets, or plant fibers, into which the female lays 2–5 pale blue eggs. The female does most or all of the egg incubation, but both parents feed the hatched nestlings.
Spizella atrogularis.title: Black-chinned sparrow

zh-CN.title: 黑颏麻雀
zh-CN.extract: 黑颏麻雀是Spizella属的一种小鸟，属于新大陆麻雀科（Passerellidae）。它分布于美国西南部和墨西哥大部分地区（特万特佩克地峡以北）；美国的大多数种群在繁殖后向南迁徙，而墨西哥的种群则为留鸟。它是一种纤细、长尾的鸟类，主体灰色，背部红褐色带有黑色条纹，翅膀和尾巴褐色，喙粉色，腿和脚淡褐色。在繁殖季节，雄性的喉咙、下巴和面部前方呈黑色。雌性、幼鸟和非繁殖期雄性在这些区域几乎没有或完全没有黑色。这是一种不引人注目的鸟类，大部分时间独自或成小群在地面缓慢觅食，有时与其他Spizella物种混群。它是杂食动物，冬季主要以种子为食，夏季以昆虫为食。它用草、细根或植物纤维筑成杯状巢，雌鸟产下2-5枚淡蓝色卵。雌鸟负责大部分或全部孵化，但双亲都会喂养孵出的雏鸟。

Spizella breweri.extract: Brewer's sparrow is a small, slim species of American sparrow in the family Passerellidae. This bird was named after the ornithologist Thomas Mayo Brewer.
Spizella breweri.title: Brewer's sparrow

zh-CN.title: 布氏麻雀
zh-CN.extract: 布氏麻雀是一种小型、苗条的美洲麻雀，属于雀鹀科。这种鸟以鸟类学家托马斯·梅奥·布鲁尔命名。

Spizella passerina.extract: The chipping sparrow is a species of New World sparrow, a passerine bird in the family Passerellidae. It is widespread, fairly tame, and common across most of its North American range.
Spizella passerina.title: Chipping sparrow

zh-CN.title: 灰头麻雀
zh-CN.extract: 灰头麻雀是一种新世界麻雀，属于雀鹀科的一种雀形目鸟类。它分布广泛，相对温顺，在北美大部分地区都很常见。

Spizelloides arborea.extract: The American tree sparrow, also known as the winter sparrow, is a medium-sized New World sparrow. It breeds in Alaska and Northern Canada and winters in Southern Canada and the Contiguous United States. It is the only member of the genus Spizelloides.
Spizelloides arborea.title: American tree sparrow

zh-CN.title: 美洲树麻雀
zh-CN.extract: 美洲树麻雀，也称为冬麻雀，是一种中等体型的新世界麻雀。它在阿拉斯加和加拿大北部繁殖，在加拿大南部和美国本土过冬。它是Spizelloides属的唯一成员。

Stelgidopteryx serripennis.extract: The northern rough-winged swallow is a small, migratory swallow. It is very similar to the southern rough-winged swallow, Stelgidopteryx ruficollis.
Stelgidopteryx serripennis.title: Northern rough-winged swallow

zh-CN.title: 北方粗翅燕
zh-CN.extract: 北方粗翅燕是一种小型迁徙性燕子。它与南方粗翅燕（Stelgidopteryx ruficollis）非常相似。

Sterna forsteri.extract: Forster's tern is a tern in the family Laridae. The genus name Sterna is derived from Old English "stearn", "tern", and forsteri commemorates the naturalist Johann Reinhold Forster.
Sterna forsteri.title: Forster's tern

zh-CN.title: 福斯特燕鸥
zh-CN.extract: 福斯特燕鸥是鸥科的一种燕鸥。属名Sterna源自古英语'stearn'，意为'燕鸥'，种加词forsteri以博物学家约翰·莱因霍尔德·福斯特命名。

Sterna hirundo.extract: The common tern is a seabird in the family Laridae. This bird has a circumpolar distribution, its four subspecies breeding in temperate and subarctic regions of Europe, Asia and North America. It is strongly migratory, wintering in coastal tropical and subtropical regions. Breeding adults have light grey upperparts, white to very light grey underparts, a black cap, orange-red legs, and a narrow pointed bill. Depending on the subspecies, the bill may be mostly red with a black tip or all black. There are several similar species, including the partly sympatric Arctic tern, which can be separated on plumage details, leg and bill colour, or vocalisations.
Sterna hirundo.title: Common tern

zh-CN.title: 普通燕鸥
zh-CN.extract: 普通燕鸥是鸥科的一种海鸟。这种鸟呈环极分布，其四个亚种在欧洲、亚洲和北美的温带和亚北极地区繁殖。它是一种强迁徙性鸟类，在沿海热带和亚热带地区越冬。繁殖成鸟上体浅灰色，下体白色至非常浅的灰色，黑色头顶，橙红色腿，以及窄而尖的喙。根据亚种不同，喙可能大部分为红色带有黑色尖端，或全黑色。有几种相似物种，包括部分同域分布的北极燕鸥，可以通过羽毛细节、腿和喙的颜色或叫声来区分。

Streptopelia decaocto.extract: The Eurasian collared dove, often simply just collared dove, is a dove species native to Europe, Asia, and northern Africa. It has also been introduced to Japan, North and Central America, and the islands in the Caribbean.
Streptopelia decaocto.title: Eurasian collared dove

zh-CN.title: 欧亚环颈斑鸠
zh-CN.extract: 欧亚环颈斑鸠，通常简称为环颈斑鸠，是一种原产于欧洲、亚洲和北非的鸽种。它也被引入到日本、北美、中美以及加勒比海的岛屿。

Strix occidentalis.extract: The spotted owl is a species of true owl. It is a resident species of old-growth forests in western North America, where it nests in tree hollows, old bird of prey nests, or rock crevices. Nests can be between 12 and 60 metres high and usually contain two eggs. It is a nocturnal owl which feeds on small mammals and birds. Three subspecies are recognized, ranging in distribution from British Columbia to Mexico. The spotted owl is under pressure from habitat destruction throughout its range, and is currently classified as a near-threatened species.
Strix occidentalis.title: Spotted owl

zh-CN.title: 斑林鸮
zh-CN.extract: 斑林鸮是鸱鸮科的一种真正的猫头鹰。它是北美西部原始森林的留鸟，在树洞、旧的猛禽巢穴或岩石缝隙中筑巢。巢穴高度在12至60米之间，通常产两枚卵。它是一种夜行性猫头鹰，以小型哺乳动物和鸟类为食。目前确认有三个亚种，分布范围从不列颠哥伦比亚省到墨西哥。斑林鸮在其整个分布区内受到栖息地破坏的压力，目前被列为近危物种。

Sturnella neglecta.extract: The western meadowlark is a medium-sized icterid bird, about 20 cm (7.9 in) in length. It is found across western and central North America and is a partial migrant, breeding in western Canada and western United States west of the Great Lakes, and in northern Mexico. In the northern half of the breeding range, the birds migrate south for the winter, while further south they are resident all year. The winter range also extends south and southeast of the breeding range, as far as central Mexico, and east to western Florida. The western meadowlark nests on the ground in open grasslands and shrublands. It feeds on bugs and seeds. The western meadowlark has distinctive calls described as watery or flute-like, which distinguish it from the closely related eastern meadowlark. The western meadowlark is the state bird of six states; in Kansas, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, Oregon, and Wyoming.
Sturnella neglecta.title: Western meadowlark

zh-CN.title: 西草地鹨
zh-CN.extract: 西草地鹨是一种中等体型的拟黄鹂科鸟类，体长约20厘米。分布于北美洲西部和中部，是一种部分迁徙的鸟类，在加拿大西部、美国西部（五大湖以西）以及墨西哥北部繁殖。在繁殖区北部，鸟类会向南迁徙过冬，而在较南地区则全年留居。冬季分布范围也向繁殖区的南部和东南部延伸，远至墨西哥中部，东到佛罗里达州西部。西草地鹨在开阔的草原和灌木丛中的地面筑巢。以昆虫和种子为食。西草地鹨有独特的叫声，被描述为清脆或笛声般，这使其与近缘的东草地鹨区分开来。西草地鹨是六个州的州鸟：堪萨斯州、蒙大拿州、内布拉斯加州、北达科他州、俄勒冈州和怀俄明州。

Sturnus vulgaris.extract: The common starling, also known simply as the starling in Great Britain and Ireland, and as the European starling in North America, is a medium-sized passerine bird in the starling family, Sturnidae. It is about 20 cm (8 in) long and has glossy black plumage with a metallic sheen, which is speckled with white at some times of the year. The legs are pink and the bill is black in winter and yellow in summer; young birds have browner plumage than the adults. Its gift for mimicry has been noted in literature including the Mabinogion and the works of Pliny the Elder and William Shakespeare.
Sturnus vulgaris.title: Common starling

zh-CN.title: 紫翅椋鸟
zh-CN.extract: 紫翅椋鸟，在英国和爱尔兰常简称为椋鸟，在北美称为欧洲椋鸟，是椋鸟科（Sturnidae）的一种中等体型的雀形目鸟类。体长约20厘米，羽毛黑色有光泽，带有金属光泽，一年中某些时候有白色斑点。腿粉红色，喙冬季黑色、夏季黄色；幼鸟的羽毛比成鸟更偏褐色。其模仿能力在文学作品中有所记载，包括《马比诺吉昂》以及老普林尼和威廉·莎士比亚的作品。

Tachycineta bicolor.extract: The tree swallow is a migratory bird of the family Hirundinidae. Found in the Americas, the tree swallow was first described in 1807 by French ornithologist Louis Vieillot as Hirundo bicolor. It has since been moved to its current genus, Tachycineta, within which its phylogenetic placement is debated. The tree swallow has glossy blue-green upperparts, with the exception of the blackish wings and tail, and white underparts. The bill is black, the eyes dark brown, and the legs and feet pale brown. The female is generally duller than the male, and the first-year female has mostly brown upperparts, with some blue feathers. Juveniles have brown upperparts, and gray-brown-washed breasts. The tree swallow breeds in the US and Canada. It winters along southern US coasts south, along the Gulf Coast, to Panama and the northwestern coast of South America, and in the West Indies.
Tachycineta bicolor.title: Tree swallow

zh-CN.title: 双色树燕
zh-CN.extract: 双色树燕是燕科（Hirundinidae）的一种候鸟。分布于美洲，1807年由法国鸟类学家路易·维埃约首次描述，命名为 Hirundo bicolor。后移入现属 Tachycineta，其系统发育位置尚有争议。双色树燕上身亮蓝绿色，翅和尾偏黑色，下身白色。喙黑色，眼睛深褐色，腿和脚浅褐色。雌鸟通常比雄鸟暗淡，一龄雌鸟上身主要为褐色，带有些蓝色羽毛。幼鸟上身褐色，胸部灰褐色。双色树燕在美国和加拿大繁殖，冬季沿美国南部海岸向南，沿墨西哥湾海岸至巴拿马和南美洲西北海岸，以及西印度群岛越冬。

Tachycineta thalassina.extract: The violet-green swallow is a small North American passerine bird in the swallow family. These aerial insectivores are distributed along the west coast from Alaska to Mexico, extending as far east as Montana and Texas. With an appearance very similar to the tree swallow, these individuals can be identified by the white rump side-patches that appear to separate their green back and purple tail. Violet-green swallows are secondary cavity nesters, found in a number of habitats including deciduous and coniferous forest. In addition to nesting in tree holes within these habitats, they are also widely observed nesting in the cracks of large cliffs.
Tachycineta thalassina.title: Violet-green swallow

zh-CN.title: 紫绿树燕
zh-CN.extract: 紫绿树燕是燕科的一种小型北美雀形目鸟类。这些空中食虫鸟分布于从阿拉斯加到墨西哥的西海岸，东至蒙大拿州和得克萨斯州。外表与双色树燕非常相似，可通过白色臀侧斑（将绿色背部和紫色尾部分开）来识别。紫绿树燕是次级洞巢鸟，栖息于多种生境，包括落叶林和针叶林。除了在这些生境的树洞中筑巢外，也常见于大悬崖裂缝中筑巢。

Thalasseus elegans.extract: The elegant tern is a tern in the family Laridae. It breeds on the Pacific coast of southern California in the United States and western Mexico, and migrates south to Peru, Ecuador and Chile for the northern winter; in the late summer and fall, some also disperse north to Oregon and more rarely Washington.
Thalasseus elegans.title: Elegant tern

zh-CN.title: 优雅燕鸥
zh-CN.extract: 优雅燕鸥是鸥科（Laridae）的一种燕鸥。在美国加利福尼亚州南部太平洋沿岸和墨西哥西部繁殖，冬季向南迁徙至秘鲁、厄瓜多尔和智利；在夏末和秋季，部分个体也会向北扩散至俄勒冈州，较少到华盛顿州。

Thryomanes bewickii.extract: Bewick's wren is a wren native to North America. It is the only species placed in the genus Thryomanes. At about 14 cm (5.5 in) long, it is grey-brown above, white below, with a long white eyebrow. While similar in appearance to the Carolina wren, it has a long tail that is tipped in white. The song is loud and melodious, much like the song of other wrens. It lives in thickets, brush piles and hedgerows, open woodlands and scrubby areas, often near streams. It eats insects and spiders, which it gleans from vegetation or finds on the ground.
Thryomanes bewickii.title: Bewick's wren

zh-CN.title: 比氏鹪鹩
zh-CN.extract: 比氏鹪鹩是一种原产于北美洲的鹪鹩。它是 Thryomanes 属的唯一物种。体长约14厘米，上身灰褐色，下身白色，有长白色眉纹。外形与卡罗来纳鹪鹩相似，但尾长且尖端白色。鸣声响亮动听，与其他鹪鹩相似。栖息于灌木丛、柴堆和树篱、开阔林地和灌丛地带，常近溪流。以昆虫和蜘蛛为食，从植被上获取或在地面觅食。

Toxostoma redivivum.extract: The California thrasher is a large member of family Mimidae found primarily in chaparral habitat in California in the United States and Baja California in Mexico. It is the only species of the genus Toxostoma throughout most of its range.
Toxostoma redivivum.title: California thrasher

zh-CN.title: 加州弯嘴鸫
zh-CN.extract: 加州弯嘴鸫是嘲鸫科（Mimidae）的大型鸟类，主要分布于美国加利福尼亚州的夏栎灌丛生境和墨西哥的下加利福尼亚州。在其大部分分布区内，它是 Toxostoma 属的唯一物种。

Tringa semipalmata.extract: The willet is a large shorebird in the family Scolopacidae. It is a relatively large and robust sandpiper and is the largest of the species called "shanks" in the genus Tringa. Its closest relative is the lesser yellowlegs, a much smaller bird with a very different appearance apart from the fine, clear, and dense pattern of the neck, which both species show in breeding plumage. It breeds in North America and the West Indies and winters in southern North America, Central America, the West Indies and South America.
Tringa semipalmata.title: Willet

zh-CN.title: 半蹼鹬
zh-CN.extract: 半蹼鹬是鹬科（Scolopacidae）的一种大型滨鸟。它是一种相对较大且健壮的鹬，也是 Tringa 属中被称为“鹬”的最大物种。其最近亲是小黄脚鹬，体型小得多，外貌差异很大，但颈部在繁殖期有精细、清晰而密集的斑纹，两者共有。半蹼鹬在北美和西印度群岛繁殖，冬季在北美南部、中美洲、西印度群岛和南美洲越冬。

Troglodytes aedon.extract: The northern house wren is a very small passerine in the wren family Troglodytidae. It is found in southern Canada, the USA and Mexico. It occurs in most suburban areas in its range. It formerly included many subspecies resident in South America and in the Caribbean that are now considered as separate species. The name troglodytes means "hole dweller", and is a reference to the bird's tendency to disappear into crevices when hunting insects or to seek shelter.
Troglodytes aedon.title: Northern house wren

zh-CN.title: 北美家鹪鹩
zh-CN.extract: 北美家鹪鹩是一种非常小的雀形目鸟类，属于鹪鹩科。分布于加拿大南部、美国以及墨西哥。在其分布范围内，大多数郊区都有出现。此前包括了许多分布于南美洲和加勒比地区的亚种，但这些亚种如今已被视为独立物种。种名troglodytes意为“洞穴居住者”，指的是这种鸟在捕食昆虫或寻找庇护时倾向于躲入缝隙的习性。

Troglodytes pacificus.extract: The Pacific wren is a very small North American bird and a member of the mainly New World wren family Troglodytidae. The species was formerly lumped together with either the winter wren of eastern North America alone, or also with the Eurasian wren of Eurasia, then under the merged name of northern wren with the scientific name T. troglodytes having priority.
Troglodytes pacificus.title: Pacific wren

zh-CN.title: 太平洋鹪鹩
zh-CN.extract: 太平洋鹪鹩是一种非常小的北美鸟类，属于主要分布于新大陆的鹪鹩科。该物种曾与北美东部的冬鹪鹩合并，或与欧亚大陆的欧亚鹪鹩合并，统一称为北方鹪鹩，其学名T. troglodytes具有优先权。

Turdus migratorius.extract: The American robin is a migratory bird of the true thrush genus and Turdidae, the wider thrush family. It is named after the European robin because of its reddish-orange breast, though the two species are not closely related, with the European robin belonging to the Old World flycatcher family. The American robin is widely distributed throughout North America, wintering from southern Canada to central Mexico and along the Pacific coast.
Turdus migratorius.title: American robin

zh-CN.title: 美洲知更鸟
zh-CN.extract: 美洲知更鸟是一种候鸟，属于鸫属和鸫科。因其红橙色的胸部得名于欧洲知更鸟，但这两个物种亲缘关系不近，欧洲知更鸟属于旧大陆鹟科。美洲知更鸟广泛分布于北美全境，冬季从加拿大南部到墨西哥中部以及太平洋沿岸地区越冬。

Tyrannus verticalis.extract: The western kingbird is a large tyrant flycatcher found throughout western North America, as far south as Mexico.
Tyrannus verticalis.title: Western kingbird

zh-CN.title: 西王霸鹟
zh-CN.extract: 西王霸鹟是一种大型的霸鹟科鸟类，分布于北美西部，南至墨西哥。

Tyrannus vociferans.extract: Cassin's kingbird is a large tyrant flycatcher native to western North America. The name of this bird commemorates the American ornithologist John Cassin.
Tyrannus vociferans.title: Cassin's kingbird

zh-CN.title: 卡辛王霸鹟
zh-CN.extract: 卡辛王霸鹟是一种大型的霸鹟科鸟类，原产于北美西部。这种鸟的名字是为了纪念美国鸟类学家约翰·卡辛。

Tyto alba.extract: The western barn owl is a species of barn owl native to Europe, southwestern Asia, and Africa. It was formerly considered a subspecies group together with barn owls native to other parts of the world, but this classification was found to be paraphyletic with respect to some other members of the genus.
Tyto alba.title: Western barn owl

zh-CN.title: 西仓鸮
zh-CN.extract: 西仓鸮是一种仓鸮，原产于欧洲、西南亚和非洲。它曾与世界其他地区的仓鸮一起被视为一个亚种群，但后来发现这种分类相对于该属的其他一些成员来说是并系群。

Urile penicillatus.extract: Brandt's cormorant is a strictly marine bird of the cormorant family of seabirds that inhabits the Pacific coast of North America. It ranges, in the summer, from Alaska to the Gulf of California, but the population north of Vancouver Island migrates south during the winter. Its specific name, penicillatus is Latin for a painter's brush, in reference to white plumes on its neck and back during the early breeding season. The common name honors the German naturalist Johann Friedrich von Brandt of the Academy of Sciences at St. Petersburg, who described the species from specimens collected on expeditions to the Pacific during the early 19th century.
Urile penicillatus.title: Brandt's cormorant

zh-CN.title: 布兰特鸬鹚
zh-CN.extract: 布兰特鸬鹚是一种严格的海鸟，属于鸬鹚科海鸟，栖息于北美太平洋沿岸。夏季时，其分布范围从阿拉斯加到加利福尼亚湾，但温哥华岛以北的种群在冬季会向南迁徙。种加词penicillatus在拉丁语中意为“画家的画笔”，指的是繁殖季节初期其颈部和背部的白色羽毛。俗名纪念德国博物学家约翰·弗里德里希·冯·布兰特，他曾任职于圣彼得堡科学院，并根据19世纪早期太平洋探险中采集的标本描述了该物种。

Vireo bellii.extract: Bell's vireo is a songbird that migrates between a breeding range in Western North America and a winter range in Central America. It is dull olive-gray above and whitish below. It has a faint white eye ring and faint wing bars.
Vireo bellii.title: Bell's vireo

zh-CN.title: 贝尔维里奥
zh-CN.extract: 贝尔维里奥是一种鸣禽，在北美西部的繁殖区和中美洲的越冬区之间迁徙。它呈暗橄榄灰色，腹部偏白。具有模糊的白色眼圈和模糊的翼斑。

Vireo cassinii.extract: Cassin's vireo is a small North American songbird, ranging from southern British Columbia in Canada through the western coastal states of the United States, including California, Oregon, and Washington. The Cassin's Vireo moves down Western United States forests in its migration. During its migration in early spring and late fall, it spends the winter in regions from southern Arizona to southern Mexico, including parts of Baja California and the Pacific coast of Mexico.
Vireo cassinii.title: Cassin's vireo

zh-CN.title: 卡氏绿鹃
zh-CN.extract: 卡氏绿鹃是一种小型北美鸣禽，分布范围从加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省南部延伸至美国西部沿海各州，包括加利福尼亚、俄勒冈和华盛顿。卡氏绿鹃在迁徙过程中会沿美国西部森林移动。在早春和晚秋的迁徙季节，它会在从亚利桑那州南部到墨西哥南部的地区越冬，包括下加利福尼亚半岛部分地区和墨西哥太平洋沿岸。

Vireo gilvus.extract: The warbling vireo is a small North American songbird.
Vireo gilvus.title: Warbling vireo

zh-CN.title: 歌绿鹃
zh-CN.extract: 歌绿鹃是一种小型北美鸣禽。

Vireo huttoni.extract: Hutton's vireo is a small songbird in the family Vireonidae, the vireos, greenlets, and shrike-babblers. It is found from southwestern Canada to Guatemala.
Vireo huttoni.title: Hutton's vireo

zh-CN.title: 郝氏绿鹃
zh-CN.extract: 郝氏绿鹃是绿鹃科（Vireonidae，包括绿鹃、绿莺和伯劳鹛）的一种小型鸣禽。分布于从加拿大西南部到危地马拉的区域。

Xanthocephalus xanthocephalus.extract: The yellow-headed blackbird is a medium-sized blackbird with a yellow head.
Xanthocephalus xanthocephalus.title: Yellow-headed blackbird

zh-CN.title: 黄头黑鹂
zh-CN.extract: 黄头黑鹂是一种中等体型的黑鹂，头部呈黄色。

Zenaida asiatica.extract: The white-winged dove is a dove whose native range extends from the Southwestern United States through Mexico, Central America, and the Caribbean. They are large for doves, and can be distinguished from similar doves by the distinctive white edge on their wings. They have a blue eyering, and red eyes. The plumage is brownish-gray to gray. Juveniles are duller in color, and have brown eyes. The call is likened to English phrase "who cooks for you". There are three subspecies. It was first described by George Edwards in 1743, and given its binomial name by Linnaeus in 1756. It was moved into the genus Zenaida in 1838.
Zenaida asiatica.title: White-winged dove

zh-CN.title: 白翅鸽
zh-CN.extract: 白翅鸽是一种鸽子，其自然分布范围从美国西南部经墨西哥、中美洲延伸至加勒比地区。它们体型较大，可通过翅膀上独特的白色边缘与类似鸽子区分。具有蓝色眼圈和红色眼睛。羽毛呈棕灰色至灰色。幼鸟颜色较暗，眼睛为褐色。其叫声被类比为英语短语“who cooks for you”。共有三个亚种。1743年由乔治·爱德华兹首次描述，1756年由林奈赋予双名法名称。1838年被归入Zenaida属。

Zenaida macroura.extract: The mourning dove is a member of the dove family, Columbidae. The bird is also known as the American mourning dove, the rain dove, the chueybird, and colloquially as the turtle dove, and it was once known as the Carolina pigeon and Carolina turtledove. It is one of the most abundant and widespread North American birds and a popular gamebird, with more than 20 million birds shot annually in the U.S., both for sport and meat. Its ability to sustain its population under such pressure is due to its prolific breeding; in warm areas, one pair may raise up to six broods of two young each in a single year. The wings make an unusual whistling sound upon take-off and landing, a form of sonation. The bird is a strong flier, capable of speeds up to 88 km/h (55 mph).
Zenaida macroura.title: Mourning dove

zh-CN.title: 哀鸽
zh-CN.extract: 哀鸽是鸽科（Columbidae）的一员。这种鸟也被称为美洲哀鸽、雨鸽、chueybird，俗称斑鸠，曾被称为卡罗来纳鸽和卡罗来纳斑鸠。它是北美数量最多、分布最广的鸟类之一，也是一种受欢迎的猎鸟，在美国每年有超过2000万只被猎杀，用于运动或食用。它在如此压力下仍能维持种群数量，得益于其旺盛的繁殖能力：在温暖地区，一对鸟一年内可繁殖多达六窝，每窝两只幼鸟。起飞和降落时翅膀会发出不寻常的呼啸声，这是一种发声形式。这种鸟飞行能力强，速度可达每小时88公里（55英里）。

Zonotrichia atricapilla.extract: The golden-crowned sparrow is a large New World sparrow found in the western part of North America.
Zonotrichia atricapilla.title: Golden-crowned sparrow

zh-CN.title: 金冠带鹀
zh-CN.extract: 金冠带鹀是一种大型新世界鹀，分布于北美西部。

Zonotrichia leucophrys.extract: The white-crowned sparrow is a species of passerine bird native to North America. A medium-sized member of the New World sparrow family, this species is marked by a grey face and black and white streaking on the upper head. It breeds in brushy areas in the taiga and tundra of the northernmost parts of the continent and in the Rocky Mountains and Pacific coast. While southerly populations in the Rocky Mountains and coast are largely resident, the breeding populations of the northerly part of its range are migratory and can be found as wintering or passage visitors through most of North America south to central Mexico.
Zonotrichia leucophrys.title: White-crowned sparrow

zh-CN.title: 白冠带鹀
zh-CN.extract: 白冠带鹀是一种原产于北美的雀形目鸟类。作为新世界鹀科的中等体型成员，该物种的特征是灰色面部和头部上方的黑白条纹。繁殖于大陆最北部针叶林和冻原的灌丛地带，以及落基山脉和太平洋沿岸。虽然落基山脉和海岸的南部种群大多为留鸟，但其分布范围北部的繁殖种群具有迁徙性，可在北美大部分地区（南至墨西哥中部）作为越冬或过境鸟类出现。

Zonotrichia querula.extract: Harris's sparrow is a large sparrow. Their breeding habitat is the north part of central Canada, making it Canada's only endemic breeding bird. In the winter they migrate to the Great Plains states of the United States, from southern South Dakota to central Texas. The common name of this species commemorates the American amateur ornithologist Edward Harris (1799–1863).
Zonotrichia querula.title: Harris's sparrow

zh-CN.title: 哈里斯雀
zh-CN.extract: 哈里斯雀是一种大型麻雀。它们的繁殖栖息地是加拿大中部的北部地区，使其成为加拿大唯一的地方性繁殖鸟类。冬季它们迁徙到美国大平原各州，从南达科他州南部到德克萨斯州中部。这种鸟的常用名是为了纪念美国业余鸟类学家爱德华·哈里斯（1799-1863）。
